entries.translation_en:
O my master! O Aba Abdillah! O son of the Messenger of Allah!
Your servant, the son of your servant and the son of your maidservant, abased before you,
belittled in the loftiness of your rank, confessing your right,
has come to you seeking your protection, heading for your sanctuary, turning towards your station, seeking means to Allah the Exalted through you.
May I enter, O my master? May I enter, O friend of Allah? May I enter, O angels of Allah who surround this sanctuary and reside in this shrine?
In the Name of Allah, and by Allah, and in the way of Allah, and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah.
O Allah, make me alight at a blessed alighting place, for You are the best of those who give lodging.
Allah is Great, greatly; all praise belongs to Allah, abundantly; and glory be to Allah, morning and evening.
All praise belongs to Allah, the One, the Eternal Refuge, the Glorious, the One, the Bestower of favours, the Gracious, the All-gentle, the All-kind,
who, of His gracious bounty, made easy for me the visit of my master, by His goodness; He did not make me barred from visiting him, nor driven away from his protection; rather He bestowed and granted.
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam, the chosen one of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah, the trustee of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham, the intimate friend of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses, the one who conversed with Allah.
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus, the spirit of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, the beloved of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Ali, the proof of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O successor, the righteous, the God-fearing.
Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah, son of His vengeance, the one left alone and unavenged.
I bear witness that you established the prayer, gave the alms, enjoined what is good, forbade what is evil, and strove in the way of Allah as striving is due to Him, until your sanctuary was violated and you were killed, wronged.
Peace be upon you, O Aba Abdillah.
Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O son of the master of the successors.
Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah al-Zahra, mistress of the women of the worlds.
Peace be upon you, O champion of the Muslims, O my master!
I bear witness that you were a light in the lofty loins and the purified wombs; the Age of Ignorance did not pollute you with its filth, nor clothe you in its darkest garments.
I bear witness that you are among the pillars of the religion, the foundations of the Muslims, and the stronghold of the believers.
I bear witness that you are the Imam, the righteous, the God-fearing, the well-pleased, the pure, the guide, the rightly guided.
I bear witness that the Imams from your descendants are the word of piety, the banners of guidance, the firmest handhold, and the proof against the people of this world.
We belong to Allah and to Him we return. O my master, I am a friend to your friend and an enemy to your enemy; I believe in you all and in your return I am certain, according to the laws of my religion and the final outcome of my deeds; my heart is at peace with your hearts, and my affair follows your affair. O my master, I have come to you fearful, so grant me safety; I have come to you seeking protection, so protect me; I have come to you poor, so enrich me.
My master and my lord, you are my master, the proof of Allah over all creation. I have believed in your secret and your open, your outward and your inward, your first and your last. I bear witness that you are the reciter of the Book of Allah, the trustee of Allah, the caller to Allah with wisdom and good exhortation.
May Allah curse a people who wronged you, and may Allah curse a people who heard of that and were pleased with it.
O Allah, for You I have prayed, for You I have bowed, and for You I have prostrated — You alone, with no partner to You — for prayer, bowing and prostration are not valid except for You, because You are Allah; there is no god but You.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and convey to them from me the finest greeting and salutation, and return their greeting to me.
O Allah, these two units of prayer are a gift from me to my master al-Husayn ibn Ali, peace be upon them both. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon him, accept them from me, and reward me for them with the best of my hope and expectation in You and in Your friend, O Friend of the believers.
Peace be upon al-Husayn ibn Ali, the oppressed, the martyr, the one slain by tears, the captive of sorrows.
O Allah, I bear witness that he is Your friend and the son of Your friend, Your chosen one who rose up for Your right; You honoured him with Your honour, sealed his life with martyrdom, made him a master among the masters and a leader among the leaders, honoured him with pure birth, gave him the inheritances of the prophets, and made him, among the successors, a proof over Your creation. He left no excuse unaddressed in the call, gave sincere counsel generously, and spent his very life for You, until he rescued Your servants from ignorance and the bewilderment of error.
And there banded together against him those whom this world had deceived, who sold their share of the Hereafter for the lowest price, fell headlong after their desires, angered You and angered Your Prophet, and obeyed, among Your servants, the possessors of discord and hypocrisy and the bearers of burdens who deserve the Fire. So he fought them in Your way, patiently, seeking Your reward, advancing and not retreating, untouched in (the cause of) Allah by the blame of any blamer, until his blood was shed in obedience to You and his sanctuary was violated. O Allah, so curse them with a grievous curse and punish them with a painful punishment.
Peace be upon you, O friend of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O son of the Seal of the Prophets.
Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah, mistress of the women of the worlds.
Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.
Peace be upon you, O oppressed martyr.
May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you! You lived felicitous, and you were killed wronged, a martyr.
Peace be upon you, O defenders of the Oneness of Allah.
Peace be upon you, for your patience; how excellent is the final home!
May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you; you have attained a mighty triumph.
Peace be upon you, O righteous servant, the truthful one who consoled (his master) with his own life. I bear witness that you believed in Allah, supported the son of the Messenger of Allah, called to the way of Allah, and consoled (him) with your very self; so upon you, from Allah, be the finest greeting and peace.
May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you, O supporter of the religion of Allah!
Peace be upon you, O supporter of al-Husayn the truthful.
Peace be upon you, O supporter of al-Husayn the martyr.
Upon you, from me, be peace as long as I remain and as long as night and day remain.
O Allah, for You I have prayed, for You I have bowed, and for You I have prostrated.
Peace be upon you, O my master — the farewell greeting of one who is neither averse nor weary. If I depart, it is not from boredom; and if I remain, it is not from doubting what Allah has promised the patient. O my master, may Allah not make this my last covenant of visiting you; grant me return to you, residence in your sanctuary, and being in your shrine. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
Peace be upon you, O door of the (exalted) station.
Peace be upon you, O companion of the Qur'an.
Peace be upon you, O proof in disputation.
Peace be upon you, O ark of salvation.
Peace be upon you, O angels of my Lord who reside in this sanctuary.
Peace be upon you, forever, as long as I remain and as long as night and day remain.
We belong to Allah and to Him we return; and there is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Mighty.
entries.note_en: The complete narrated form: entry permission, salutations, the gift of two rak'ahs of prayer, salutations to al-Abbas (a.s.), and the farewell. Also prescribed on the nights of the two Eids.

entries.title_ar: زيارة العباس بن علي عليه السلام
entries.arabic:
سَلاَمُ ٱللَّهِ وَسَلاَمُ مَلاَئِكَتِهِ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
وَأَنْبِيَائِهِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَعِبَادِهِ ٱلصَالِحينَ
وَجَمِيعِ ٱلشُّهَدَاءِ وَٱلصِّدِّيقينَ
وَٱلزَّاكِيَاتُ ٱلطَّيِّبَاتُ فِيمَا تَغْتَدِي وَتَرُوحُ
عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
أَشْهَدُ لَكَ بِٱلتَّسْلِيمِ وَٱلتَّصْدِيقِ
وَٱلْوَفَاءِ وَٱلنَّصِيحَةِ
لِخَلَفِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِ
وَٱلسِّبْطِ ٱلْمُنْتَجَبِ
وَٱلدَّلِيلِ ٱلْعَالِمِ
وَٱلْوَصِيِّ ٱلْمُبَلِّغِ
وَٱلْمَظْلُومِ ٱلْمُهْتَضَمِ
فَجَزَاكَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْ رَسُولِهِ
وَعَنْ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَعَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ
أَفْضَلَ ٱلْجَزَاءِ
بِمَا صَبَرْتَ وَٱحْتَسَبْتَ وَأَعَنْتَ
فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَىٰ ٱلدَّارِ
لَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ قَتَلَكَ
وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ جَهِلَ حَقَّكَ
وَٱسْتَخَفَّ بِحُرْمَتِكَ
وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ حَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مَاءِ ٱلْفُرَاتِ
أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قُتِلْتَ مَظْلُوماً
وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُنْجِزٌ لَكُمْ مَا وَعَدَكُمْ
جِئْتُكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلُمْؤْمِنينَ وَافِداً إِلَيْكُمْ
وَقَلْبِي مُسَلِّمٌ لَكُمْ وَتَابِعٌ
وَأَنَا لَكُمْ تَابِعٌ
وَنُصْرَتِي لَكُمْ مُعَدَّةٌ
حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ
وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَاكِمِينَ
فَمَعَكُمْ مَعَكُمْ
لاَ مَعَ عَدُوِّكُمْ
إِنِّي بِكُمْ وَبِإِيَابِكُمْ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَبِمَنْ خَالَفَكُمْ وَقَتَلَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلْكَافَرينَ
قَتَلَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكُمْ بِٱلأَيْدِي وَٱلأَلْسُنِ
entries.translation_en:
The peace of Allah, and the peace of His near angels,
and His sent prophets,
and His righteous servants,
and all the martyrs and the truthful ones,
and the pure, blessed greetings that come in the morning and the evening, be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.
I bear witness to your submission, your affirmation,
your loyalty and your sincere counsel,
towards the successor of the sent Prophet, may Allah bless him and his Household,
the chosen grandson,
the knowledgeable guide,
the successor who conveyed (the message),
and the oppressed one whose rights were trampled.
So may Allah reward you, on behalf of His Messenger,
and on behalf of the Commander of the Faithful,
and on behalf of al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
may the blessings of Allah be upon them,
with the finest reward,
for your patience, your devotion in seeking His reward, and your support.
How excellent is the final home!
May Allah curse the one who killed you;
may Allah curse the one who was ignorant of your right
and belittled your sanctity;
and may Allah curse the one who stood between you and the water of the Euphrates.
I bear witness that you were killed wronged,
and that Allah will fulfil for you what He promised you.
I have come to you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful, as a visitor to you all;
my heart is surrendered to you and follows you;
I am a follower of yours,
and my support for you is ready,
until Allah judges,
and He is the best of judges.
So I am with you, with you,
not with your enemies.
I am among those who believe in you and in your return,
and among those who disbelieve in whoever opposed you and killed you.
May Allah destroy a people who killed you with hands and with tongues.
entries.translation_ur:
اللہ کا سلام اور اس کے مقرب فرشتوں کا سلام،
اور اس کے بھیجے ہوئے نبیوں کا،
اور اس کے نیک بندوں کا،
اور تمام شہیدوں اور صدیقوں کا،
اور وہ پاکیزہ و بابرکت سلامتیاں جو صبح و شام آتی جاتی ہیں، آپ پر ہوں، اے امیر المؤمنین کے فرزند۔
میں آپ کے لیے گواہی دیتا ہوں آپ کی فرمانبرداری، آپ کی تصدیق،
آپ کی وفاداری اور آپ کی خیرخواہی کی،
اس نبی کے جانشین کی نسبت جو بھیجے گئے، اللہ ان پر اور ان کے اہلِ بیت پر رحمتیں نازل فرمائے،
وہ برگزیدہ نواسے،
وہ باعلم رہنما،
وہ جانشین جنہوں نے (پیغام) پہنچایا،
اور وہ مظلوم جن کے حق کو پامال کیا گیا۔
پس اللہ آپ کو جزا دے، اپنے رسول کی طرف سے،
اور امیر المؤمنین کی طرف سے،
اور حسن و حسین کی طرف سے،
ان پر اللہ کی رحمتیں ہوں،
بہترین جزا کے ساتھ،
آپ کے صبر، آپ کے ثواب کی نیت سے کی گئی کوشش اور آپ کی مدد کے بدلے۔
پس (آخرت کا) گھر کتنا ہی اچھا انجام ہے!
اللہ لعنت کرے اس پر جس نے آپ کو قتل کیا؛
اللہ لعنت کرے اس پر جس نے آپ کے حق سے جہالت برتی
اور آپ کی حرمت کو ہلکا سمجھا؛
اور اللہ لعنت کرے اس پر جو آپ کے اور فرات کے پانی کے درمیان حائل ہوا۔
میں گواہی دیتا ہوں کہ آپ مظلوم قتل کیے گئے،
اور یہ کہ اللہ آپ سے کیا ہوا وعدہ ضرور پورا فرمائے گا۔
میں آپ کے پاس آیا ہوں، اے امیر المؤمنین کے فرزند، آپ سب کی زیارت کرنے والا بن کر؛
میرا دل آپ کے سپرد اور آپ کا پیروکار ہے؛
میں آپ کا تابعدار ہوں،
اور میری مدد آپ کے لیے تیار ہے،
یہاں تک کہ اللہ فیصلہ فرمائے،
اور وہ بہترین فیصلہ کرنے والا ہے۔
پس میں آپ کے ساتھ ہوں، آپ کے ساتھ ہوں،
آپ کے دشمنوں کے ساتھ نہیں۔
میں ان لوگوں میں سے ہوں جو آپ پر اور آپ کی واپسی پر ایمان رکھتے ہیں،
اور ان لوگوں میں سے ہوں جو اس کا انکار کرتے ہیں جس نے آپ کی مخالفت کی اور آپ کو قتل کیا۔
اللہ ہلاک کرے اس قوم کو جس نے آپ کو ہاتھوں اور زبانوں سے قتل کیا۔
entries.note_en: As taught by Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) in Kamil al-Ziyarat.

entries.arabic:
اَللّهُمَّ اِنّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْء، وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتي قَهَرْتَ بِها كُلَّ شَيْء، وَخَضَعَ لَها كُلُّ شَئ، وَذَلَّ لَها كُلُّ شَئ، وَبِجَبَرُوتِكَ الَّتي غَلَبْتَ بِها كُلَّ شَئ، وَبِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتي لا يَقُومُ لَها شَئٌ، وَبِعَظَمَتِكَ الَّتي مَلاََتْ كُلَّ شَئ، وَبِسُلْطانِكَ الَّذي عَلا كُلَّ شَئ، وَبِوَجْهِكَ الْباقي بَعْدَ فَناءِ كُلِّ شَئ، وَبِأَسْمائِكَ الَّتي مَلاََتْ اَرْكانَ كُلِّ شَئ، وَبِعِلْمِكَ الَّذي اَحاطَ بِكُلِّ شَئ، وَبِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذي اَضاءَ لَهُ كُلُّ شئ، يا نُورُ يا قُدُّوسُ، يا اَوَّلَ الاَْوَّلِينَ وَيا آخِرَ الاْخِرينَ، اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتي تَهْتِكُ الْعِصَمَ، اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتي تُنْزِلُ النِّقَمَ، اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتي تُغَيِّرُ النِّعَمَ، اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتي تَحْبِسُ الدُّعاءَ، اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتي تُنْزِلُ الْبَلاءَ، اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي كُلَّ ذَنْب اَذْنَبْتُهُ، وَكُلَّ خَطيئَة اَخْطَأتُها، اَللّهُمَّ اِنّي اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِذِكْرِكَ، وَاَسْتَشْفِعُ بِكَ اِلى نَفْسِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ اَنْ تُدْنِيَني مِنْ قُرْبِكَ، وَاَنْ تُوزِعَني شُكْرَكَ، وَاَنْ تُلْهِمَني ذِكْرَكَ، اَللّهُمَّ اِنّي أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤالَ خاضِع مُتَذَلِّل خاشِع اَنْ تُسامِحَني وَتَرْحَمَني وَتَجْعَلَني بِقِسْمِكَ راضِياً قانِعاً وَفي جَميعِ الاَْحْوالِ مُتَواضِعاً، اَللّهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ سُؤالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فاقَتُهُ، وَاَنْزَلَ بِكَ عِنْدَ الشَّدائِدِ حاجَتَهُ، وَعَظُمَ فيما عِنْدَكَ رَغْبَتُهُ، اَللّهُمَّ عَظُمَ سُلْطانُكَ وَعَلا مَكانُكَ وَخَفِي مَكْرُكَ وَظَهَرَ اَمْرُكَ وَغَلَبَ قَهْرُكَ وَجَرَتْ قُدْرَتُكَ وَلا يُمْكِنُ الْفِرارُ مِنْ حُكُومَتِكَ، اَللّهُمَّ لا اَجِدُ لِذُنُوبي غافِراً، وَلا لِقَبائِحي ساتِراً، وَلا لِشَئ مِنْ عَمَلِي الْقَبيحِ بِالْحَسَنِ مُبَدِّلاً غَيْرَكَ لا اِلهَ إلاّ اَنْتَ سُبْحانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسي، وَتَجَرَّأْتُ بِجَهْلي وَسَكَنْتُ اِلى قَديمِ ذِكْرِكَ لي وَمَنِّكَ عَلَيَّ، اَللّهُمَّ مَوْلاي كَمْ مِنْ قَبيح سَتَرْتَهُ وَكَمْ مِنْ فادِح مِنَ الْبَلاءِ اَقَلْتَهُ (اَمَلْتَهُ) وَكَمْ مِنْ عِثار وَقَيْتَهُ، وَكَمْ مِنْ مَكْرُوه دَفَعْتَهُ، وَكَمْ مِنْ ثَناء جَميل لَسْتُ اَهْلاً لَهُ نَشَرْتَهُ، اَللّهُمَّ عَظُمَ بَلائي وَاَفْرَطَ بي سُوءُ حالي، وَقَصُرَتْ (قَصَّرَتْ) بي اَعْمالي وَقَعَدَتْ بي اَغْلالى، وَحَبَسَني عَنْ نَفْعي بُعْدُ اَمَلي (آمالي)، وَخَدَعَتْنِي الدُّنْيا بِغُرُورِها، وَنَفْسي بِجِنايَتِها (بِخِيانَتِها) وَمِطالي يا سَيِّدي فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ اَنْ لا يَحْجُبَ عَنْكَ دُعائي سُوءُ عَمَلي وَفِعالي، وَلا تَفْضَحْني بِخَفِي مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سِرّى، وَلا تُعاجِلْني بِالْعُقُوبَةِ عَلى ما عَمِلْتُهُ في خَلَواتي مِنْ سُوءِ فِعْلي وَإساءَتي وَدَوامِ تَفْريطي وَجَهالَتي وَكَثْرَةِ شَهَواتي وَغَفْلَتي، وَكُنِ اللّهُمَّ بِعِزَّتِكَ لي في كُلِّ الاَْحْوالِ (فِي الاَْحْوالِ كُلِّها) رَؤوفاً وَعَلَي في جَميعِ الاُْمُورِ عَطُوفاً اِلهي وَرَبّي مَنْ لي غَيْرُكَ أَسْأَلُهُ كَشْفَ ضُرّي وَالنَّظَرَ في اَمْري، اِلهي وَمَوْلاي اَجْرَيْتَ عَلَي حُكْماً اِتَّبَعْتُ فيهِ هَوى نَفْسي وَلَمْ اَحْتَرِسْ فيهِ مِنْ تَزْيينِ عَدُوّي، فَغَرَّني بِما اَهْوى وَاَسْعَدَهُ عَلى ذلِكَ الْقَضاءُ فَتَجاوَزْتُ بِما جَرى عَلَي مِنْ ذلِكَ بَعْضَ حُدُودِكَ، وَخالَفْتُ بَعْضَ اَوامِرِكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ (اَلْحُجَّةُ) عَلي في جَميعِ ذلِكَ وَلا حُجَّةَ لي فيما جَرى عَلَيَّ فيهِ قَضاؤُكَ وَاَلْزَمَني حُكْمُكَ وَبَلاؤُكَ، وَقَدْ اَتَيْتُكَ يا اِلهي بَعْدَ تَقْصيري وَاِسْرافي عَلى نَفْسي مُعْتَذِراً نادِماً مُنْكَسِراً مُسْتَقيلاً مُسْتَغْفِراً مُنيباً مُقِرّاً مُذْعِناً مُعْتَرِفاً لا اَجِدُ مَفَرّاً مِمّا كانَ مِنّي وَلا مَفْزَعاً اَتَوَجَّهُ اِلَيْهِ في اَمْري غَيْرَ قَبُولِكَ عُذْري وَاِدْخالِكَ اِيّايَ في سَعَة (مِنْ) رَحْمَتِكَ
اَللّهُمَّ (اِلهي) فَاقْبَلْ عُذْري وَارْحَمْ شِدَّةَ ضُرّي وَفُكَّني مِنْ شَدِّ وَثاقي، يا رَبِّ ارْحَمْ ضَعْفَ بَدَني وَرِقَّةَ جِلْدي وَدِقَّةَ عَظْمي، يا مَنْ بَدَأَ خَلْقي وَذِكْري وَتَرْبِيَتي وَبِرّى وَتَغْذِيَتي هَبْني لاِبْتِداءِ كَرَمِكَ وَسالِفِ بِرِّكَ بي يا اِلهي وَسَيِّدي وَرَبّي، اَتُراكَ مُعَذِّبي بِنارِكَ بَعْدَ تَوْحيدِكَ وَبَعْدَ مَا انْطَوى عَلَيْهِ قَلْبي مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِكَ وَلَهِجَ بِهِ لِساني مِنْ ذِكْرِكَ، وَاعْتَقَدَهُ ضَميري مِنْ حُبِّكَ، وَبَعْدَ صِدْقِ اعْتِرافي وَدُعائي خاضِعاً لِرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ، هَيْهاتَ اَنْتَ اَكْرَمُ مِنْ اَنْ تُضَيِّعَ مَنْ رَبَّيْتَهُ اَوْ تُبْعِدَ (تُبَعِّدَ) مَنْ اَدْنَيْتَهُ اَوْ تُشَرِّدَ مَنْ اوَيْتَهُ اَوْ تُسَلِّمَ اِلَى الْبَلاءِ مَنْ كَفَيْتَهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ، وَلَيْتَ شِعْرى يا سَيِّدي وَاِلهي وَمَوْلايَ اَتُسَلِّطُ النّارَ عَلى وُجُوه خَرَّتْ لِعَظَمَتِكَ ساجِدَةً، وَعَلى اَلْسُن نَطَقَتْ بِتَوْحيدِكَ صادِقَةً، وَبِشُكْرِكَ مادِحَةً، وَعَلى قُلُوب اعْتَرَفَتْ بِاِلهِيَّتِكَ مُحَقِّقَةً، وَعَلى ضَمائِرَ حَوَتْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ بِكَ حَتّى صارَتْ خاشِعَةً، وَعَلى جَوارِحَ سَعَتْ اِلى اَوْطانِ تَعَبُّدِكَ طائِعَةً وَاَشارَتْ بِاسْتِغْفارِكَ مُذْعِنَةً، ما هكَذَا الظَّنُّ بِكَ وَلا اُخْبِرْنا بِفَضْلِكَ عَنْكَ يا كَريمُ يا رَبِّ وَاَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفي عَنْ قَليل مِنْ بَلاءِ الدُّنْيا وَعُقُوباتِها وَما يَجْري فيها مِنَ الْمَكارِهِ عَلى اَهْلِها، عَلى اَنَّ ذلِكَ بَلاءٌ وَمَكْرُوهٌ قَليلٌ مَكْثُهُ، يَسيرٌ بَقاؤُهُ، قَصيرٌ مُدَّتُهُ فَكَيْفَ احْتِمالي لِبَلاءِ الاْخِرَةِ وَجَليلِ (حُلُولِ) وُقُوعِ الْمَكارِهِ فيها وَهُوَ بَلاءٌ تَطُولُ مُدَّتُهُ وَيَدُومُ مَقامُهُ وَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْ اَهْلِهِ لاَِنَّهُ لا يَكُونُ إلاّ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ وَاْنتِقامِكَ وَسَخَطِكَ، وَهذا ما لا تَقُومُ لَهُ السَّماواتُ وَالاَْرْضُ يا سَيِّدِي فَكَيْفَ لي (بي) وَاَنَا عَبْدُكَ الضَّعيفُ الذَّليلُ الْحَقيرُ الْمِسْكينُ الْمُسْتَكينُ، يا اِلهي وَرَبّي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلايَ لاَِيِّ الاُْمُورِ اِلَيْكَ اَشْكُو وَلِما مِنْها اَضِجُّ وَاَبْكي لاَِليمِ الْعَذابِ وَشِدَّتِهِ، اَمْ لِطُولِ الْبَلاءِ وَمُدَّتِهِ، فَلَئِنْ صَيَّرْتَنى لِلْعُقُوباتِ مَعَ اَعْدائِكَ وَجَمَعْتَ بَيْني وَبَيْنَ اَهْلِ بَلائِكَ وَفَرَّقْتَ بَيْني وَبَيْنَ اَحِبّائِكَ وَاَوْليائِكَ، فَهَبْني يا اِلهى وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلايَ وَرَبّي صَبَرْتُ عَلى عَذابِكَ فَكَيْفَ اَصْبِرُ عَلى فِراقِكَ، وَهَبْني (يا اِلهي) صَبَرْتُ عَلى حَرِّ نارِكَ فَكَيْفَ اَصْبِرُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ اِلى كَرامَتِكَ اَمْ كَيْفَ اَسْكُنُ فِي النّارِ وَرَجائي عَفْوُكَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ يا سَيِّدى وَمَوْلايَ اُقْسِمُ صادِقاً لَئِنْ تَرَكْتَني ناطِقاً لاَِضِجَّنَّ اِلَيْكَ بَيْنَ اَهْلِها ضَجيجَ الاْمِلينَ (الاْلِمينَ) وَلاََصْرُخَنَّ اِلَيْكَ صُراخَ الْمَسْتَصْرِخينَ، وَلاََبْكِيَنَّ عَلَيْكَ بُكاءَ الْفاقِدينَ، وَلاَُنادِيَنَّكَ اَيْنَ كُنْتَ يا وَلِيَّ الْمُؤْمِنينَ، يا غايَةَ آمالِ الْعارِفينَ، يا غِياثَ الْمُسْتَغيثينَ، يا حَبيبَ قُلُوبِ الصّادِقينَ، وَيا اِلهَ الْعالَمينَ، اَفَتُراكَ سُبْحانَكَ يا اِلهى وَبِحَمْدِكَ تَسْمَعُ فيها صَوْتَ عَبْد مُسْلِم سُجِنَ (يُسْجَنُ) فيها بِمُخالَفَتِهِ، وَذاقَ طَعْمَ عَذابِها بِمَعْصِيَتِهِ وَحُبِسَ بَيْنَ اَطْباقِها بِجُرْمِهِ وَجَريرَتِهِ وَهُوَ يَضِجُّ اِلَيْكَ ضَجيجَ مُؤَمِّل لِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَيُناديكَ بِلِسانِ اَهْلِ تَوْحيدِكَ، وَيَتَوَسَّلُ اِلَيْكَ بِرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ، يا مَوْلايَ فَكَيْفَ يَبْقى فِي الْعَذابِ وَهُوَ يَرْجُو ما سَلَفَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ، اَمْ كَيْفَ تُؤْلِمُهُ النّارُ وَهُوَ يَأْملُ فَضْلَكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ اَمْ كَيْفَ يُحْرِقُهُ لَهيبُها وَاَنْتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَتَرى مَكانَه اَمْ كَيْفَ يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَفيرُها وَاَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفَهُ، اَمْ كَيْفَ يَتَقَلْقَلُ بَيْنَ اَطْباقِها وَاَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ صِدْقَهُ، اَمْ كَيْفَ تَزْجُرُهُ زَبانِيَتُها وَهُوَ يُناديكَ يا رَبَّهُ، اَمْ كَيْفَ يَرْجُو فَضْلَكَ في عِتْقِهِ مِنْها فَتَتْرُكُهُ فيها هَيْهاتَ ما ذلِكَ الظَّنُ بِكَ وَلاَ الْمَعْرُوفُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَلا مُشْبِهٌ لِما عامَلْتَ بِهِ الْمُوَحِّدينَ مِنْ بِرِّكَ وَاِحْسانِكَ، فَبِالْيَقينِ اَقْطَعُ لَوْ لا ما حَكَمْتَ بِهِ مِنْ تَعْذيبِ جاحِديكَ، وَقَضَيْتَ بِهِ مِنْ اِخْلادِ مُعانِدِيكَ لَجَعَلْتَ النّارَ كُلَّها بَرْداً وَسَلاماً وَما كانَت لاَِحَد فيها مَقَرّاً وَلا مُقاماً لكِنَّكَ تَقَدَّسَتْ اَسْماؤُكَ اَقْسَمْتَ اَنْ تَمْلاََها مِنَ الْكافِرينَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنّاسِ اَجْمَعينَ، وَاَنْ تُخَلِّدَ فيهَا الْمُعانِدينَ وَاَنْتَ جَلَّ ثَناؤُكَ قُلْتَ مُبْتَدِئاً، وَتَطَوَّلْتَ بِالاًِنْعامِ مُتَكَرِّماً اَفَمَنْ كانَ مُؤْمِناً كَمَنْ كانَ فاسِقاً لا يَسْتَوُونَ، اِلهى وَسَيِّدى فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتى قَدَّرْتَها، وَبِالْقَضِيَّةِ الَّتي حَتَمْتَها وَحَكَمْتَها وَغَلَبْتَ مَنْ عَلَيْهِ اَجْرَيْتَها اَنْ تَهَبَ لى في هذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَفي هذِهِ السّاعَةِ كُلَّ جُرْم اَجْرَمْتُهُ، وَكُلَّ ذَنْب اَذْنَبْتُهُ، وَكُلَّ قَبِيح اَسْرَرْتُهُ، وَكُلَّ جَهْل عَمِلْتُهُ، كَتَمْتُهُ اَوْ اَعْلَنْتُهُ اَخْفَيْتُهُ اَوْ اَظْهَرْتُهُ، وَكُلَّ سَيِّئَة اَمَرْتَ بِاِثْباتِهَا الْكِرامَ الْكاتِبينَ الَّذينَ وَكَّلْتَهُمْ بِحِفْظِ ما يَكُونُ مِنّي وَجَعَلْتَهُمْ شُهُوداً عَلَيَّ مَعَ جَوارِحي، وَكُنْتَ اَنْتَ الرَّقيبَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ وَرائِهِمْ، وَالشّاهِدَ لِما خَفِيَ عَنْهُمْ، وَبِرَحْمَتِكَ اَخْفَيْتَهُ، وَبِفَضْلِكَ سَتَرْتَهُ، وَاَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظّي مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْر اَنْزَلْتَهُ (تُنَزِّلُهُ) اَوْ اِحْسان فَضَّلْتَهُ اَوْ بِرٍّ نَشَرْتَهُ (تَنْشُرُهُ) اَوْ رِزْق بَسَطْتَهُ (تَبْسُطُهُ) اَوْ ذَنْب تَغْفِرُهُ اَوْ خَطَأ تَسْتُرُهُ، يا رَبِّ يا رَبِّ يا رَبِّ يا اِلهي وَسَيِّدي وَمَوْلايَ وَمالِكَ رِقّى، يا مَنْ بِيَدِهِ ناصِيَتى يا عَليماً بِضُرّى (بِفَقْرى) وَمَسْكَنَتى، يا خَبيراً بِفَقْرى وَفاقَتى يا رَبِّ يا رَبِّ يا رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ وَقُدْسِكَ وَاَعْظَمِ صِفاتِكَ وَاَسْمائِكَ اَنْ تَجْعَلَ اَوْقاتي مِنَ (فِي) اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهارِ بِذِكْرِكَ مَعْمُورَةً، وَبِخِدْمَتِكَ مَوْصُولَةً، وَاَعْمالى عِنْدَكَ مَقْبُولَةً حَتّى تَكُونَ اَعْمالي وَاَوْرادى (وَاِرادَتي) كُلُّها وِرْداً واحِداً وَحالى في خِدْمَتِكَ سَرْمَداً، يا سَيِّدي يا مَنْ عَلَيْهِ مُعَوَّلي يا مَنْ اِلَيْهِ شَكَوْتُ اَحْوالي يا رَبِّ يا رَبِّ يا رَبِّ، قَوِّ عَلى خِدْمَتِكَ جَوارِحى وَاشْدُدْ عَلَى الْعَزيمَةِ جَوانِحي وَهَبْ لِيَ الْجِدَّ في خَشْيَتِكَ، وَالدَّوامَ فِي الاِْتِّصالِ بِخِدْمَتِكَ، حَتّى اَسْرَحَ اِلَيْكَ في مَيادينِ السّابِقينَ وَاُسْرِعَ اِلَيْكَ فِي الْبارِزينَ (الْمُبادِرينَ) وَاَشْتاقَ اِلى قُرْبِكَ فِي الْمُشْتاقينَ وَاَدْنُوَ مِنْكَ دُنُوَّ الُْمخْلِصينَ، وَاَخافَكَ مَخافَةَ الْمُوقِنينَ، وَاَجْتَمِعَ في جِوارِكَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنينَ، اَللّهُمَّ وَمَنْ اَرادَني بِسُوء فَاَرِدْهُ وَمَنْ كادَني فَكِدْهُ، وَاجْعَلْني مِنْ اَحْسَنِ عَبيدِكَ نَصيباً عِنْدَكَ، وَاَقْرَبِهِمْ مَنْزِلَةً مِنْكَ، وَاَخَصِّهِمْ زُلْفَةً لَدَيْكَ، فَاِنَّهُ لا يُنالُ ذلِكَ إلاّ بِفَضْلِكَ، وَجُدْ لي بِجُودِكَ وَاعْطِفْ عَلَيَّ بِمَجْدِكَ وَاحْفَظْني بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَاجْعَلْ لِسانى بِذِكْرِكَ لَهِجَاً وَقَلْبي بِحُبِّكَ مُتَيَّماً وَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِحُسْنِ اِجابَتِكَ، وَاَقِلْني عَثْرَتي وَاغْفِرْ زَلَّتي، فَاِنَّكَ قَضَيْتَ عَلى عِبادِكَ بِعِبادَتِكَ، وَاَمَرْتَهُمْ بِدُعائِكَ، وَضَمِنْتَ لَهُمُ الاِْجابَةَ، فَاِلَيْكَ يا رَبِّ نَصَبْتُ وَجْهي وَاِلَيْكَ يا رَبِّ مَدَدْتُ يَدي، فَبِعِزَّتِكَ اسْتَجِبْ لي دُعائي وَبَلِّغْني مُنايَ وَلا تَقْطَعْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ رَجائي، وَاكْفِني شَرَّ الْجِنِّ وَالاِْنْسِ مِنْ اَعْدائي، يا سَريعَ الرِّضا اِغْفِرْ لِمَنْ لا يَمْلِكُ إلاّ الدُّعاءَ فَاِنَّكَ فَعّالٌ لِما تَشاءُ، يا مَنِ اسْمُهُ دَواءٌ وَذِكْرُهُ شِفاءٌ وَطاعَتُهُ غِنىً، اِرْحَمْ مَنْ رَأْسُ مالِهِ الرَّجاءُ وَسِلاحُهُ الْبُكاءُ، يا سابِغَ النِّعَمِ، يا دافِعَ النِّقَمِ، يا نُورَ الْمُسْتَوْحِشينَ فِي الظُّلَمِ، يا عالِماً لا يُعَلَّمُ، صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد وَافْعَلْ بي ما اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلى رَسُولِهِ وَالاَْئِمَّةِ الْمَيامينَ مِنْ آلِهِ (اَهْلِهِ) وَسَلَّمَ تَسْليماً كَثيراً.
entries.translation_en:
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which embraces all things; by Your power through which You have subdued all things, before which all things have humbled themselves and to which all things have submitted; by Your might through which You have overcome all things; by Your glory before which nothing can stand; by Your greatness which has filled all things; by Your sovereignty which has risen above all things; by Your Face, which remains after the annihilation of all things; by Your Names which have filled the foundations of all things; by Your knowledge which encompasses all things; and by the light of Your Face through which all things are illuminated. O Light! O Holy One! O First of the first ones and O Last of the last ones!
O Allah, forgive me the sins that tear apart the safeguards. O Allah, forgive me the sins that bring down punishments. O Allah, forgive me the sins that change blessings. O Allah, forgive me the sins that hold back supplication. O Allah, forgive me the sins that bring down affliction. O Allah, forgive me every sin I have committed and every wrong I have done.
O Allah, I draw near to You through Your remembrance, I seek Your intercession with Yourself, and I ask You by Your generosity to bring me near to Your proximity, to grant me gratitude to You, and to inspire me with Your remembrance.
O Allah, I ask You with the asking of one submissive, abased and humble: pardon me, have mercy on me, and make me content and satisfied with my allotted share, and humble in all states.
O Allah, I ask You with the asking of one whose poverty has become intense, who has laid his need before You in hardships, and whose longing for what is with You has become great.
O Allah, mighty is Your reign, exalted is Your station, hidden is Your plan, manifest is Your command, overpowering is Your force, flowing is Your power, and escape from Your government is impossible; there is no refuge from You except in You, and no salvation from You except through You. You wrong no one, and You are not pleased with wrongdoing. Whoever asks You, You give him; whoever calls You, You answer him; whoever turns to You in repentance, You accept him; and whoever disobeys You, You give him respite. Whoever disobeys You, You conceal him; and whoever turns away, You call him from near.
O Allah, do not make me, through my wretchedness, the most wretched of those who disobey You, and do not expose me to what You have warned against. O Allah, do not deprive me of the good that is with You because of the evil that is with me; and if You do not answer my prayer, then do not withhold Your forgiveness; and if You do not forgive me, then do not distance the fulfilment of my hope. O Allah, let Your generosity be too great to punish me, and let Your clemency be too great to distance me.
O Allah, I ask You for patience, and I ask You for relief from every hardship. O Allah, I ask You to protect me from the evil of what comes out by night and what settles by day, from the evil of what You have created, apportioned and originated, and from the evil of Satan, the accursed, and the evil of the unjust ruler, and the evil of my own soul, and the evil of every creature whose forelock You hold. Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path.
O Allah, the sins have clothed me in the garment of my humiliation; separation from You has covered me in the clothing of my destitution; my crimes have deadened my heart, so revive it with a repentance from You. O my hope and my desire, O my request and my wish! By Your glory, I find no one to forgive my sins but You, and I see no one to mend my brokenness but You. I have submitted to You in penitence, I have humbled myself before You in abasement; so if You drive me from Your door, in whom shall I seek refuge? And if You turn me away from Your side, in whom shall I seek protection? O my sorrow at my shame and my disgrace! O my grief at my evil deeds and what I have committed!
I ask You, O Forgiver of the great sin, O Mender of the broken bone: forgive my destructive, ruinous sins, and conceal my disgraceful hidden faults; do not leave me bare, on the plain of the Resurrection, of the coolness of Your pardon and Your forgiveness; and do not strip me of the beautiful covering of Your concealment.
O Allah, shade me with Your mercy, send down upon me the abundance of Your blessings, and cover me with the cover of Your protection. O Allah, I ask You to lift from me every veil between me and You. O Allah, do not test me in this world, and do not expose me on the Day when secrets are laid bare.
O my God, by Your glory and Your might, I do not wish my disobedience to oppose You; and when I am heedless of Your watchfulness, I do not find safety from Your punishment. O Allah, correct the corruption of my heart, and make the fear of You the provision of my soul. My God, how can I despair of Your goodly governance of me after my repentance, when You have not withheld from me Your beautiful protection in my disobedience?
O Allah, if the term has drawn near and my deeds have not brought me close to You, I have made confession of my sin my means towards You; so if You pardon, who is worthier of that than You? And if You punish, who is more just than You in judgement?
Have mercy, in this world, on my estrangement; at death, on my loneliness; in the grave, on my solitude; at the standing, on my neediness; and on the Day when I am raised for reckoning, on a station where there is no intercessor to avail me with You. O Allah, I ask You to let me enjoy the hearing of the announcement of Your pardon; admit me to the abode of Your honour; and protect me from the disgrace of estrangement from You.
O Allah, if an evil deed is recorded against me, then let not Your knowledge of my confession make me despair of Your pardon; and if You have recorded against me persistent sinning, then I have known, in my turning, that there is no way out for me except through Your pardon and Your forgiveness.
O Allah, You know my weakness despite Your knowledge of my disobedience; and You know my powerlessness despite Your witnessing of my intention. So do not burn this weak body with the Fire, being unable to bear it; and do not punish this lowly self with the punishment, being unable to endure it; and do not leave me in the narrow abode, alone and estranged.
O Allah, forgive me that which no creature can forgive. O Allah, do not disgrace me on the day I am sent to my family and my children. O Allah, do not make this my last covenant of confidential prayer with You; and if it is, then make me among the pardoned, not among the deprived.
O Allah, this praise belongs to You, perpetually, everlastingly, increasing and never decreasing, as You love and as You are pleased. O Allah, if You take me to task for my crimes, I will take You to task for Your pardon; if You take me to task for my sins, I will take You to task for Your forgiveness; and if You enter me into the Fire, I will inform its inhabitants that I love You.
O Allah, if my deed is small beside the reality of Your obedience, then my hope is great beside the reality of my expectation of You. O Allah, how shall I turn away from You, deprived, when You have so generously guaranteed the return of the stranger? O Allah, my lifetime has wasted away in the heedlessness of forgetting You, and my youth has worn out in the drunkenness of distance from You. O Allah, I did not wake when You granted me (time), nor did I give up the paths of disobedience towards You; so how do I now despair of Your generosity, when I have not deserved anything but it?
O Allah, I am a servant who keeps returning to You, excusing himself; so accept my excuse. I have come to You, apologising, regretful, broken, humble, seeking forgiveness, penitent, acknowledging, confessing, admitting; I find no escape from what I have done, and no refuge to which I can turn in my affair, except that You accept my excuse and admit me into the expanse of Your vast mercy.
O Allah, so accept my excuse, have mercy on the intensity of my harm, and release me from the tightness of my bonds. O Lord, have mercy on the weakness of my body, the thinness of my skin and the delicacy of my bones. O He who began my creation, my mention, my upbringing, my well-being and my nourishment: grant me (now) as You did at my beginning, by Your generosity and Your earlier goodness to me.
O Allah, O my God, my Master and my Lord: will You punish me with Your Fire after Your Oneness (which I profess), after what my heart has embraced of knowledge of You, what my tongue has uttered of Your remembrance, what my conscience has held firm of love for You, and after the truthfulness of my confession and my supplication, humbled before Your lordship? Far be it from You! You are too generous to waste one whom You have raised; to distance one whom You have brought near; to drive away one whom You have sheltered; or to surrender to affliction one whom You have sufficed and shown mercy.
Would that I knew, O my Master, my God and my Lord: will You make the Fire prevail over faces that have fallen prostrate before Your greatness, over tongues that have uttered Your Oneness truthfully and thanked You, and over hearts that have acknowledged Your divinity in certainty? Or will You make it prevail over bodies that weakness has worn down in worship of You until they grew thin, and over limbs that went back and forth between the places of prostration to You and the places of standing before You? Far be it from You, and that is not what is expected of You, nor what has been told of Your grace, O Generous One!
O Allah, strengthen the weakness of my body for Your service; fortify my heart with resolve for Your intentions; and grant me earnestness in the fear of You and constancy in joining what I hope of service to You, so that I may march towards You in the arenas of the foremost, race to You among those who rush, yearn eagerly towards You among the yearning, draw near to You with the nearness of the sincere, fear You with the fear of those who are certain, and gather with the believers in Your vicinity.
O Allah, whoever intends me harm, intend him; and whoever plots against me, plot against him; and make me among the best of Your servants in share of You, the nearest of them in station to You, and the most particular of them in rank with You; for that is attained only by Your grace. Bestow on me, by Your generosity, and incline towards me with Your glory, and protect me by Your mercy. Make my tongue constant in Your remembrance, my heart captivated by Your love, and be gracious to me by Your good answer; slip away my stumble, and overlook my lapse.
Indeed, You have decreed upon Your servants that they worship You, and You have commanded them to call upon You, and You have guaranteed them the answer. So towards You, O Lord, I have set my face, and towards You, O Lord, I have stretched out my hand. By Your glory, answer my prayer, bring me to my desire, and do not cut off my hope from Your grace; and suffice me against the evil of my enemies, from jinn and mankind.
O Swift to be pleased! Forgive the one who possesses nothing but supplication, for You do whatever You will. O He whose Name is a remedy, whose remembrance is a cure, and whose obedience is wealth: have mercy on the one whose capital is hope and whose weapon is weeping. O Pourer of blessings, O Repeller of afflictions, O Light of those who feel lonely in the darknesses, O Knower who is not taught: send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and do with me what You are worthy of; and may Allah bless His Messenger and the blessed Imams from his Household, and grant them abundant peace.
entries.note_en: Taught by Imam Ali (a.s.) to Kumayl ibn Ziyad; recited on Thursday nights and on the night of mid-Sha'ban.

entries.translation_en:
O Allah, I ask You and I turn to You through Your Prophet, the Prophet of mercy, Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household.
O Aba al-Qasim! O Messenger of Allah! O Imam of mercy!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba al-Hasan! O Commander of the Faithful! O Ali ibn Abi Talib! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Fatimah al-Zahra! O daughter of Muhammad! O delight of the eye of the Messenger! O our mistress and our lady! — (refrain in the feminine:) O our mistress and our lady! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba Muhammad! O Hasan ibn Ali! O the Chosen One! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba Abdillah! O Husayn ibn Ali! O the Martyr! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba al-Hasan! O Ali ibn al-Husayn! O Zayn al-Abidin! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba Ja'far! O Muhammad ibn Ali! O the one who split open the knowledge of Allah! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba Abdillah! O Ja'far ibn Muhammad! O the Truthful One! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba al-Hasan! O Musa ibn Ja'far! O the one who restrains (his anger)! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba al-Hasan! O Ali ibn Musa! O the Well-Pleased One! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba Ja'far! O Muhammad ibn Ali! O the God-fearing, the Generous One! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba al-Hasan! O Ali ibn Muhammad! O the Guide, the Pure One! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O Aba Muhammad! O Hasan ibn Ali! O the Pure, al-Askari! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O successor of al-Hasan and the succeeding Proof! O the Awaited Rising One, al-Mahdi! O son of the Messenger of Allah! O proof of Allah over His creation!
O our master and our lord! We have turned towards you, sought your intercession, and taken you as our means to Allah, and we have placed you before our needs. O one held in honour with Allah, intercede for us with Allah.
O my masters and my lords! I have turned through you — my Imams and my provision for the day of my poverty and my need — to Allah; I have taken you as my means to Allah and sought your intercession with Allah, so intercede for me with Allah, and rescue me from my sins with Allah; for you are my means to Allah, and through love of you and nearness to you I hope for salvation from Allah. So be, with Allah, my hope, O my masters, O friends of Allah! May Allah bless them all, and may Allah curse the enemies of Allah who wronged them, from the first and the last. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
entries.translation_ur:
اے اللہ! میں تجھ سے سوال کرتا ہوں اور تیری طرف رخ کرتا ہوں تیرے نبی، نبیِ رحمت، محمد کے وسیلے سے، اللہ ان پر اور ان کے اہلِ بیت پر رحمتیں نازل فرمائے۔
اے ابا القاسم! اے رسول اللہ! اے امامِ رحمت!
اے ہمارے آقا اور ہمارے مولا! ہم نے آپ کی طرف رخ کیا، آپ کی شفاعت طلب کی، اور آپ کو اللہ کی طرف وسیلہ بنایا، اور ہم نے آپ کو اپنی حاجتوں کے سامنے پیش کیا۔ اے اللہ کے حضور باعزت ہستی، اللہ کے حضور ہماری شفاعت فرمائیے۔
اے ابا الحسن! اے امیر المؤمنین! اے علی بن ابی طالب! اے اللہ کی اس کی مخلوق پر حجت!
اے ہمارے آقا اور ہمارے مولا! ہم نے آپ کی طرف رخ کیا، آپ کی شفاعت طلب کی، اور آپ کو اللہ کی طرف وسیلہ بنایا، اور ہم نے آپ کو اپنی حاجتوں کے سامنے پیش کیا۔ اے اللہ کے حضور باعزت ہستی، اللہ کے حضور ہماری شفاعت فرمائیے۔
اے فاطمہ زہرا! اے محمد کی صاحبزادی! اے رسول کی آنکھ کی ٹھنڈک! اے ہماری سیدہ اور ہماری ملکہ! — (مؤنث صیغے کے ساتھ التجا:) اے ہماری سیدہ اور ہماری ملکہ! ہم نے آپ کی طرف رخ کیا، آپ کی شفاعت طلب کی، اور آپ کو اللہ کی طرف وسیلہ بنایا، اور ہم نے آپ کو اپنی حاجتوں کے سامنے پیش کیا۔ اے اللہ کے حضور باعزت ہستی، اللہ کے حضور ہماری شفاعت فرمائیے۔
اے ابا محمد! اے حسن بن علی! اے مجتبیٰ! اے رسول اللہ کے فرزند! اے اللہ کی اس کی مخلوق پر حجت!
اے ہمارے آقا اور ہمارے مولا! ہم نے آپ کی طرف رخ کیا، آپ کی شفاعت طلب کی، اور آپ کو اللہ کی طرف وسیلہ بنایا، اور ہم نے آپ کو اپنی حاجتوں کے سامنے پیش کیا۔ اے اللہ کے حضور باعزت ہستی، اللہ کے حضور ہماری شفاعت فرمائیے۔

اے میرے آقاؤ اور میرے مولاؤ! میں نے آپ کے وسیلے سے — جو میرے ائمہ ہیں اور میری محتاجی اور ضرورت کے دن کا سہارا ہیں — اللہ کی طرف رخ کیا ہے؛ میں نے آپ کو اللہ کی طرف وسیلہ بنایا اور اللہ کے حضور آپ کی شفاعت طلب کی، پس اللہ کے حضور میری شفاعت فرمائیے، اور اللہ کے حضور مجھے میرے گناہوں سے نجات دلائیے؛ کیونکہ آپ ہی اللہ کی طرف میرا وسیلہ ہیں، اور آپ کی محبت اور آپ کے قرب کے سبب مجھے اللہ سے نجات کی امید ہے۔ پس اللہ کے حضور میری امید بن جائیے، اے میرے آقاؤ، اے اللہ کے ولیو! اللہ ان سب پر رحمتیں نازل فرمائے، اور اللہ لعنت فرمائے اللہ کے ان دشمنوں پر جنہوں نے ان پر ظلم کیا، اولین اور آخرین میں سے۔ آمین، اے جہانوں کے پروردگار۔
entries.note_en: Seeking intercession with Allah through the Prophet and the Fourteen Infallibles, peace be upon them all.

entries.arabic:
اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ
عَلَىٰ مَا جَرَىٰ بِهِ قَضَاؤُكَ
فِي اوْلِيَائِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَخْلَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ وَدِينِكَ
إِِذِ ٱخْتَرْتَ لَهُمْ جَزِيلَ مَا عِنْدَكَ
مِنَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ٱلْمُقِيمِ
ٱلَّذِي لاََ زَوَالَ لَهُ وَلاَ ٱضْمِحْلاَلَ
بَعْدَ انْ شَرَطْتَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلزُّهْدَ
فِي دَرَجَاتِ هٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ٱلدَّنِيَّةِ
وَزُخْرُفِهَا وَزِبْرِجِهَا
فَشَرَطُوٱ لَكَ ذٰلِكَ
وَعَلِمْتَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْوَفَاءَ بِهِ
فَقَبِلْتَهُمْ وَقَرَّبْتَهُمْ
وَقَدَّمْتَ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ ٱلْعَلِيَّ
وَٱلثَّنَاءَ ٱلْجَلِيَّ
وَاهْبَطْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مَلاَئِكَتَكَ
وَكَرَّمْتَهُمْ بِوَحْيِكَ
وَرَفَدْتَهُمْ بِعِلْمِكَ
وَجَعَلْتَهُمُ ٱلذَّرِيعَةَ إِِلَيْكَ
وَٱلْوَسِيلَةَ إِلَىٰ رِضْوَانِكَ
فَبَعْضٌ اسْكَنْتَهُ جَنَّتَكَ
إِلَىٰ انْ اخْرَجْتَهُ مِنْهَا
وَبَعْضٌ حَمَلْتَهُ فِي فُلْكِكَ
وَنَجَّيْتَهُ وَمَنْ آمَنَ مَعَهُ
مِنَ ٱلْهَلَكَةِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
وَبَعْضٌ ٱتَّخَذْتَهُ لِنَفْسِكَ خَلِيلاًَ
وَسَالَكَ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ فَاجَبْتَهُ
وَجَعَلْتَ ذٰلِكَ عَلِيّاً
وَبَعْضٌ كَلَّمْتَهُ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ تَكْلِيماً
وَجَعَلْتَ لَهُ مِنْ اخِيهِ رِدْءاً وَوَزِيراً
وَبَعْضٌ اوْلَدْتَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِ ابٍ
وَآتَيْتَهُ ٱلْبَيِّنَاتِ
وَايَّدْتَهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ
وَكُلٌّ شَرَعْتَ لَهُ شَرِيعَةً
وَنَهَجْتَ لَهُ مِنْهَاجاً
وَتَخَيَّرْتَ لَهُ اوْصِيَاءَ
مُسْتَحْفِظاً بَعْدَ مُسْتَحْفِظٍ
مِنْ مُدَّةٍ إِلَىٰ مُدَّةٍ
إِِقَامَةً لِدِينِكَ
وَحُجَّةً عَلَىٰ عِبَادِكَ
وَلِئَلاَّ يَزُولَ ٱلْحَقُّ عَنْ مَقَرِّهِ
وَيَغْلِبَ ٱلْبَاطِلُ عَلَىٰ اهْلِهِ
وَلاَ يَقُولَ احَدٌ
لَوْ لاَ ارْسَلْتَ إِِلَيْنَا رَسُولاًَ مُنْذِراً
وَاقَمْتَ لَنَا عَلَماً هَادِياً
فَنَتَّبِعَ آيَاتِكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ انْ نَذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
إِلَىٰ انِ ٱنْتَهَيْتَ بِٱلامْرِ إِلَىٰ حَبِيبِكَ وَنَجِيبِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ
صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
فَكَانَ كَمَا ٱنْتَجَبْتَهُ
سَيِّدَ مَنْ خَلَقْتَهُ
وَصَفْوَةَ مَنِ ٱصْطَفَيْتَهُ
وَافْضَلَ مَنِ ٱجْتَبَيْتَهُ
وَاكْرَمَ مَنِ ٱعْتَمَدْتَهُ
قَدَّمْتَهُ عَلَىٰ انْبِيَائِكَ
وَبَعَثْتَهُ إِِلَىٰ ٱلثَّقَلَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
وَاوْطَاتَهُ مَشَارِقَكَ وَمَغَارِبَكَ
وَسَخَّرْتَ لَهُ ٱلْبُرَاقَ
وَعَرَجْتَ بِرُوْحِهِ إِلَىٰ سَمَائِكَ
وَاوْدَعْتَهُ عِلْمَ مَا كَانَ
وَمَا يَكُونُ إِِلَىٰ ٱنْقِضَاءِ خَلْقِكَ
ثُمَّ نَصَرْتَهُ بِٱلرُّعْبِ
وَحَفَفْتَهُ بِجَبْرَئِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ
وَٱلْمُسَوِّمِينَ مِنْ مَلاَئِكَتِكَ
وَوَعَدْتَهُ انْ تُظْهِرَ دِينَهُ عَلَىٰ ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِ
وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ
وَذٰلِكَ بَعْدَ انْ بَوَّاتَهُ مُبَوَّا صِدْقٍ مِنْ اهْلِهِ
وَجَعَلْتَ لَهُ وَلَهُمْ اوَّلَ بَيْتٍ
وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذي بِبَكَّةَ
مُبَارَكاً وَهُدىًٰ لِلْعَالَمينَ
فِيهِ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ
مَقَامُ إِِبْرَاهِيمَ
وَمَنْ دَخَلَهُ كَانَ آمِناً
وَقُلْتَ «إِِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ
اهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ
وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيراً.»
ثُمَّ جَعَلْتَ اجْرَ مُحَمَّدٍ
صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
مَوَدَّتَهُمْ فِي كِتَابِكَ
فَقُلْتَ «قُلْ لاََ اسْالُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ اجْراً
إِِلاَّ ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِي ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ.»
وَقُلْتَ «مَا سَالْتُكُمْ مِنْ اجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ.»
وَقُلْتَ «مَا اسْالُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اجْرٍ
إِلاَّ مَنْ شَاءَ انْ يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلاًَ.»
فَكَانُوٱ هُمُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِِلَيْكَ
وَٱلْمَسْلَكَ إِلَىٰ رِضْوَانِكَ
فَلَمَّا ٱنْقَضَتْ ايَّامُهُ
اقَامَ وَلِيَّهُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ ابِي طَالِبٍ
صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمَا وَآلِهِمَا هَادِياً
إِِذْ كَانَ هُوَ ٱلْمُنْذِرَ
وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ
فَقَالَ وَٱلْمَلَا امَامَهُ:
”مَنْ كُنْتُ مَوْلاَهُ
فَعَلِيٌّ مَوْلاَهُ
اَللَّهُمَّ وَالِ مَنْ وَالاَهُ
وَعَادِ مَنْ عَادَاهُ
وَٱنْصُرْ مَنْ نَصَرَهُ
وَٱخْذُلْ مَنْ خَذَلَهُ.“
وَقَالَ: ”مَنْ كُنْتُ انَا نَبِيَّهُ فَعَلِيٌّ امِيرُهُ.“
وَقَالَ: ”انَا وَعَلِيٌّ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ
وَسَائِرُ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنْ شَجَرٍ شَتَّىٰ.“
وَاحَلَّهُ مَحَلَّ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَىٰ
فَقَالَ لَهُ: ”انْتَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَىٰ
إِلاَّ انَّهُ لاََ نَبِيَّ بَعْدِي.“
وَزَوَّجَهُ ٱبْنَتَهُ سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
وَاحَلَّ لَهُ مِنْ مَسْجِدِهِ مَا حَلَّ لَهُ
وَسَدَّ ٱلابْوَابَ إِِلاَّ بَابَهُ
ثُمَّ اوْدَعَهُ عِلْمَهُ وَحِكْمَتَهُ
فَقَالَ: ”انَا مَدِينَةُ ٱلْعِلْمِ
وَعَلِيٌّ بَابُهَا
فَمَنْ ارَادَ ٱلْمَدِينَةَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ
فَلْيَاتِهَا مِنْ بَابِهَا.“
ثُمَّ قَالَ: ”انْتَ اخِي وَوَصِيِّي وَوَارِثِي
لَحْمُكَ مِنْ لَحْمِي
وَدَمُكَ مِنْ دَمِي
وَسِلْمُكَ سِلْمِي
وَحَرْبُكَ حَرْبِي
وَٱلإِيمَانُ مُخَالِطٌ لَحْمَكَ وَدَمَكَ
كَمَا خَالَطَ لَحْمِي وَدَمِي
وَانْتَ غَداً عَلَىٰ الْحَوْضِ خَلِيفَتِي
وَانْتَ تَقْضِي دَيْنِي
وَتُنْجِزُ عِدَاتِي
وَشِيعَتُكَ عَلَىٰ مَنَابِرَ مِنْ نُورٍ
مُبْيَضَّةً وُجُوهُهُمْ حَوْلِي فِي ٱلْجَنَّةِ
وَهُمْ جِيرَانِي
وَلَوْلاَ انْتَ يَا عَلِيُّ
لَمْ يُعْرَفِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ بَعْدِي.“
وَكَانَ بَعْدَهُ هُدىٰ مِنَ ٱلضَّلاَلِ
وَنُوراً مِنَ ٱلْعَمَىٰ
وَحَبْلَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَتِينَ
وَصِرَاطَهُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
لاََ يُسْبَقُ بِقَرَابَةٍ فِي رَحِمٍ
وَلاَ بِسَابِقَةٍ فِي دِينٍ
وَلاَ يُلْحَقُ فِي مَنْقَبَةٍ مِنْ مَنَاقِبِهِ
يَحْذُو حَذْوَ ٱلرَّسُولِ
صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا وَآلِهِمَا
وَيُقَاتِلُ عَلَىٰ ٱلتَّاوِيلِ
وَلاَ تَاخُذُهُ فِي ٱللَّهِ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
قَدْ وَتَرَ فِيهِ صَنَادِيدَ ٱلْعَرَبِ
وَقَتَلَ ابْطَالَهُمْ
وَنَاوَشَ ذُؤْبَانَهُمْ
فَاوْدَعَ قُلُوبَهُمْ احْقَاداً
بَدْرِيَّةً وَخَيْبَرِيَّةً وَحُنَيْنِيَّةً وَغَيْرَهُنَّ
فَاضَبَّتْ عَلَىٰ عَدَاوَتِهِ
وَاكَبَّتْ عَلَىٰ مُنَابَذَتِهِ
حَتَّىٰ قَتَلَ ٱلنَّاكِثِينَ وَٱلْقَاسِطِينَ وَٱلْمَارِقِينَ
وَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُ
وَقَتَلَهُ اشْقَىٰ ٱلآخِرِينَ يَتْبَعُ اشْقَىٰ ٱلاوَّلِينَ
لَمْ يُمْتَثَلْ امْرُ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
فِي ٱلْهَادِينَ بَعْدَ ٱلْهَادِينَ
وَٱلامَّةُ مُصِرَّةٌ عَلَىٰ مَقْتِهِ
مُجْتَمِعَةٌ عَلَىٰ قَطِيعَةِ رَحِمِهِ
وَإِِقْصَاءِ وُلْدِهِ
إِِلاَّ ٱلْقَلِيلَ مِمَّنْ وَفَىٰ لِرِعَايَةِ ٱلْحَقِّ فِيهِمْ
فَقُتِلَ مَنْ قُتِلَ
وَسُبِيَ مَنْ سُبِيَ
وَاقْصِيَ مَنْ اقْصِيَ
وَجَرَىٰ ٱلْقَضَاءُ لَهُمْ
بِمَا يُرْجَىٰ لَهُ حُسْنُ ٱلْمَثُوبَةِ
إِِذْ كَانَتِ ٱلارْضُ لِلَّهِ
يُورِثُهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ
وَٱلْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
وَسُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا
إِِنْ كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولاًَ
وَلَنْ يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ
وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
فَعَلَىٰ ٱلاطَائِبِ مِنْ اهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّد وَعَلِيٍّ
صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا وَآلِهِمَا
فَلْيَبْكِ ٱلْبَاكُونَ
وَإِِيَّاهُمْ فَلْيَنْدُبِ ٱلنَّادِبُونَ
وَلِمِثْلِهِمْ فَلْتَذْرِفِ ٱلدُّمُوعُ
وَلْيَصْرُخِ ٱلصَّارِخُونَ
وَيَضِجَّ ٱلضَّاجُّونَ
وَيَعِجَّ ٱلْعَاجُّوَنَ
ايْنَ ٱلْحَسَنُ ايْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنُ
ايْنَ ابْنَاءُ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
صَالِحٌ بَعْدَ صَالِحٍ
وَصَادِقٌ بَعْدَ صَادِقٍ
ايْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلُ بَعْدَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
ايْنَ ٱلْخِيَرَةُ بَعْدَ ٱلْخِيَرَةِ
ايْنَ ٱلشُّمُوسُ ٱلطَّالِعَةُ
ايْنَ ٱلاقْمَارُ ٱلْمُنِيرَةُ
ايْنَ ٱلانْجُمُ ٱلزَّاهِرَةُ
ايْنَ اعْلاَمُ ٱلدِّينِ
وَقَوَاعِدُ ٱلْعِلْمِ

ٱلَّتِي لاََ تَخْلُو مِنَ ٱلْعِتْرَةِ ٱلْهَادِيةِ

ايْنَ ٱلْمُرْتَجىٰ لإِِزَالَةِ ٱلْجَوْرِ وَٱلْعُدْوَانِ
ايْنَ ٱلْمُدَّخَرُ لِتَجْدِيدِ ٱلْفَرَائِضِ وَٱلسُّنَنِ
ايْنَ ٱلْمُتَخَيَّرُ لإِِِعَادَةِ ٱلْمِلَّةِ وَٱلشَّرِيعَةِ
ايْنَ ٱلْمُؤَمَّلُ لإِِِحْيَاءِ ٱلْكِتَابِ وَحُدُودِهِ
ايْنَ مُحْيِي مَعَالِمِ ٱلدِّينِ وَاهْلِهِ
ايْنَ قَاصِمُ شَوْكَةِ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
ايْنَ هَادِمُ ابْنِيَةِ ٱلشِّرْكِ وَٱلنِّفَاقِ
ايْنَ مُبِيدُ اهْلِ ٱلْفُسُوقِ
وَٱلْعِصْيَانِ وَٱلطُّغْيَانِ
ايْنَ حَاصِدُ فُرُوعِ ٱلْغَيِّ وَٱلشِّقَاقِ
ايْنَ طَامِسُ آثَارِ ٱلزَّيْغِ وَٱلاهْوَاءِ
ايْنَ قَاطِعُ حَبَائِلِ ٱلْكِذْبِ وَٱلٱِفْتِرَاءِ
ايْنَ مُبِيدُ ٱلْعُتَاةِ وَٱلْمَرَدَةِ
ايْنَ مُسْتَاصِلُ اهْلِ ٱلْعِنَادِ وَٱلتَّضْلِيلِ وَٱلإِلْحَادِ
ايْنَ مُعِزُّ ٱلاوْلِيَاءِ وَمُذِلُّ ٱلاعْدَاءِ
ايْنَ جَامِعُ ٱلْكَلِمَةِ عَلَىٰ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
ايْنَ بَابُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي مِنْهُ يُؤْتَىٰ
ايْنَ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي إِِلَيْهِ يَتَوَجَّهُ ٱلاوْلِيَاءُ
ايْنَ ٱلسَّبَبُ ٱلْمُتَّصِلُ بَيْنَ ٱلارْضِ وَٱلسَّمَاءِ
ايْنَ صَاحِبُ يَوْمِ ٱلْفَتْحِ
وَنَاشِرُ رَايَةِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
ايْنَ مُؤَلِّفُ شَمْلِ ٱلصَّلاَحِ وَٱلرِّضَا
ايْنَ ٱلطَّالِبُ بِذُحُولِ ٱلانْبِيَاءِ وَابْنَاءِ ٱلانْبِيَاءِ
ايْنَ ٱلطَّالِبُ بِدَمِ ٱلْمَقْتُولِ بِكَرْبَلاَءَ
ايْنَ ٱلْمَنْصُورُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَٱفْتَرَىٰ
ايْنَ ٱلْمُضْطَرُّ ٱلَّذِي يُجَابُ إِِذَا دَعَا
ايْنَ صَدْرُ ٱلْخَلاَئِقِ ذُوُ ٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
ايْنَ ٱبْنُ ٱلنَّبِيِّ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ
وَٱبْنُ عَلِيٍّ ٱلْمُرْتَضَىٰ
وَٱبْنُ خَدِيجَةَ ٱلْغَرَّاءِ
وَٱبْنُ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
بِابِي انْتَ وَامِّي
وَنَفْسِي لَكَ ٱلْوِقَاءُ وَٱلْحِمَىٰ

entries.translation_en:
O Allah, to You belongs all praise for what Your decree has brought to pass concerning Your friends, whom You chose purely for Yourself and Your religion, when You selected for them the abundant (portion) that is with You, of the everlasting blessing that neither passes away nor diminishes — after You stipulated for them renunciation of the levels of this lowly world and its ornament and its gilding. They accepted that condition from You, and You knew their faithfulness to it, so You accepted them and drew them near; You sent down before them lofty mention and manifest praise; You made Your angels descend upon them; You honoured them with Your revelation; You aided them with Your knowledge; and You made them the means towards You and the medium to Your good pleasure.
Some of them You settled in Your Garden, until You brought him out of it. Some You carried in Your ark and delivered him, and those who believed with him, from destruction, by Your mercy. One You took as an intimate friend for Yourself; he asked You for a tongue of truthfulness among later generations and You answered him, and You made that lofty. One You spoke to from a tree, directly, and made his brother for him a support and a minister. One You brought into being without a father, gave him the clear signs, and strengthened him with the Holy Spirit. For each of them You legislated a law, marked out a path, and chose successors for him — guardian after guardian, from age to age — upholding Your religion, a proof over Your servants, so that the truth would not depart from its place, falsehood would not prevail over its people, and no one could say: "Why did You not send us a messenger to warn us, and set up for us a banner to guide us, so that we might follow Your signs before we were humbled and disgraced?"
Until You brought the matter to Your beloved and Your chosen one, Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household. He was, as You selected him, the master of those You created, the choicest of those You picked, the best of those You chose, and the noblest of those You trusted. You placed him before Your prophets, sent him to the two weighty races among Your servants, made Your easts and Your wests his treading place, made the Buraq subservient to him, raised his spirit to Your heaven, and deposited with him the knowledge of what was and what will be, until the end of Your creation. Then You helped him with awe (cast into his enemies' hearts), surrounded him with Gabriel and Michael and the marked ones among Your angels, and promised him that You would make his religion prevail over all religion, however much the polytheists might hate it.
That was after You had settled him in a true settlement among his Household, and made for him and for them the first House established for the people — the one at Bakkah — blessed and a guidance for the worlds, in which are clear signs, the Station of Abraham; and whoever enters it is safe. And You said: "Allah only desires to remove defilement from you, O People of the House, and to purify you completely." Then You made the reward of Muhammad, Your blessings be upon him and his Household, love of them in Your Book, and You said: "Say: I do not ask of you any reward for it except love among near relatives." And You said: "Whatever reward I asked of you, it is yours." And You said: "I do not ask of you any reward for it, except that whoever wills may take a path to his Lord." So they were the path towards You and the way to Your good pleasure.
When his days came to an end, he appointed his friend, Ali ibn Abi Talib — Your blessings be upon them both and their Household — as a guide, since he was the warner, and for every people there is a guide. And he said, with the crowd before him: "For whoever I am his master, Ali is his master. O Allah, befriend whoever befriends him, be hostile to whoever is hostile to him, help whoever helps him, and abandon whoever abandons him." And he said: "Whoever has me as his prophet has Ali as his commander." And he said: "I and Ali are from one tree, and the rest of the people are from various trees." And he placed him in the position of Harun in relation to Musa, saying to him: "You are to me in the position of Harun to Musa, except that there is no prophet after me." And he married him to his daughter, the mistress of the women of the worlds; made lawful for him, in his mosque, what was lawful for him(self); and closed the doors except his door. Then he deposited with him his knowledge and his wisdom, and said: "I am the city of knowledge and Ali is its gate; so whoever wants the city and the wisdom, let him come to it through its gate." Then he said: "You are my brother, my successor and my heir; your flesh is from my flesh, your blood is from my blood, your peace is my peace, your war is my war; faith is mixed with your flesh and your blood as it is mixed with my flesh and my blood. Tomorrow, at the Pool, you are my vicegerent; you will discharge my debt and fulfil my promises; and your partisans will be on pulpits of light, their faces radiant, around me in the Garden, and they are my neighbours. Were it not for you, O Ali, the believers would not have been known after me."
After him, he was a guidance against error, a light against blindness, Allah's firm rope and His straight path. He could not be surpassed in closeness of kinship, nor in precedence in religion; he could not be matched in any of his virtues. He followed in the footsteps of the Messenger, may Allah bless them both and their Household. He fought over the (true) interpretation, and the blame of no blamer touched him in (the cause of) Allah. He had shed the blood of the champions of the Arabs, killed their heroes, and attacked their wolves, so he planted in their hearts rancours — of Badr, of Khaybar, of Hunayn and others besides. They nursed their hostility towards him and pressed on in opposing him, until he killed the oath-breakers, the unjust and the renegades.
When he fulfilled his term, and the most wretched of the later ones killed him, following the most wretched of the first ones, the command of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his Household, about the guides after the guides was not obeyed. The nation persisted in detesting him, united in severing his kinship ties and exiling his children — except the few who remained faithful to honouring the truth in them. So some were killed, some were taken captive, and some were exiled. The decree unfolded for them with that for which the best of rewards is hoped, since the earth belongs to Allah: He gives it as inheritance to whom He wills of His servants, and the end is for the God-fearing. Glory be to our Lord! The promise of our Lord is surely fulfilled, and Allah does not break His promise, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
So for the pure ones from the Household of Muhammad and Ali, may Allah bless them both and their Household — for them let the weepers weep; for their sake let the lamenters lament; and for the like of them let the tears be shed. Let the screamers scream, the moaners moan, and the wailers wail.
Where is al-Hasan? Where is al-Husayn? Where are the sons of al-Husayn — righteous one after righteous one, truthful one after truthful one? Where is the path after the path? Where is the choice after the choice? Where are the rising suns? Where are the shining moons? Where are the gleaming stars? Where are the banners of the religion and the foundations of knowledge? Where is the Remnant of Allah, who is never absent from the guiding progeny? Where is the one prepared to cut off the roots of the wrongdoers? Where is the one awaited to straighten the crooked and the bent? Where is the one hoped in to remove injustice and aggression? Where is the one stored up to renew the obligations and the practices? Where is the one chosen to restore the faith and the law? Where is the one expected to revive the Book and its limits? Where is the reviver of the landmarks of the religion and its people? Where is the breaker of the might of the transgressors? Where is the demolisher of the buildings of polytheism and hypocrisy? Where is the destroyer of the people of wickedness, disobedience and rebellion? Where is the harvester of the branches of error and discord? Where is the obliterater of the traces of deviation and desires? Where is the cutter of the snares of lying and fabrication? Where is the destroyer of the insolent and the defiant? Where is the uprooter of the people of stubbornness, misguidance and godlessness? Where is the honorer of the friends and the abaser of the enemies? Where is the uniter of the word upon God-consciousness? Where is the door of Allah, through which He is approached? Where is the face of Allah, towards which the friends turn? Where is the bond connecting earth and heaven? Where is the master of the Day of Victory and the unfurler of the banner of guidance? Where is the uniter of the scattered (community) upon righteousness and good pleasure? Where is the seeker of vengeance for the prophets and the sons of the prophets? Where is the seeker of the blood of the one killed in Karbala? Where is the one granted victory over whoever transgressed against him and fabricated lies? Where is the compelled one who is answered when he calls? Where is the chief of creatures, possessed of righteousness and God-consciousness? Where is the son of the chosen Prophet, the son of Ali the Well-Pleased, the son of Khadijah the radiant, and the son of Fatimah the Great?
May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you, and my soul be your shield and your protection! O son of the masters brought near! O son of the noblest nobles! O son of the rightly guided guides! O son of the refined choice ones! O son of the most generous chiefs! O son of the pure purified ones! O son of the chosen generous seas (of knowledge)! O son of the noblest full moons! O son of the shining full moons! O son of the glowing lamps! O son of the piercing meteors! O son of the gleaming stars! O son of the clear paths! O son of the gleaming signs! O son of the perfect sciences! O son of the well-known practices! O son of the transmitted landmarks! O son of the present miracles! O son of the witnessed proofs! O son of the straight path! O son of the mighty tidings! O son of the one who, in the Mother of the Book with Allah, is "Ali, Wise"! O son of the signs and the clear proofs! O son of the manifest evidences! O son of the dazzling, clear arguments! O son of the conclusive proofs! O son of the abundant blessings! O son of Ta-Ha and the decisive verses! O son of Ya-Sin and the Scattering Winds! O son of the Mount and the Charging Steeds! O son of the one who drew near and came down, and was at a distance of two bows' lengths or nearer — a nearness and an approach to the Most High, the All-High!
Would that I knew where the distance has settled you! Or rather, which earth bears you, or which soil? Is it at Radwa, or elsewhere — or at Dhi Tuwa? It is hard for me that I see the creatures and you are not seen, and I hear from you neither a faint sound nor a whisper. It is hard for me that tribulation surrounds you, apart from me, while no clamour or complaint from me reaches you.
May my soul be sacrificed for you — you, the absent one who has never been absent from us! May my soul be sacrificed for you — you, the distant one who has never distanced himself from us! May my soul be sacrificed for you — you, the wish of every longing believer, man and woman, who remembered and then yearned! May my soul be sacrificed for you — you, the bond of glory that cannot be equalled! May my soul be sacrificed for you — you, of rooted nobility that cannot be rivalled! May my soul be sacrificed for you — you, of ancient blessings that cannot be matched! May my soul be sacrificed for you — you, of a share of honour that cannot be paralleled!
Until when shall I be bewildered about you, O my master, and until when? And with what words shall I describe you, and what secret speech? It is hard for me that I should be answered by another than you, and converse (with others). It is hard for me that I weep for you while mankind abandons you. It is hard for me that what has run its course should run upon you and not upon them. Is there any helper, so that I may prolong with him the wailing and the weeping? Is there any one distraught, so that I may help his distress when he is alone? Has any eye been hurt by a mote, so that my eye may help it upon the mote? Is there any way to you, O son of Ahmad, so that you may be met? Will our day be joined to you, with a promise, so that we may be graced? When shall we come to your flowing springs and drink our fill? When shall we quench ourselves with your sweet water — for the thirst has grown long? When shall we attend you morning and evening, so that our eyes are comforted? When will you see us and we see you, while you have unfurled the banner of victory — will it be seen? Will we gather around you while you lead the assembly, having filled the earth with justice, made your enemies taste disgrace and punishment, destroyed the insolent and the deniers of the truth, cut off the last remnant of the arrogant, and uprooted the roots of the wrongdoers — while we say: "All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds"?
O Allah, You are the remover of sorrows and affliction; to You I complain of wrong, and with You is redress; and You are the Lord of the Hereafter and of this world. So help — O Helper of those who cry for help — Your lowly servant who is afflicted, and show him his master, O Mighty in power; remove from him, through him, grief and burning anguish; and cool his thirst, O He who is established upon the Throne, and to whom is the return and the final end.
O Allah, we are Your servants, longing for Your friend, the reminder of You and of Your Prophet. You created him for us as a protection and a refuge; You appointed him for us a support and a sanctuary; and You made him, for the believers among us, an Imam. So convey to him, from us, greeting and peace; and increase us, through that, O Lord, in honour. Make his dwelling a dwelling and a residence for us, and complete Your blessing by placing him before us, until You bring us into Your gardens and into the company of the martyrs among Your elite.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad; and send blessings upon Muhammad — his grandfather and Your Messenger — the greater master; upon his father — the lesser master; upon his grandmother, the great truthful lady, Fatimah daughter of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household; and upon those of his righteous fathers whom You have chosen; and upon him (himself) — the finest, the most complete, the most perfect, the most enduring, the most abundant and the most ample blessings that You have ever sent upon any of Your chosen ones and the choice of Your creation. And bless him with a blessing that has no limit to its number, no end to its extent, and no exhaustion to its duration.
O Allah, through him establish the truth, refute falsehood, give triumph through him to Your friends, abase through him Your enemies; and connect, O Allah, between us and him a connection that leads to the company of his ancestors; make us among those who hold fast to their hems and remain in their shade; help us to render his rights to him, to strive in obedience to him, and to avoid disobedience to him; bestow upon us his good pleasure; grant us his kindness, his mercy, his prayer and his good, in a measure through which we attain abundance of Your mercy and triumph with You. Make our prayers, through him, accepted; our sins, through him, forgiven; and our supplications, through him, answered. Make our provisions, through him, ample; our anxieties, through him, sufficed; and our needs, through him, fulfilled. Turn towards us with Your noble Face; accept our drawing near to You; look upon us with a merciful look by which we complete (our) honour with You — then do not turn it away from us, by Your generosity. And give us to drink from the Pool of his grandfather, may Allah bless him and his Household, from his cup and by his hand — a full, satiating, pleasant, wholesome drink, after which there is no thirst. O Most Merciful of the merciful!
entries.note_en: The supplication of lamentation for Imam al-Mahdi (a.j.), recited on Friday mornings and on the Eids.

entries.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ النُّورِ الْعَظِيمِ ِ ، وَرَبَّ الْكُرْسِيِّ الرَّفيعِ ، وَرَبَّ الْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ ، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْراةِ وَالاِْنْجيلِ وَالزَّبُورِ ، وَرَبَّ الظِّلِّ وَالْحَرُورِ ، وَمُنْزِلَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظيمِ ، وَرَبَّ الْمَلائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبينَ وَالاَْنْبِياءِ وَالْمُرْسَلينَ ، اَللّهُمَّ اِنّي اَسْاَلُكَ بِاِسْمِكَ الْكَريمِ ، وَبِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الْمُنيرِ وَمُلْكِكَ الْقَديمِ ، يا حَيُّ يا قَيُّومُ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذي اَشْرَقَتْ بِهِ السَّماواتُ وَالاَْرَضُونَ ، وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي يَصْلَحُ بِهِ الاَْوَّلُونَ وَالاْخِرُونَ ، يا حَيّاً قَبْلَ كُلِّ حَيٍّ وَيا حَيّاً بَعْدَ كُلِّ حَيٍّ وَيا حَيّاً حينَ لا حَيَّ يا مُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتى وَمُميتَ الاَْحْياءِ ، يا حَيُّ لا اِلهَ اِلّا اَنْتَ ، اَللّهُمَّ بَلِّغْ مَوْلانَا الاِْمامَ الْهادِيَ الْمَهْدِيَّ الْقائِمَ بِاَمْرِكَ صَلَواتُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ و عَلى آبائِهِ الطّاهِرينَ عَنْ جَميعِ الْمُؤْمِنينَ وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ في مَشارِقِ الاَْرْضِ وَمَغارِبِها سَهْلِها وَجَبَلِها وَبَرِّها وَبَحْرِها ، وَعَنّي وَعَنْ والِدَيَّ مِنَ الصَّلَواتِ زِنَةَ عَرْشِ اللهِ وَمِدادَ كَلِماتِهِ ، وَما اَحْصاهُ عِلْمُهُ وَاَحاطَ بِهِ كِتابُهُ ، اَللّهُمَّ اِنّي اُجَدِّدُ لَهُ في صَبيحَةِ يَوْمي هذا وَما عِشْتُ مِنْ اَيّامي عَهْداً وَعَقْداً وَبَيْعَةً لَهُ في عُنُقي ، لا اَحُولُ عَنْها وَلا اَزُولُ اَبَداً ، اَللّهُمَّ اجْعَلْني مِنْ اَنْصارِهِ وَاَعْوانِهِ وَالذّابّينَ عَنْهُ وَالْمُسارِعينَ اِلَيْهِ في قَضاءِ حَوائِجِهِ ، وَالْمُمْتَثِلينَ لاَِوامِرِهِ وَالُْمحامينَ عَنْهُ ، وَالسّابِقينَ اِلى اِرادَتِهِ وَالْمُسْتَشْهَدينَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ، اَللّهُمَّ اِنْ حالَ بَيْني وَبَيْنَهُ الْمَوْتُ الَّذي جَعَلْتَهُ عَلى عِبادِكَ حَتْماً مَقْضِيّاً فَاَخْرِجْني مِنْ قَبْري مُؤْتَزِراً كَفَنى شاهِراً سَيْفي مُجَرِّداً قَناتي مُلَبِّياً دَعْوَةَ الدّاعي فِي الْحاضِرِ وَالْبادي ، اَللّهُمَّ اَرِنيِ الطَّلْعَةَ الرَّشيدَةَ ، وَالْغُرَّةَ الْحَميدَةَ ، وَاكْحُلْ ناظِري بِنَظْرَة منِّي اِلَيْهِ ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُ وَسَهِّلْ مَخْرَجَهُ ، وَاَوْسِعْ مَنْهَجَهُ وَاسْلُكْ بي مَحَجَّتَهُ ، وَاَنْفِذْ اَمْرَهُ وَاشْدُدْ اَزْرَهُ ، وَاعْمُرِ اللّهُمَّ بِهِ بِلادَكَ ، وَاَحْيِ بِهِ عِبادَكَ ، فَاِنَّكَ قُلْتَ وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ : ( ظَهَرَ الْفَسادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِما كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِي النّاسِ ) ، فَاَظْهِرِ الّلهُمَّ لَنا وَلِيَّكَ وَابْنَ بِنْتِ نَبِيِّكَ الْمُسَمّى بِاسْمِ رَسُولِكَ حَتّى لا يَظْفَرَ بِشَيْء مِنَ الْباطِلِ اِالّا مَزَّقَهُ ، وَيُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ وَيُحَقِّقَهُ ، وَاجْعَلْهُ اَللّهُمَّ مَفْزَعاً لِمَظْلُومِ عِبادِكَ ، وَناصِراً لِمَنْ لا يَجِدُ لَهُ ناصِراً غَيْرَكَ ، وَمُجَدِّداً لِما عُطِّلَ مِنْ اَحْكامِ كِتابِكَ ، وَمُشَيِّداً لِما وَرَدَ مِنْ اَعْلامِ دينِكَ وَسُنَنِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ، وَاجْعَلْهُ اَللّهُمَّ مِمَّنْ حَصَّنْتَهُ مِن بَأسِ الْمُعْتَدينَ ، اَللّهُمَّ وَسُرَّ نَبِيَّكَ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَمَنْ تَبِعَهُ عَلى دَعْوَتِهِ ، وَارْحَمِ اسْتِكانَتَنا بَعْدَهُ ، اَللّهُمَّ اكْشِفْ هذِهِ الْغُمَّةَ عَنْ هذِهِ الاُْمَّةِ بِحُضُورِهِ ، وَعَجِّلْ لَنا ظُهُورَهُ ، اِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعيداً وَنَراهُ قَريباً ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يا اَرْحَمَ الرّاحِمينَ
اَلْعَجَلَ اَلْعَجَلَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ
entries.translation_en:
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Allah, Lord of the mighty light, Lord of the exalted Throne, Lord of the surging sea, Sender-down of the Torah, the Gospel and the Psalms, Lord of shade and heat, Sender-down of the mighty Qur'an, Lord of the near angels, the prophets and the messengers. O Allah, I ask You by Your noble Name, by the light of Your luminous Face and Your eternal kingdom. O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting! I ask You by Your Name by which the heavens and the earths shine, and by Your Name by which the first and the last are set right. O Living before every living thing, O Living after every living thing, O Living when there was no living thing, O Reviver of the dead and Causer of the living to die, O Living One, there is no god but You.
O Allah, convey to our master, the Imam, the guide, the rightly guided, the one who rises by Your command — may the blessings of Allah be upon him and upon his pure fathers — from all the believing men and believing women in the east of the earth and its west, its plains and its mountains, its land and its sea, and from me and from my parents, blessings equal to the weight of the Throne of Allah, the ink of His words, and all that His knowledge encompasses and His Book contains.
O Allah, I renew for him, on the morning of this day of mine, and for all the days I shall live, a covenant, a pledge and an allegiance to him upon my neck, from which I shall never turn away and never move, ever. O Allah, make me among his helpers, his supporters, those who defend him, those who hasten to him to fulfil his needs, those who comply with his orders, those who protect him, those who race towards his will, and those martyred before him.
O Allah, if death, which You have made for Your servants an inevitable decree, comes between me and him, then bring me out of my grave wrapped in my shroud, my sword unsheathed, my spear bare, answering the call of the caller in settled land and desert.
O Allah, show me the rightly guided countenance and the praiseworthy forehead, and anoint my eyes with a glance from me towards him; hasten his relief, make his emergence easy, widen his path, lead me along his way, carry out his command, strengthen his arm; flourish, O Allah, through him Your lands, and revive through him Your servants. For You have said — and Your word is the truth — "Corruption has appeared on land and sea because of what the hands of people have earned." So manifest for us, O Allah, Your friend, and the son of the daughter of Your Prophet, named with the name of Your Messenger, until he leaves nothing of falsehood without tearing it apart, and establishes the truth and confirms it. Make him, O Allah, a refuge for the oppressed among Your servants, a helper for whoever finds no helper other than You, a reviver of what has been suspended of the rulings of Your Book, and a strengthener of what has come down of the signs of Your religion and the ways of Your Prophet, may Allah bless him and his Household. Make him, O Allah, among those whom You have fortified against the onslaught of the aggressors. O Allah, gladden Your Prophet Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, by the sight of him and of those who follow him in his call, and have mercy on our lowliness after him. O Allah, lift this gloom from this nation by his presence, and hasten for us his appearance; they see it as far away, but we see it as near — by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
Hasten! Hasten! O my master, O Master of the Age! (Recite three times, gently striking the right thigh with the palm, as the narration instructs.)
entries.note_en: The covenant with Imam al-Mahdi (a.j.), renewed every morning. At the end, gently strike the right thigh with the palm while saying the final line three times.

entries.arabic: اِلهي عَظُمَ الْبَلاءُ، وَبَرِحَ الْخَفاءُ، وَانْكَشَفَ الْغِطاءُ، وَانْقَطَعَ الرَّجاءُ، وَضاقَتِ الأرض، وَمُنِعَتِ السَّماءُ، واَنْتَ الْمُسْتَعانُ، وَاِلَيْكَ الْمُشْتَكى، وَعَلَيْكَ الْمُعَوَّلُ فِي الشِّدَّةِ والرَّخاءِ، اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد، اُولِي الأمر الَّذينَ فَرَضْتَ عَلَيْنا طاعَتَهُمْ، وَعَرَّفْتَنا بِذلِكَ مَنْزِلَتَهُمْ، فَفَرِّجْ عَنا بِحَقِّهِمْ فَرَجاً عاجِلاً قَريباً كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ اَوْ هُوَ اَقْرَبُ، يا مُحَمَّدُ يا عَلِيُّ يا عَلِيُّ يا مُحَمَّدُ اِكْفِياني فَاِنَّكُما كافِيانِ، وَانْصُراني فَاِنَّكُما ناصِرانِ، يا مَوْلانا يا صاحِبَ الزَّمانِ، الْغَوْثَ الْغَوْثَ الْغَوْثَ، اَدْرِكْني اَدْرِكْني اَدْرِكْني، السّاعَةَ السّاعَةَ السّاعَةَ، الْعَجَلَ الْعَجَلَ الْعَجَل، يا اَرْحَمَ الرّاحِمينَ، بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ الطّاهِرينَ
entries.translation_en: O my God, the calamity has become great, the hidden has become exposed, the veil has been lifted, hope has been cut off, the earth has become narrow, and the sky has been withheld. You are the one whose help is sought, to You is the complaint, and upon You is reliance in hardship and in ease. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, those in authority whose obedience You have made obligatory upon us, and through that You have made us know their station; so relieve us, by their right, with a relief that is swift and near, like the blink of an eye or even nearer. O Muhammad, O Ali! O Ali, O Muhammad! Suffice me, for you two are sufficient; support me, for you two are supporters. O our master, O Master of the Age! Help! Help! Help! Reach me, reach me, reach me! This very hour, this very hour, this very hour! Hasten, hasten, hasten! O Most Merciful of the merciful, by the right of Muhammad and his pure Household.
entries.translation_ur: اے میرے خدا! مصیبت عظیم ہو گئی ہے، پوشیدہ ظاہر ہو گیا ہے، پردہ اٹھ گیا ہے، امید ٹوٹ گئی ہے، زمین تنگ ہو گئی ہے اور آسمان (کی رحمت) روک لی گئی ہے۔ تو ہی ہے جس سے مدد مانگی جاتی ہے، تیرے ہی حضور شکایت ہے، اور سختی و آسانی میں تجھ ہی پر بھروسا ہے۔ اے اللہ! محمد و آلِ محمد پر رحمتیں نازل فرما، وہ صاحبانِ امر جن کی اطاعت تو نے ہم پر فرض کی ہے اور اس کے ذریعے تو نے ہمیں ان کا مرتبہ پہچنوایا؛ پس ان کے حق کے واسطے ہمیں ایسی کشادگی عطا فرما جو فوری اور قریب ہو، پلک جھپکنے کی مانند یا اس سے بھی قریب۔ اے محمد، اے علی! اے علی، اے محمد! میری کفایت فرمائیے، کیونکہ آپ دونوں ہی کافی ہیں؛ میری مدد فرمائیے، کیونکہ آپ دونوں ہی مددگار ہیں۔ اے ہمارے مولا، اے صاحبِ زمانہ! فریاد ہے، فریاد ہے، فریاد ہے! میری دستگیری فرمائیے، میری دستگیری فرمائیے، میری دستگیری فرمائیے! اسی گھڑی، اسی گھڑی، اسی گھڑی! جلد، جلد، جلد! اے سب رحم کرنے والوں سے بڑھ کر رحم کرنے والے، محمد اور ان کے پاک اہلِ بیت کے حق کے واسطے سے۔
entries.note_en: The supplication for relief, attributed to Imam al-Mahdi (a.j.).
