entries.translation_en:
"Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him with full greeting." (33:56)
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad the Prophet, upon his descendants, and upon the People of his House.
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. — And there is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Mighty. (Recite one hundred times.)
All praise belongs to Allah, who does what He wills, and no one other than He does what he wills.
O Allah, I ask You for the things that bring about Your mercy, the resolutions of Your forgiveness, deliverance from the Fire and from every affliction, triumph with Paradise and good pleasure in the Abode of Peace, and the proximity of Your Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him and his Household. O Allah, whatever blessing we have is from You; there is no god but You; I seek Your forgiveness and I turn to You in repentance.
Glory be to You; there is no god but You; forgive me all of my sins, all of them together, for none forgives the sins — all of them together — but You.
O Allah, I ask You, by the coming of Your night, the passing of Your day, the presence of Your prayers, the voices of Your callers, and the glorification of Your angels: send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and turn to me in repentance; indeed, You are the Oft-Returning, the All-Merciful.
"So glory be to Allah when you enter the evening and when you enter the morning, and to Him belongs the praise in the heavens and the earth, and at nightfall and when you are at noon." (30:17-18)
O Allah, rescue us from the Fire, safe and sound; admit us into Paradise in peace and security; take us (in death) as Muslims; and join us to the righteous — by Your grace and Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
O Allah, Turner of hearts and eyes, keep my heart firm upon Your religion; do not let my heart deviate after You have guided me; and grant me, from Your presence, mercy; indeed, You are the Bestower. (after 3:8) And rescue me from the Fire, by Your mercy.
O Allah, extend my life for me, widen my provision for me, and spread Your mercy over me. And if, in the Mother of the Book with You, I am (written) wretched, then make me felicitous; for You erase what You will and You confirm, and with You is the Mother of the Book. (after 13:39)
(The Ten Seekings of Protection — Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, said: "When you enter the evening and the morning, say, after the obligatory prayer at Maghrib and at Fajr, ten times: I seek protection in Allah from Satan, the accursed." Then say:)
Write (it) down, may Allah have mercy on you both. In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. I have entered the evening and I have entered the morning believing in Allah, upon the religion of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, and his way; upon the religion of Ali, peace be upon him, and his way; upon the religion of Fatimah, peace be upon her, and her way; and upon the religion of the successors, may the blessings of Allah be upon them, and their way. I have believed in their secret and their open, in their unseen and their witnessed; and I seek protection in Allah, in this night of mine and this day of mine, from that from which Muhammad, Ali, Fatimah and the successors, may Allah bless them, sought protection; and I desire from Allah that in which they desired; and there is no power and no strength except by Allah.
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. All praise belongs to Allah, who makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night. All praise belongs to Allah whenever a night has darkened and grown murky; and all praise belongs to Allah whenever a star has gleamed and faded.
(The great litany of praises — the supplication for this world and the Hereafter:) All praise belongs to Allah, Possessor of the kingdom and the dominion, of greatness and irresistible power (and might), of pride, splendour and majesty, of awe and beauty, of glory, power, strength and might, of favour and victory, of grace and bounty, of justice, truth, creation and loftiness, of elevation and glory, of virtue, wisdom, richness, amplitude, expansion and contraction, of forbearance and knowledge, of the conclusive proof, of abundant blessing, of beautiful and goodly praise, and of noble favours — King of this world and the Hereafter, of Paradise and the Fire, and of whatever is in them. Blessed is Allah, and exalted.
All praise belongs to Allah, who knows the secrets of the unseen things and is aware of what the hearts conceal; from Him there is no escape and no flight. All praise belongs to Allah, the Supreme in His sovereignty, the Mighty in His station, the Irresistible in His kingdom, the Strong in His seizing, the Lofty above His Throne, the One aware of His creation, and the One who reaches, in His knowledge, whatever He intends.
All praise belongs to Allah, by whose words the firm heavens stood, the spread earths were fixed, the anchored mountains — the pegs — stood upright, the fertilising winds blew, the clouds moved in the atmosphere of the sky, the seas stood at their limits, the hearts trembled from fear of Him, and the (false) lords were subdued before His lordship. Blessed are You, O Counter of the drops of rain and the leaves of the trees, and Reviver of the bodies of the dead for the Gathering!
Glory be to You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honour! What did You do with the stranger, the poor one, when he came to You seeking refuge, crying for help? What did You do with the one who alighted in Your courtyard, exposed himself to Your good pleasure, came in the morning to You, and knelt before You, complaining to You of what is not hidden from You? So let not my share of my supplication be deprivation, O Lord, and let not my portion of what I hope from You be abandonment.
O He who has always been and will always be, standing over every soul for what it has earned! O He who made the days of this world pass away, its months revolve, and its years rotate — while You are the Everlasting, whom the ages do not wear out and the epochs do not change! O He for whom every day is new, and with whom every provision is stored — for the weak, the strong and the firm — You have divided the provisions among the creatures, and made equal the tiny ant and the sparrow.
O Allah, when the standing (on the Day of Resurrection) becomes constricted for the people, we seek refuge in You from the constriction of the standing. O Allah, when the Day of Resurrection grows long for the criminals, shorten that day for us to (the span) between one prayer and the next. O Allah, when You bring the sun near to the skulls, until between it and the skulls there is the measure of a mile, and its heat is increased by the heat of ten years — we ask You to shade us with the clouds, and to set up for us pulpits and seats upon which we sit, while the people are departing in the standing. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
I ask You, O Allah, by the right of these praises, that You forgive me, overlook (my faults) for me, clothe me with well-being in my body, and grant me safety in my religion. For I ask You while I am confident of Your answering me in my request, and I call You while I know of Your listening to my call: so listen to my supplication, do not cut off my hope, do not turn back my praise, and do not disappoint my prayer. I am in need of Your good pleasure, poor towards Your forgiveness; I ask You and I do not despair of Your mercy; I call You and I am not safe from Your wrath.
My Lord, answer me; bestow on me Your pardon; take me (in death) as a Muslim; and join me to the righteous. My Lord, do not withhold Your grace from me, O Bestower; and do not leave me to myself, abandoned, O All-Kind One! My Lord, have mercy on my fall at the parting from loved ones, on my loneliness in the stillness of the grave, on my estrangement in the desert of the Resurrection, and on my neediness when standing before You for the reckoning. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the Fire, so grant me refuge; my Lord, I seek protection in You from the Fire, so protect me; my Lord, I flee to You from the Fire, so distance me; my Lord, I plead for Your mercy, afflicted, so have mercy on me. My Lord, I seek Your forgiveness for what I was ignorant of, so forgive me; my Lord, supplication has brought me forth, in need of You, so do not make me despair, O Generous One, Possessor of favours, goodness and overlooking!
My Master, O All-Kind, O All-Merciful: answer, among those who plead to You, my call; have mercy, among those who sob with wailing, on my tears; make my comfort, on the day of departure from this world, in meeting You; conceal, among the dead, O Great Hope, my faults; and incline towards me when I move, alone, to my pit. Indeed, You are my hope, the object of my request, and the Knower of what I want in the direction of my asking.
So fulfil, O Fulfiller of needs, my need; for to You is the complaint, and You are the One whose help is sought and hoped in. I flee to You, running from sins, so accept me; I take refuge from Your justice in Your forgiveness, so reach me; I shelter in Your pardon from Your seizing, so restrain (it) from me; I seek the refreshment of Your mercy from Your punishment, so deliver me; I seek nearness to You through Islam, so bring me near; and from the Greatest Terror, grant me security; and in the shade of Your Throne, shade me; and a double share of Your mercy, grant me; and from this world, deliver me safe; and from the darknesses to the light, bring me out. And on the Day of Resurrection, whiten my face; with an easy reckoning, reckon me; and with my secrets, do not disgrace me; and upon Your tribulations, make me patient; and as You turned evil and indecency away from Yusuf, turn it away from me; and what I have no capacity for, do not burden me with. And to the Abode of Peace, guide me; by the Qur'an, benefit me; by the firm word, keep me firm; from Satan the accursed, protect me; by Your power, Your strength and Your might, preserve me; by Your forbearance, Your knowledge and the width of Your mercy, deliver me from Hell; and Your Paradise, al-Firdaws, settle me in; and the looking at Your Face, grant me; and to Your Prophet Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, join me; and from the devils and their allies, and from the evil of every possessor of evil — suffice me.
O Allah, and my enemies, and whoever plots evil against me: if they come by land, make their brave ones cowardly, scatter their gatherings, blunt their weapons, hamstring their mounts, and unleash upon them the storm winds and the destructive blasts, forever, until You make them enter the Fire; bring them down from their strongholds, and give us power over their forelocks. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad — blessings witnessed by the first generations, together with the righteous, the master of the messengers, the seal of the prophets, the leader of good, and the key of mercy.
O Allah, Lord of the Sacred House, Lord of the sacred month, Lord of the sacred landmark, Lord of the Corner and the Station, and Lord of the lawful and the forbidden: convey to the spirit of Muhammad, from us, greeting and peace. Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah; peace be upon you, O trustee of Allah; peace be upon you, O Muhammad ibn Abdillah; peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. For he is, as You described him, towards the believers, kind and merciful. O Allah, give him the best of what he asked You, the best of what You have been asked for him, and the best of what You will be asked for him until the Day of Resurrection. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
O Allah, I ask You by Your noble Face, Your mighty Name, and Your eternal kingdom: send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household, and forgive me my great sin; indeed, none forgives the great (sin) but the Great.
Whatever Allah wills; there is no power except by Allah; I seek Allah's forgiveness.
"Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah, and He is the Mighty, the Wise. To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and gives death; and He has power over all things. He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden; and He knows all things. He is the one who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then established Himself upon the Throne. He knows what enters the earth and what comes out of it, what descends from the heaven and what ascends into it; and He is with you wherever you are; and Allah sees what you do. To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and to Allah the affairs are returned. He makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night; and He knows what is in the breasts." (57:1-6)
"If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled, splitting apart, from the fear of Allah; and these parables We strike for the people, so that they may reflect. He is Allah, besides whom there is no god, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed; He is the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. He is Allah, besides whom there is no god — the King, the Holy, the Peace, the Granter of faith, the Overseer, the Mighty, the Irresistible, the Supreme; glory be to Allah above what they associate (with Him). He is Allah, the Creator, the Originator, the Shaper; to Him belong the most beautiful Names; whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him; and He is the Mighty, the Wise." (59:21-24)
Thanks, thanks, thanks! In the Name of Allah, besides whom there is no god, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. O Allah, remove from me anxiety and sorrow.
entries.note_en: Begin with the Common Ta'qibat (including Tasbihat al-Zahra), then these litanies specific to the Maghrib prayer, including the supplication of Fatimah al-Zahra (a.s.).

entries.arabic:
اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤ مرة) — اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣ مرة) — سُبْحَانَ اللهِ (٣٣ مرة)
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِي عِلْمٌ بِمَوْضِعِ رِزْقِي
وَإِنَّمَا أَطْلُبُهُ بِخَطَرَاتٍ تَخْطُرُ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِي
فَأَجُولُ فِي طَلَبِهِ ٱلْبُلْدَانَ
فَأَنَا فِيمَا أَنَا طَالِبٌ كَٱلْحَيْرَانِ
لاَ أَدْرِي أَفِي سَهْلٍ هَوُ أَمْ فِي جَبَلٍ
أَمْ في أَرْضٍ أَمْ في سَمَاءٍ
أَمْ فِي بَرٍّ أَمْ فِي بَحْرٍ
وَعَلَىٰ يَدَيْ مَنْ
وَمِنْ قِبَلِ مَنْ
وَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ عِلْمَهُ عِنْدَكَ
وَ أَسْبَابَهُ بِيَدِكَ
وَ أَنْتَ ٱلَّذي تَقْسِمُهُ بِلُطْفِكَ
وَتُسَبِّبُهُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ
وَٱجْعَلْ يَا رَبِّ رِزْقَكَ لِي وَاسِعاً
وَمَطْلَبَهُ سَهْلاً
وَمَاْخَذَهُ قَرِيباً
وَلاَ تُعَنِّنِي بِطَلَبِ مَا لَمْ تُقَدِّرْ لِي فيهِ رِزْقاً
فَإِنَّكَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِي
وَ أَنَا فَقِيرٌ إِلَىٰ رَحْمَتِكَ
فَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ
وَجُدْ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ
إِنَّكَ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَظيم
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَمَا اظَلَّتْ
وَرَبَّ ٱلارَضِينَ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَمَا اقَلَّتْ
وَرَبَّ ٱلشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا اضَلَّتْ
وَرَبَّ ٱلرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَتْ
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
وَإِلٰهَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
وَمَلِيكَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
انْتَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُقْتَدِرُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
انْتَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلاوَّلُ فَلاَ شَيْءَ قَبْلَكَ
وَانْتَ ٱلآخِرُ فَلاَ شَيْءَ بَعْدَكَ
وَانْتَ ٱلظَّاهِرُ فَلاَ شَيْءَ فَوْقَكَ
وَانْتَ ٱلْبَاطِنُ فَلاَ شَيْءَ دُونَكَ
رَبَّ جَبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ
وَإِلٰهَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ
وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلاسْبَاطِ
اسْالُكَ انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
وَانْ تَوَلاَّنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ
وَلاَ تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيَّ احَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
مِمَّنْ لاَ طَاقَةَ لِي بِهِ
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اتَحَبَّبُ إِلَيْكَ فَحَبِّبْنِي
وَفِي ٱلنَّاسِ فَعَزِّزْنِي
وَمِنْ شَرِّ شَّيَاطِينِ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلإِنْسِ فَسَلِّمْنِي
يَا رَبَّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ
يَا مُذِلَّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ وَمُعِزَّ كُلِّ ذَليلٍ قَدْ وَحَقِّكَ بَلِّغْ مَجْهُودِي
وتقرأ في الأولى الحمد وآية الكرسي وقُل يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ
وفي الثّانية الْحَمْدُ وثلاث عشرة مرّة قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ
اَللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَنْ لَا تَرَاهُ الْعُيُونُ وَلَا تُخَالِطُهُ الظُّنُونُ
وَلَا يَصِفُهُ الْوَاصِفُونَ يَا مَنْ لَا تُغَيِّرُهُ الدُّهُورُ وَلَا تُبْلِيهِ الْأَزْمِنَةُ وَلَا تَحْمِلُهُ الْأُمُورُ
يَا مَنْ لَا يَذُوقُ الْمَوْتَ وَلَا يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ
يَا مَنْ لَا تَضُرُّهُ الذُّنُوبُ وَلَا تَنْقُصُهُ الْمَغْفِرَةُ
صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَهَبْ لِي مَا لَا يَنْقُصُكَ وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَضُرُّكَ وَافْعَلْ بِي (كَذَا وَكَذَا، وتسأل حاجتك).
قال (عليه السَّلامُ): من صلاّها بنى الله له بيتاً في الجنَّة
إنّهما مجلبة للرّزق
اَللّٰهُمَّ عَافِنَا مِنْ كُلِّ بَلَاءِ الدُّنْيَا
وَاصْرِفْ عَنَّا شَرَّ الدُّنْيَا وَ شَرَّ الْآخِرَۃِ
وَارْزُقْنَا خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَ خَيْرَ الْآخِرَۃِ
بِفَضْلِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ هٰذِهٖ صَلَاتِي صَلَّيْتُهَا لَا لِحَاجَةٍ مِنْكَ‏ إِلَيْهَا
وَ لَا رَغْبَةٍ مِنْكَ فِيْهَا إِلَّا تَعْظِيمًا وَ طَاعَةً وَ إِجَابَةً لَّكَ إِلىٰ مَا أَمَرْتَنِي
إِلَهِي إِنْ كَانَ فِيْهَا خَلَلٌ أَوْ نَقْصٌ مِنْ رُكُوْعِهَا أَوْ سُجُوْدِهَا أَوْ قِيَامِهَا أَوْ قُعُوْدِهَا فَلَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي وَ تَفَضَّلْ عَلَيَّ بِالْقَبُوْلِ وَ الْغُفْرَانِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ‏.
أَعُوْذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللهِ وَ أَعُوْذُ بِقُدْرَةِ الله وَ أَعُوْذُ بِمَغْفِرَةِ اللهِ وَ أَعُوْذُ بِرَحْمَةِ اللهِ وَ أَعُوْذُ بِسُلْطَانِ اللهِ الَّذِيْ‏ هُوَ عَلىٰ‏ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيْرٌوَ
أَعُوْذُ بِكَرَمِ اللهِ وَ أَعُوْذُ بِجَمْعِ اللهِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيْدٍ وَ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيْدٍ وَ كُلِّ مُغْتَالٍ وَ سَارِقٍ وَ عَارِضٍ
وَ مِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَ الْهَامَّةِ وَ الْعَامَّةِ
وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ صَغِيْرَةٍ وَ كَبِيْرَةٍ بِلَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ
وَ مِنْ شَرِّ فُسَّاقِ الْعَرَبِ وَ الْعَجَمِ وَ فُجَّارِهِمْ
وَ مِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الْجِنِّ وَ الْإِنْسِ
وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ رَبِّي‏ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلىٰ‏ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ‏.
اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلِّ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
وَ لَا تُؤْمِنَّا مَكْرَكَ وَ لَا تُنْسِنَا ذِكْرَكَ وَ لَا تَكْشِفْ عَنَّا سِتْرَكَ
وَ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا فَضْلَكَ‏ وَ لَا تُحِلَّ عَلَيْنَا غَضَبَكَ وَ لَا تُبَاعِدْنَا مِنْ جِوَارِكَ وَ لَا تَنْقُصْنَا مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
وَ لَا تَنْزِعْ مِنَّا بَرَكَتَكَ وَ لَا تَمْنَعْنَا عَافِيَتَكَ وَ أَصْلِحْ لَنَا مَا أَعْطَيْتَنَا
وَ زِدْنَا مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْمُبَارَكِ الطَّيِّبِ الْحَسَنِ الْجَمِيْلِ وَ لَا تُغَيِّرْ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَتِكَ وَ لَا تُؤْيِسْنَا مِنْ رَوْحِكَ وَ لَا تُهِنَّا بَعْدَ كَرَامَتِكَ
وَ لَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنا وَ هَبْ لَنا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ‏
اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ قُلُوْبَنَا سَالِمَةً وَ أَرْوَاحَنَا طَيِّبَةً وَ أَزْوَاجَنَا مُطَهَّرَةً وَ أَلْسِنَتَنَا صَادِقَةً وَ إِيْمَانَنَا دَائِماً وَ يَقِيْنَنَا صَادِقاً وَ تِجَارَتَنَا لَا تَبُورُ
اللَّهُمَ‏ آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
يا رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ عَجِّلْ فَرَجَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، يا رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ إِحْفَظْ غَيْبَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ ، يا رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ إِنْتَقِمْ لِابْنَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ عليهما السلام .
أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ . أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ رَسُولَكَ الصَّادِقَ الْمُصَدَّقَ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ قالَ إِنَّكَ قُلْتَ ما تَرَدَّدْتُ في شَيْ‏ءٍ أَنَا فاعِلُهُ كَتَرَدُّدي في قَبْضِ رُوحِ عَبْدِيَ الْمُؤْمِنِ، يَكْرَهُ الْمَوْتَ وَأَنَا أَكْرَهُ مَساءَتَهُ .
أَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَعَجِّلْ لِوَلِيِّكَ الْفَرَجَ ، وَالنَّصْرَ وَالْعافِيَةَ ، وَلاتَسُؤْني في نَفْسي ، وَلا في فُلانٍ .
سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تَوَاضَعَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِعَظَمَتِهٖ، سُبْحَانَ مَنْ ذَلَّ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِعِزَّتِهٖ، سُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَضَعَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِاَمْرِهٖ وَ مُلْكِهٖ.
سُبْحَانَ مَنِ انْقَادَتْ لَهُ الْاُمُوْرُ بِاَزِمَّتِهَا.
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يَنْسٰى مَنْ ذَكَرَهٗ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يَخِيْبُ مَنْ دَعَاهُ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ مَنْ تَوَكَّلَ عَلَيْهِ كَفَاهُ.
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ سَامِكِ السَّمَاءِ، وَ سَاطِحِ الْاَرْضِ، وَ حَاصِرِ الْبِحَارِ وَ نَاضِدِ الْجِبَالِ، وَ بَارِءِ الْحَيَوَانِ، وَ خَالِقِ الشَّجَرِ، وَ فَاتِحِ يَنَابِيْعِ الْاَرْضِ، وَ مُدَبِّرِ الْاُمُوْرِ، وَ مُسَيِّرِ السَّحَابِ، وَ مُجْرِيْ الرِّيْحِ وَ الْمَاءِ وَ النَّارِ مِنْ اَغْوَارِ الْاَرْضِ مُتَسَارِعَاتٍ فِيْ الْهَوَاءِ، وَ مُهْبِطِ الْحَرِّ وَ الْبَرْدِ.
اَلَّذِيْ بِنِعْمَتِهٖ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ، وَ بِشُكْرِهٖ تُسْتَوْجَبُ الزِّيَادَاتُ وَ بِاَمْرِهٖ قَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ، وَ بِعِزَّتِهِ اسْتَقَرَّتِ الرَّاسِيَاتُ، وَ سَبَّحَتِ الْوُحُوْشُ فِيْ الْفَلَوَاتِ، وَ الطَّيْرُ فِيْ الْوَكَنَاتِ.
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَفِيْعِ الدَّرَجَاتِ، مُنْزِلِ الْاٰيَاتِ، وَاسِعِ الْبَرَكَاتِ، سَاتِرِ الْعَوْرَاتِ، قَابِلِ الْحَسَنَاتِ، مُقِيْلِ الْعَثَرَاتِ، مُنَفِّسِ الْكُرُبَاتِ، مُنْزِلِ الْبَرَكَاتِ، مُجِيْبِ الدَّعَوَاتِ، مُحْيِيْ الْاَمْوَاتِ، اِلٰهِ مَنْ فِيْ الْاَرْضِ وَ السَّمَاوَاتِ.
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ عَلٰى كُلِّ حَمْدٍ وَ ذِكْرٍ، وَ شُكْرٍ وَ صَبْرٍ، وَ صَلَاةٍ وَ زَكَاةٍ وَ قِيَامٍ وَ عِبَادَةٍ، وَ سَعَادَةٍ وَ بَرَكَةٍ، وَ زِيَادَةٍ وَ رَحْمَةٍ، وَ نِعْمَةٍ وَ كَرَامَةٍ وَ فَرِيْضَةٍ وَ سَرَّاءٍ وَ ضَرَّاءٍ، وَ شِدَّةٍ وَ رَخَاءٍ، وَ مُصِيْبَةٍ وَ بَلَاءٍ، وَ عُسْرٍ وَ يُسْرٍ، وَ غِنَاءٍ وَ فَقْرٍ، وَ عَلٰى كُلِّ حَالٍ، وَ فِيْ كُلِّ اَوَانٍ وَ زَمَانٍ، وَ (فِىْ) كُلِّ مَثْوًى وَ مُنْقَلَبٍ وَ مُقَامٍ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ عَائِذٌ بِكَ فَاَعِذْنِيْ، وَ مُسْتَجِيْرٌ بِكَ فَاَجِرْنِيْ، وَ مُسْتَعِيْنٌ بِكَ فَاَعِنِّيْ، وَ مُسْتَغِيْثٌ بِكَ فَاَغِثْنِيْ، وَ دَاعِيْكَ فَاَجِبْنِيْ، وَ مُسْتَغْفِرُكَ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ.
وَ مُسْتَنْصِرُكَ فَانْصُرْنِيْ، وَ مُسْتَهْدِيْكَ فَاهْدِنِيْ، وَ مُسْتَكْفِيْكَ فَاكْفِنِيْ.
وَ مُلْتَجِأٌ اِلَيْكَ فَاٰوِنِيْ، وَ مُسْتَمْسِكٌ بِحَبْلِكَ فَاعْصِمْنِيْ.
وَ مُتَوَكِّلٌ عَلَيْكَ فَاكْفِنِيْ، وَ اجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْ عِيَاذِكَ وَ جِوَارِكَ وَ حِرْزِكَ وَ كَهْفِكَ وَ حِيَاطَتِكَ وَ حَرَاسَتِكَ وَ كَلَاءَتِكَ وَ حُرْمَتِكَ وَ اَمْنِكَ.
وَ تَحْتَ ظِلِّكَ، وَ تَحْتَ جَنَاحِكَ، وَ اجْعَلْ عَلَيَّ جُنَّةً وَاقِيَةً مِنْكَ.
وَ اجْعَلْ حِفْظَكَ وَ حِيَاطَتَكَ وَ حِرَاسَتَكَ وَ كَلَاءَتَكَ، مِنْ وَرَائِيْ وَ اَمَامِيْ وَ عَنْ يَمِيْنِيْ وَ عَنْ شِمَالِيْ، وَ مِنْ فَوْقِيْ وَ مِنْ تَحْتِيْ، وَ حَوَالِيَّ حَتّٰى لَا يَصِلَ اَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمَخْلُوْقِيْنَ اِلٰى مَكْرُوْهِيْ وَ اَذَايَ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ اَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ، بَدِيْعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ، ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْاِكْرَامِ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْ حَسَدَ الْحَاسِدِيْنَ، وَ بَغْيَ الْبَاغِيْنَ، وَ كَيْدَ الْكَائِدِيْنَ، وَ مَكْرَ الْمَاكِرِيْنَ، وَ حِيْلَةَ الْمُحْتَالِيْنَ، وَ غِيْلَةَ الْمُغْتَالِيْنَ، وَ ظُلْمَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ، وَ جَوْرَ الْجَائِرِيْنَ، وَ اعْتِدَاءَ الْمُعْتَدِيْنَ، وَ سَخَطَ الْمُسْخِطِيْنَ، وَ تَشَحُّبَ الْمُتَشَحِّبِيْنَ، وَ صَوْلَةَ الصَّائِلِيْنَ، وَ اقْتِسَارَ الْمُقْتَسِرِيْنَ، وَ غَشْمَ الْغَاشِمِيْنَ، وَ خَبْطَ الْخَابِطِيْنَ، وَ سِعَايَةَ السَّاعِيْنَ، وَ نَمَامَةَ النَّمَّامِيْنَ، وَ سِحْرَ السَّحَرَةِ وَ الْمَرَدَةِ وَ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ، وَ جَوْرَ السَّلَاطِيْنِ وَ مَكْرُوْهَ الْعَالَمِيْنَ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْمَخْزُوْنِ الطَّيِّبِ الطَّاهِرِ، الَّذِيْ قَامَتْ بِهِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ، وَ اَشْرَقَتْ لَهُ الظُّلَمُ، وَ سَبَّحَتْ لَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَ وَجِلَتْ مِنْهُ الْقُلُوْبُ، وَ خَضَعَتْ لَهُ الرِّقَابُ، وَ اُحْيِيَتْ بِهِ الْمَوْتٰى: اَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِيْ كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ اَذْنَبْتُهٗ فِيْ ظُلَمِ اللَّيْلِ وَ ضَوْءِ النَّهَارِ، عَمْدًا اَوْ خَطَأً سِرًّا اَوْ عَلَانِيَةً، وَ اَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ يَقِيْنًا وَ هَدْيًا، وَ نُورًا وَ عِلْمًا وَ فَهْمًا حَتّٰى اُقِيْمَ كِتَابَكَ، وَ اُحِلَّ حَلَالَكَ، وَ اُحَرِّمَ حَرَامَكَ، وَ اُؤَدِّيَ فَرَائِضَكَ، وَ اُقِيْمَ سُنَّةَ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اَلْحِقْنِيْ بِصَالِحِ مَنْ مَضٰى، وَ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْ صَالِحِ مَنْ بَقِيَ وَ اخْتِمْ لِيْ عَمَلِيْ بِاَحْسَنِهٖ، اِنَّكَ غَفُوْرٌ رَحِيْمٌ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اِذَا فَنٰي عُمْرِيْ وَ تَصَرَّمَتْ اَيَّامَ حَيَاتِيْ، وَ كَانَ لَا بُدَّ لِيْ مِنْ لِقَائِكَ، فَاَسْاَلُكَ - يَا لَطِيْفُ - اَنْ‏‏ تُوْجِبَ لِيْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلًا يَغْبِطُنِيْ بِهِ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ وَ الْاٰخِرُوْنَ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اقْبَلْ مِدْحَتِيْ وَ الْتِهَافِيْ وَ ارْحَمْ ضَرَاعَتِيْ وَ هُتَافِيْ وَ اِقْرَارِيْ عَلٰى نَفْسِيْ وَ اعْتِرَافِيْ، فَقَدْ اَسْمَعْتُكَ صَوْتِيْ فِيْ الدَّاعِيْنَ، وَ خُشُوْعِيْ فِيْ الضَّارِعِيْنَ، وَ مِدْحَتِيْ فِيْ الْقَائِلِيْنَ، وَ تَسْبِيْحِيْ فِيْ الْمَادِحِيْنَ.
وَ اَنْتَ مُجِيْبُ الْمُضْطَرِّيْنَ، وَ مُغِيْثُ الْمُسْتَغِيْثِيْنَ، وَ غِيَاثُ الْمَلْهُوْفِيْنَ، وَ حِرْزُ الْهَارِبِيْنَ، وَ صَرِيْخُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ، وَ مُقِيْلُ الْمُذْنِبِيْنَ وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى الْبَشِيْرِ النَّذِيْرِ وَ السِّرَاجِ الْمُنِيْرِ، وَ عَلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَ النَّبِيِّيْنَ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ دَاحِيَ الْمَدْحُوَّاتِ، وَ بَارِءَ الْمَسْمُوْكَاتِ، وَ جَبَّالَ الْقُلُوْبِ عَلٰى فِطْرَتِهَا، شَقِيِّهَا وَ سَعِيْدِهَا.
اِجْعَلْ شَرَائِفَ صَلَوَاتِكَ، وَ نَوَامِيَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَ كَرَائِمَ تَحِيَّاتِكَ، عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُوْلِكَ وَ اَمِيْنِكَ عَلٰى وَحْيِكَ، الْقَائِمِ بِحُجَّتِكَ، وَ الذَّابِّ عَنْ حَرَمِكَ، وَ الصَّادِعِ بِاَمْرِكَ، وَ الْمُشَيِّدِ لِاٰيَاتِكَ وَ الْمُوْفِيْ لِنَذْرِكَ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاَعْطِهٖ بِكُلِّ فَضِيْلَةٍ مِنْ فَضَائِلِهٖ، وَ مَنْقَبَةٍ مِنْ مَنَاقِبِهٖ، وَ حَالٍ مِنْ اَحْوَالِهٖ، وَ مَنْزِلَةٍ مِنْ مَنَازِلِهٖ، رَاَيْتَ مُحَمَّدًا لَكَ فِيْهَا نَاصِرًا، وَ عَلٰى مَكْرُوْهِ بَلَائِكَ صَابِرًا، وَ لِمَنْ عَادَاكَ مُعَادِيًا، وَ لِمَنْ وَالَاكَ مُوَالِيًا وَ عَمَّا كَرِهْتَ نَائِيًا، وَ اِلٰى مَا اَحْبَبْتَ دَاعِيًا.
فَضَائِلَ مِنْ جَزَائِكَ وَ خَصَائِصَ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ وَ حِبَائِكَ، تُسْنِيْ بِهَا اَمْرَهٗ، وَ تُعْلِيْ بِهَا دَرَجَتَهٗ مَعَ الْقُوَّامِ بِقِسْطِكَ، وَ الذَّابِّيْنَ عَنْ حَرَمِكَ حَتّٰى لَا يَبْقٰى سَنَاءٌ وَ لَا بَهَاءٌ وَ لَا رَحْمَةٌ وَ لَا كَرَامَةٌ اِلَّا خَصَصْتَ مُحَمَّدًا بِذٰلِكَ، وَ اٰتَيْتَهٗ مِنْكَ الذُّرٰى وَ بَلَّغْتَهُ الْمَقَامَاتِ الْعُلٰى، اٰمِيْنَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْتَوْدِعُكَ دِيْنِيْ وَ نَفْسِيْ وَ جَمِيْعَ نِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، فَاجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْ كَنَفِكَ وَ حِفْظِكَ، وَ عِزِّكَ وَ مَنْعِكَ.
عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَ تَقَدَّسَتْ اَسْمَاؤُكَ، وَ لَا اِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ حَسْبِيْ اَنْتَ فِيْ السَّرَّاءِ وَ الضَّرَّاءِ وَ الشِّدَّةِ وَ الرَّخَاءِ، وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ.
رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَاِلَيْكَ اَنَبْنَا وَاِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيْرُ۝۴ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَۃً لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ اغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا۝۰ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ۝۵ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ۝۰ۤۖ اِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا۝۶۵ۤۖ اِنَّهَا سَاۗءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَّ مُقَامًا۝۶۶
رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفٰتِحِيْنَ۝۸۹
رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَ كَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّاٰتِنَا وَ تَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْاَبْرَارِ۝۱۹۳ۚ رَبَّنَا وَ اٰتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَّنَا عَلٰي رُسُلِكَ وَ لَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَۃِ۝۰ۭ اِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ۝۱۹۴
رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ اِنْ نَّسِيْنَآ اَوْ اَخْطَاْنَا۝۰ۚ رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ اِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهٗ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا۝۰ۚ رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَۃَ لَنَا بِهٖ۝۰ۚ وَ اعْفُ عَنَّا۝۰۪ وَ اغْفِرْ لَنَا۝۰۪ وَ ارْحَمْنَا۝۰۪ اَنْتَ مَوْلٰىنَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَي الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ۝۲۸۶ۧ
رَبَّنَآ اٰتِنَا فِيْ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَۃً وَّ فِيْ الْاٰخِرَۃِ حَسَنَۃً وَّ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ۝۲۰۱
وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا.
entries.translation_en:
O Allah, I have no knowledge of the place of my provision; I only seek it through thoughts that occur to my heart, so I wander through the lands in seeking it. In what I seek, I am like the bewildered one: I do not know whether it is in a plain or on a mountain, on land or in the sky, on dry land or in the sea, at whose hands it is, and from whom it comes. But I have known that its knowledge is with You, its causes are in Your hand, and You are the one who divides it by Your gentleness and brings it about by Your mercy. O Allah, so send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household, and make, O Lord, Your provision for me wide, its seeking easy, and its source near; and do not torment me by seeking what You have not decreed as provision for me — for You have no need of my torment, and I am poor towards Your mercy. So send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household, and be generous to Your servant from Your grace; indeed, You are the Possessor of great grace.
O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and what they shade, Lord of the seven earths and what they bear, Lord of the devils and what they have led astray, and Lord of the winds and what they scatter. O Allah, Lord of all things, God of all things, and Sovereign of all things: You are Allah, the All-Powerful over all things. You are Allah, the First, so there is nothing before You; You are the Last, so there is nothing after You; You are the Manifest, so there is nothing above You; and You are the Hidden, so there is nothing beneath You. Lord of Gabriel, Michael and Israfil; God of Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob and the Tribes: I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, to take charge of me by Your mercy, and not to give power over me to any of Your creation whom I cannot withstand.
O Allah, I endear myself to You, so make me beloved; and among the people, make me honoured; and from the evil of the devils of jinn and mankind, keep me safe. O Lord of the worlds! And send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household.
O Abaser of every tyrant and Honourer of every abased one: by Your right, I have reached the limit of my striving. (Then the Wutayrah prayer is prayed: in its first unit, al-Fatiha, Ayat al-Kursi and Surah al-Kafirun; in its second, al-Fatiha and Surah al-Ikhlas thirteen times.)
O Allah, I ask You, O He whom the eyes do not see, conjecture does not encompass, and the describers do not describe; O He whom the epochs do not change, the ages do not wear out, and events do not alter; O He who does not taste death and does not fear missing out; O He whom the sins do not harm and forgiveness does not diminish: send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household; grant me what does not diminish You; forgive me what does not harm You; and do for me (here mention your need), and I ask You for my need. (It is narrated from him, peace be upon him: whoever prays it, Allah builds for him a house in Paradise; and the two units are a bringer of provision. This is most likely the Wutayrah prayer.)
(After the prayer:) O Allah, grant us well-being from every affliction of this world; turn away from us the evil of this world and the evil of the Hereafter; and grant us the good of this world and the good of the Hereafter — by Your grace and Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
O Allah, this is my prayer; I have prayed it — not because You have need of it, nor desire for it — but in magnification, obedience, and answer to what You commanded me. My God, if there was in it any flaw or deficiency, do not take me to task for it; bestow on me acceptance and forgiveness.
(Then the litanies of praise:) Glory be to the One before whose greatness everything is humbled; glory be to the One in whose might everything is abased; glory be to the One to whose command and kingdom everything has submitted; glory be to the One to whom all matters have surrendered their reins.
All praise belongs to Allah, who does not forget whoever remembers Him; all praise belongs to Allah, who does not disappoint whoever calls Him; all praise belongs to Allah, with whom whoever relies upon Him — He suffices him.
All praise belongs to Allah, Raiser of the sky, Spreader of the earth, Confiner of the seas, Layerer of the mountains, Creator of the animals, Maker of the trees, Opener of the springs of the earth, Disposer of the affairs, Mover of the clouds, Runner of the wind, the water and the fire from the depths of the earth, racing through the air, and Sender-down of heat and cold — by whose blessing the righteous deeds are completed, by gratitude to whom increases are deserved, by whose command the heavens stood, by whose might the anchored (mountains) settled, and the wild beasts in the deserts glorified (Him), and the birds in their nests.
All praise belongs to Allah, Exalted in degrees, Sender-down of the verses, Wide in blessings, Concealer of faults, Acceptor of good deeds, Pardoner of stumbles, Reliever of sorrows, Sender-down of blessings, Answerer of prayers, Reviver of the dead, God of whoever is on earth and in the heavens.
All praise belongs to Allah for every praise and remembrance, gratitude and patience, prayer and alms, standing and worship, felicity and blessing, increase and mercy, favour and honour, obligation, in ease and hardship, in difficulty and prosperity, in calamity and affliction, in hardship and ease, in riches and poverty, in every state, in every era and time, and in every dwelling, return and station.
O Allah, I am one who seeks Your protection, so protect me; one who seeks Your refuge, so shelter me; one who seeks Your help, so help me; one who cries to You for rescue, so rescue me; one who calls You, so answer me; one who seeks Your forgiveness, so forgive me; one who seeks Your support, so support me; one who seeks Your guidance, so guide me; one who asks Your sufficiency, so suffice me; one who takes refuge with You, so shelter me; one who holds fast to Your rope, so preserve me; one who relies upon You, so suffice me; and place me in Your protection, Your neighbourhood, Your stronghold, Your cave, Your guarding, Your watchfulness, Your care, Your sanctity and Your security, beneath Your shade and beneath Your wing; and place over me a protecting shield from You. And place Your protection, guarding, watchfulness and care behind me, before me, on my right, on my left, above me, beneath me, and all around me, so that none of the creatures can reach harm or injury to me. There is no god but You; You are the Bestower, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Possessor of Majesty and Honour.
O Allah, suffice me against the envy of the enviers, the tyranny of the tyrants, the plotting of the plotters, the scheming of the schemers, the trickery of the tricksters, the treachery of the treacherous, the injustice of the unjust, the oppression of the oppressors, the transgression of the transgressors, the anger of the anger-provokers, the hostility of the hostile, the onslaught of the attackers, the compulsion of the compellers, the violence of the violent, the stumbling of the stumblers, and the tale-bearing of the tale-bearers...
(Then blessings are asked for the Prophet, may Allah bless him and his Household: that for every virtue of his virtues, every merit of his merits, every state of his states and every station of his stations in which You saw Muhammad as a supporter of You, patient under Your hateful affliction, hostile to whoever was hostile to You, a friend to whoever befriended You, distant from what You disliked, and a caller to what You loved — You give him, of Your reward, of the choicest of Your gifts and Your presents, that by which You raise his affair and elevate his rank, together with those who uphold Your justice and defend Your sanctuary — until no splendour, no radiance, no mercy and no honour remains except that You have singled Muhammad out with it, and given him from You progeny, and raised him to the highest stations. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.)
O Allah, I entrust to You my religion, my soul, and all Your blessings upon me; so place me in Your keeping, Your protection, Your might and Your invincibility. Mighty is the one under Your protection; glorious is Your praise; sanctified are Your Names; and there is no god other than You. You suffice me in ease and hardship, in difficulty and prosperity; and You are the best of trustees.
"Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have turned, and to You is the destination. Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord; indeed, You are the Mighty, the Wise." (60:4-5) "Our Lord, turn away from us the punishment of Hell; indeed, its punishment is inseparable; indeed, it is an evil abode and residence." (25:65-66) "Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of deciders." (7:89) "Our Lord, forgive us our sins, erase from us our evil deeds, and take us (in death) with the righteous. Our Lord, give us what You promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection; indeed, You do not break the promise." (3:193-194) "Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or err. Our Lord, do not lay upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us; You are our Master, so help us against the disbelieving people." (2:286) "Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and shield us from the punishment of the Fire." (2:201) And may Allah bless our master Muhammad, the Prophet, and his pure Household, and grant them peace.
entries.note_en: Begin with the Common Ta'qibat (including Tasbihat al-Zahra), then these litanies specific to the Isha prayer, including the Wutayrah prayer and the Quranic 'Our Lord...' verses.

entries.arabic:
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ عَلَيْهَا السَّلامُ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَيَّامِ فَقَالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا فَاطِمَةُ، فَقُلْتُ: عَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ، قَالَ: إِنِّي أَجِدُ فِي بَدَنِي ضَعْفًا، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: أُعِيذُكَ بِاللَّهِ يَا أَبَتَاهُ مِنَ الضُّعْفِ، فَقَالَ: يَا فَاطِمَةُ ائْتِينِي بِالْكِسَاءِ الْيَمَانِيِّ فَغَطِّينِي بِهِ، فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِالْكِسَاءِ الْيَمَانِيِّ فَغَطَّيْتُهُ بِهِ وَصِرْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ وَإِذَا وَجْهُهُ يَتَلَأْلَأُ كَأَنَّهُ الْبَدْرُ فِي لَيْلَةِ تَمَامِهِ وَكَمَالِهِ.
فَمَا كَانَتْ إِلَّا سَاعَةً وَإِذَا بِوَلَدِيَ الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَدْ أَقْبَلَ وَقَالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّاهُ، فَقُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِي وَثَمَرَةَ فُؤَادِي، فَقَالَ: يَا أُمَّاهُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رَائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً كَأَنَّهَا رَائِحَةُ جَدِّي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ إِنَّ جَدَّكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ، فَأَقْبَلَ الْحَسَنُ نَحْوَ الْكِسَاءِ وَقَالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَدَّاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَدْخُلَ مَعَكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ؟ فَقَالَ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي وَيَا صَاحِبَ حَوْضِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ، فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ.
فَمَا كَانَتْ إِلَّا سَاعَةً وَإِذَا بِوَلَدِيَ الْحُسَيْنِ قَدْ أَقْبَلَ وَقَالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّاهُ، فَقُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي وَيَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِي وَثَمَرَةَ فُؤَادِي، فَقَالَ لِي: يَا أُمَّاهُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رَائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً كَأَنَّهَا رَائِحَةُ جَدِّي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ إِنَّ جَدَّكَ وَأَخَاكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ، فَدَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ نَحْوَ الْكِسَاءِ وَقَالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَدَّاهُ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنِ اخْتَارَهُ اللَّهُ، أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُمَا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ؟ فَقَالَ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي وَيَا شَافِعَ أُمَّتِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ، فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُمَا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ.
فَأَقْبَلَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَقَالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، فَقُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَبَا الْحَسَنِ وَيَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، فَقَالَ: يَا فَاطِمَةُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رَائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً كَأَنَّهَا رَائِحَةُ أَخِي وَابْنِ عَمِّي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ هَا هُوَ مَعَ وَلَدَيْكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ، فَأَقْبَلَ عَلِيٌّ نَحْوَ الْكِسَاءِ وَقَالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ؟ قَالَ لَهُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَخِي وَيَا وَصِيِّي وَخَلِيفَتِي وَصَاحِبَ لِوَائِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ، فَدَخَلَ عَلِيٌّ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ.
ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ نَحْوَ الْكِسَاءِ وَقُلْتُ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَتَاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ؟ قَالَ: وَعَلَيْكِ السَّلامُ يَا بِنْتِي وَيَا بِضْعَتِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكِ، فَدَخَلْتُ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ.
فَلَمَّا اكْتَمَلْنَا جَمِيعًا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ أَخَذَ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ بِطَرَفَيِ الْكِسَاءِ وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ أَهْلُ بَيْتِي وَخَاصَّتِي وَحَامَّتِي، لَحْمُهُمْ لَحْمِي وَدَمُهُمْ دَمِي، يُؤْلِمُنِي مَا يُؤْلِمُهُمْ وَيَحْزُنُنِي مَا يَحْزُنُهُمْ، أَنَا حَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حَارَبَهُمْ وَسِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سَالَمَهُمْ وَعَدُوٌّ لِمَنْ عَادَاهُمْ وَمُحِبٌّ لِمَنْ أَحَبَّهُمْ، إِنَّهُمْ مِنِّي وَأَنَا مِنْهُمْ، فَاجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ وَغُفْرَانَكَ وَرِضْوَانَكَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَأَذْهِبْ عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْسَ وَطَهِّرْهُمْ تَطْهِيرًا.
فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: يَا مَلَائِكَتِي وَيَا سُكَّانَ سَمَاوَاتِي، إِنِّي مَا خَلَقْتُ سَمَاءً مَبْنِيَّةً وَلَا أَرْضًا مَدْحِيَّةً وَلَا قَمَرًا مُنِيرًا وَلَا شَمْسًا مُضِيئَةً وَلَا فَلَكًا يَدُورُ وَلَا بَحْرًا يَجْرِي وَلَا فُلْكًا يَسْرِي إِلَّا فِي مَحَبَّةِ هَؤُلَاءِ الْخَمْسَةِ الَّذِينَ هُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ.
فَقَالَ الْأَمِينُ جِبْرَائِيلُ: يَا رَبِّ وَمَنْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ؟ فَقَالَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: هُمْ أَهْلُ بَيْتِ النُّبُوَّةِ وَمَعْدِنُ الرِّسَالَةِ، هُمْ فَاطِمَةُ وَأَبُوهَا وَبَعْلُهَا وَبَنُوهَا.
فَقَالَ جِبْرَائِيلُ: يَا رَبِّ أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَهْبِطَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ لِأَكُونَ مَعَهُمْ سَادِسًا؟ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ: نَعَمْ قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ، فَهَبَطَ الْأَمِينُ جِبْرَائِيلُ وَقَالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، الْعَلِيُّ الْأَعْلَى يُقْرِئُكَ السَّلامَ وَيَخُصُّكَ بِالتَّحِيَّةِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ وَيَقُولُ لَكَ: وَعِزَّتِي وَجَلَالِي إِنِّي مَا خَلَقْتُ سَمَاءً مَبْنِيَّةً وَلَا أَرْضًا مَدْحِيَّةً وَلَا قَمَرًا مُنِيرًا وَلَا شَمْسًا مُضِيئَةً وَلَا فَلَكًا يَدُورُ وَلَا بَحْرًا يَجْرِي وَلَا فُلْكًا يَسْرِي إِلَّا لِأَجْلِكُمْ وَمَحَبَّتِكُمْ، وَقَدْ أَذِنَ لِي أَنْ أَدْخُلَ مَعَكُمْ، فَهَلْ تَأْذَنُ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَمِينَ وَحْيِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّهُ نَعَمْ قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ، فَدَخَلَ جِبْرَائِيلُ مَعَنَا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ.
فَقَالَ لِأَبِي: إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَوْحَى إِلَيْكُمْ يَقُولُ: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا.
فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ لِأَبِي: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي مَا لِجُلُوسِنَا هَذَا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ مِنَ الْفَضْلِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: وَالَّذِي بَعَثَنِي بِالْحَقِّ نَبِيًّا وَاصْطَفَانِي بِالرِّسَالَةِ نَجِيًّا، مَا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنَا هَذَا فِي مَحْفِلٍ مِنْ مَحَافِلِ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ وَفِيهِ جَمْعٌ مِنْ شِيعَتِنَا وَمُحِبِّينَا إِلَّا وَنَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الرَّحْمَةُ وَحَفَّتْ بِهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَاسْتَغْفَرَتْ لَهُمْ إِلَى أَنْ يَتَفَرَّقُوا.
فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: إِذَنْ وَاللَّهِ فُزْنَا وَفَازَ شِيعَتُنَا وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ.
فَقَالَ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: يَا عَلِيُّ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَنِي بِالْحَقِّ نَبِيًّا وَاصْطَفَانِي بِالرِّسَالَةِ نَجِيًّا، مَا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنَا هَذَا فِي مَحْفِلٍ مِنْ مَحَافِلِ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ وَفِيهِ جَمْعٌ مِنْ شِيعَتِنَا وَمُحِبِّينَا وَفِيهِمْ مَهْمُومٌ إِلَّا وَفَرَّجَ اللَّهُ هَمَّهُ، وَلَا مَغْمُومٌ إِلَّا وَكَشَفَ اللَّهُ غَمَّهُ، وَلَا طَالِبُ حَاجَةٍ إِلَّا وَقَضَى اللَّهُ حَاجَتَهُ.
فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: إِذَنْ وَاللَّهِ فُزْنَا وَسُعِدْنَا وَكَذَلِكَ شِيعَتُنَا فَازُوا وَسُعِدُوا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ.
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
entries.translation_en:
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Fatima al-Zahra, daughter of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon them, narrated: One day my father, the Messenger of Allah, came to me and said, 'Peace be upon you, O Fatima.' I replied, 'And peace be upon you.' He said, 'I feel weakness in my body.' I said to him, 'May Allah protect you from weakness, dear father.' He said, 'O Fatima, bring me the Yemeni cloak and cover me with it.' So I brought the Yemeni cloak and covered him with it, and as I looked at him his face shone like the full moon on the night of its perfection.
After a short while my son Hasan came and said, 'Peace be upon you, mother.' I replied, 'And peace be upon you, O delight of my eyes and fruit of my heart.' He said, 'Mother, I smell a sweet fragrance near you, as if it were the fragrance of my grandfather, the Messenger of Allah.' I said, 'Yes, your grandfather is beneath the cloak.' Hasan went to the cloak and said, 'Peace be upon you, my grandfather, O Messenger of Allah. Do you allow me to enter beneath the cloak with you?' He replied, 'And peace be upon you, my son and master of my Fountain. I allow you.' So he entered beneath the cloak with him.
After a short while my son Husayn came and said, 'Peace be upon you, mother.' I replied, 'And peace be upon you, my son, O delight of my eyes and fruit of my heart.' He said to me, 'Mother, I smell a sweet fragrance near you, as if it were the fragrance of my grandfather, the Messenger of Allah.' I said, 'Yes, your grandfather and your brother are beneath the cloak.' Husayn stepped towards the cloak and said, 'Peace be upon you, my grandfather. Peace be upon you, O one whom Allah chose. Do you allow me to be with you both beneath the cloak?' He replied, 'And peace be upon you, my son and intercessor of my community. I allow you.' So he entered beneath the cloak with them both.
Then Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Abi Talib came and said, 'Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Messenger of Allah.' I replied, 'And peace be upon you, O father of Hasan and Commander of the Faithful.' He said, 'O Fatima, I smell a sweet fragrance near you, as if it were the fragrance of my brother and cousin, the Messenger of Allah.' I said, 'Yes, he is beneath the cloak with your two sons.' Ali went to the cloak and said, 'Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah. Do you allow me to be with you beneath the cloak?' He replied to him, 'And peace be upon you, my brother, my successor, my caliph and bearer of my banner. I allow you.' So Ali entered beneath the cloak.
Then I came towards the cloak and said, 'Peace be upon you, my father, O Messenger of Allah. Do you allow me to be with you beneath the cloak?' He said, 'And peace be upon you, my daughter and part of myself. I allow you.' So I entered beneath the cloak.
When we were all gathered beneath the cloak, my father, the Messenger of Allah, took hold of the two ends of the cloak, raised his right hand towards the sky and said, 'O Allah, these are my Household, my closest ones and my kin. Their flesh is my flesh and their blood is my blood. What pains them pains me, and what grieves them grieves me. I am at war with whoever wages war on them, at peace with whoever is at peace with them, an enemy to whoever shows enmity to them, and a lover of whoever loves them. They are from me and I am from them. So place Your blessings, Your favours, Your mercy, Your forgiveness and Your pleasure upon me and upon them, and remove all impurity from them and purify them completely.'
Then Allah, mighty and majestic, said, 'O My angels and O dwellers of My heavens, I did not create a raised sky, nor a spread-out earth, nor a shining moon, nor a radiant sun, nor a revolving orbit, nor a flowing sea, nor a sailing ship, except out of love for these five who are beneath the cloak.'
The trustworthy Gabriel said, 'My Lord, who is beneath the cloak?' Allah, mighty and majestic, replied, 'They are the Household of Prophethood and the source of the Message. They are Fatima, her father, her husband and her sons.'
Gabriel said, 'My Lord, do You allow me to descend to the earth to be a sixth with them?' Allah said, 'Yes, I allow you.' So the trustworthy Gabriel descended and said, 'Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah. The Most High conveys His peace to you and greets you with honour, and says to you: By My might and My majesty, I did not create a raised sky, nor a spread-out earth, nor a shining moon, nor a radiant sun, nor a revolving orbit, nor a flowing sea, nor a sailing ship, except for your sake and out of love for you. And He has allowed me to enter with you. Do you allow me, O Messenger of Allah?' The Messenger of Allah said, 'And peace be upon you, O trusted bearer of Allah's revelation. Yes, I allow you.' So Gabriel entered beneath the cloak with us.
He then said to my father, 'Allah has revealed to you, saying: Allah only wishes to remove all impurity from you, O People of the Household, and to purify you completely.'
Ali said to my father, 'O Messenger of Allah, tell me what reward there is with Allah for this gathering of ours beneath the cloak?' The Prophet said, 'By Him who sent me with the truth as a prophet and chose me as a messenger for intimate converse: whenever this account of ours is mentioned in any gathering of the people of the earth in which there is a group of our followers and lovers, mercy descends upon them, angels surround them, and they seek forgiveness for them until they disperse.'
Ali said, 'Then, by Allah, we have triumphed, and our followers have triumphed, by the Lord of the Kaaba.'
Then my father, the Messenger of Allah, said, 'O Ali, by Him who sent me with the truth as a prophet and chose me as a messenger for intimate converse: whenever this account of ours is mentioned in any gathering of the people of the earth in which there is a group of our followers and lovers, and among them is someone in distress, Allah will relieve his distress; and no one in grief but Allah will remove his grief; and no seeker of a need but Allah will fulfil his need.'
Ali said, 'Then, by Allah, we have triumphed and found happiness, and likewise our followers have triumphed and found happiness in this world and the Hereafter, by the Lord of the Kaaba.'
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
entries.translation_ur:
اے اللہ! محمد اور آلِ محمد پر درود بھیج۔
اللہ کے نام سے جو بڑا مہربان، نہایت رحم والا ہے۔
حضرت فاطمہ زہرا سلام اللہ علیہا، رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم کی بیٹی، نے فرمایا: ایک دن میرے والد، رسول اللہ، میرے پاس تشریف لائے اور فرمایا: 'اے فاطمہ! تم پر سلام ہو۔' میں نے عرض کیا: 'آپ پر بھی سلام ہو۔' آپ نے فرمایا: 'میں اپنے بدن میں کمزوری محسوس کر رہا ہوں۔' میں نے عرض کیا: 'ابا جان! اللہ آپ کو کمزوری سے محفوظ رکھے۔' آپ نے فرمایا: 'اے فاطمہ! یمنی چادر لاؤ اور مجھے اس سے ڈھانپ دو۔' میں یمنی چادر لائی اور آپ کو اس سے ڈھانپ دیا، اور میں آپ کی طرف دیکھ رہی تھی کہ آپ کا چہرہ چودھویں رات کے چاند کی طرح چمک رہا تھا۔
تھوڑی دیر بعد میرے بیٹے حسن آئے اور فرمایا: 'اماں! آپ پر سلام ہو۔' میں نے عرض کیا: 'آپ پر بھی سلام ہو، اے میری آنکھوں کی ٹھنڈک اور میرے دل کے پھل!' انہوں نے فرمایا: 'اماں! میں آپ کے پاس ایک خوشبو محسوس کر رہا ہوں، گویا یہ میرے نانا رسول اللہ کی خوشبو ہے۔' میں نے کہا: 'ہاں، آپ کے نانا چادر کے نیچے ہیں۔' حسن چادر کی طرف بڑھے اور فرمایا: 'نانا جان! اے رسول اللہ! آپ پر سلام ہو۔ کیا آپ اجازت دیتے ہیں کہ میں آپ کے ساتھ چادر کے نیچے آ جاؤں؟' آپ نے فرمایا: 'بیٹے! اور میرے حوض کے مالک! تم پر بھی سلام ہو، میں نے اجازت دی۔' پس وہ آپ کے ساتھ چادر کے نیچے داخل ہو گئے۔
تھوڑی دیر بعد میرے بیٹے حسین آئے اور فرمایا: 'اماں! آپ پر سلام ہو۔' میں نے عرض کیا: 'بیٹے! اور میری آنکھوں کی ٹھنڈک اور میرے دل کے پھل! آپ پر بھی سلام ہو۔' انہوں نے فرمایا: 'اماں! میں آپ کے پاس ایک خوشبو محسوس کر رہا ہوں، گویا یہ میرے نانا رسول اللہ کی خوشبو ہے۔' میں نے کہا: 'ہاں، آپ کے نانا اور آپ کے بھائی چادر کے نیچے ہیں۔' حسین چادر کی طرف بڑھے اور فرمایا: 'نانا جان! آپ پر سلام ہو، اے وہ جنہیں اللہ نے چن لیا! کیا آپ اجازت دیتے ہیں کہ میں آپ دونوں کے ساتھ چادر کے نیچے آ جاؤں؟' آپ نے فرمایا: 'بیٹے! اور میری امت کے شفاعت کرنے والے! تم پر بھی سلام ہو، میں نے اجازت دی۔' پس وہ ان دونوں کے ساتھ چادر کے نیچے داخل ہو گئے۔
پھر ابو الحسن علی بن ابی طالب تشریف لائے اور فرمایا: 'اے رسول اللہ کی بیٹی! آپ پر سلام ہو۔' میں نے عرض کیا: 'اے ابو الحسن! اور اے امیر المؤمنین! آپ پر بھی سلام ہو۔' انہوں نے فرمایا: 'اے فاطمہ! میں آپ کے پاس ایک خوشبو محسوس کر رہا ہوں، گویا یہ میرے بھائی اور چچا زاد رسول اللہ کی خوشبو ہے۔' میں نے کہا: 'ہاں، وہ آپ کے دونوں بیٹوں کے ساتھ چادر کے نیچے ہیں۔' علی چادر کی طرف بڑھے اور فرمایا: 'اے رسول اللہ! آپ پر سلام ہو۔ کیا آپ اجازت دیتے ہیں کہ میں آپ کے ساتھ چادر کے نیچے آ جاؤں؟' آپ نے فرمایا: 'میرے بھائی! اور میرے وصی! اور میرے خلیفہ! اور میرے علمبردار! تم پر بھی سلام ہو، میں نے اجازت دی۔' پس علی چادر کے نیچے داخل ہو گئے۔
پھر میں چادر کی طرف بڑھی اور عرض کیا: 'ابا جان! اے رسول اللہ! آپ پر سلام ہو۔ کیا آپ اجازت دیتے ہیں کہ میں آپ کے ساتھ چادر کے نیچے آ جاؤں؟' آپ نے فرمایا: 'بیٹی! اور میرے جگر کے ٹکڑے! تم پر بھی سلام ہو، میں نے اجازت دی۔' پس میں چادر کے نیچے داخل ہو گئی۔
جب ہم سب چادر کے نیچے جمع ہو گئے تو میرے والد رسول اللہ نے چادر کے دونوں کنارے پکڑے، اپنا دایاں ہاتھ آسمان کی طرف اٹھایا اور فرمایا: 'اے اللہ! یہ میرے اہلِ بیت ہیں، میرے خاص اور میرے قریبی لوگ۔ ان کا گوشت میرا گوشت ہے اور ان کا خون میرا خون ہے۔ جو انہیں تکلیف دے وہ مجھے تکلیف دیتا ہے، اور جو انہیں غمگین کرے وہ مجھے غمگین کرتا ہے۔ میں اس سے جنگ میں ہوں جو ان سے جنگ کرے، اور اس سے صلح میں ہوں جو ان سے صلح کرے، اور اس کا دشمن ہوں جو ان کا دشمن ہو، اور اس کا دوست ہوں جو ان کا دوست ہو۔ وہ مجھ سے ہیں اور میں ان سے ہوں۔ پس اپنی درودیں، برکتیں، رحمت، مغفرت اور رضا مجھ پر اور ان پر نازل فرما، اور ان سے ہر ناپاکی دور کر دے اور انہیں پوری طرح پاک کر دے۔'
پھر اللہ عز و جل نے فرمایا: 'اے میرے فرشتو! اور اے میرے آسمانوں کے رہنے والو! میں نے نہ کوئی بلند آسمان بنایا، نہ پھیلی ہوئی زمین، نہ روشن چاند، نہ چمکتا سورج، نہ گھومتا فلک، نہ بہتا سمندر، نہ چلتی کشتی، مگر ان پانچ کی محبت میں جو چادر کے نیچے ہیں۔'
امین جبرائیل نے عرض کیا: 'اے میرے رب! چادر کے نیچے کون ہیں؟' اللہ عز و جل نے فرمایا: 'وہ نبوت کے گھرانے والے اور رسالت کے سرچشمے ہیں۔ وہ فاطمہ، ان کے والد، ان کے شوہر اور ان کے بیٹے ہیں۔'
جبرائیل نے عرض کیا: 'اے میرے رب! کیا آپ مجھے اجازت دیتے ہیں کہ میں زمین پر اتروں اور ان کے ساتھ چھٹا ہو جاؤں؟' اللہ نے فرمایا: 'ہاں، میں نے اجازت دی۔' پس امین جبرائیل اترے اور فرمایا: 'اے رسول اللہ! آپ پر سلام ہو۔ بلند و برتر اللہ آپ کو سلام پہنچاتا ہے اور آپ کو تحیت و اکرام سے مخصوص کرتا ہے اور آپ سے فرماتا ہے: مجھے اپنی عزت و جلال کی قسم! میں نے نہ کوئی بلند آسمان بنایا، نہ پھیلی ہوئی زمین، نہ روشن چاند، نہ چمکتا سورج، نہ گھومتا فلک، نہ بہتا سمندر، نہ چلتی کشتی، مگر تمہاری خاطر اور تمہاری محبت میں۔ اور اس نے مجھے اجازت دی ہے کہ میں تمہارے ساتھ داخل ہو جاؤں۔ اے رسول اللہ! کیا آپ مجھے اجازت دیتے ہیں؟' رسول اللہ نے فرمایا: 'اے اللہ کی وحی کے امین! تم پر بھی سلام ہو، ہاں، میں نے اجازت دی۔' پس جبرائیل ہمارے ساتھ چادر کے نیچے داخل ہو گئے۔
پھر انہوں نے میرے والد سے کہا: 'اللہ نے تمہاری طرف وحی کی ہے، وہ فرماتا ہے: اللہ تو بس یہ چاہتا ہے کہ اے اہلِ بیت! تم سے ہر ناپاکی دور کر دے اور تمہیں پوری طرح پاک کر دے۔'
علی نے میرے والد سے عرض کیا: 'اے رسول اللہ! مجھے بتائیے کہ چادر کے نیچے ہمارے اس بیٹھنے کا اللہ کے نزدیک کیا فضل ہے؟' نبی نے فرمایا: 'اس ذات کی قسم جس نے مجھے حق کے ساتھ نبی بنا کر بھیجا اور رسالت کے لیے برگزیدہ کیا: جب بھی زمین کے کسی مجلس میں ہمارا یہ واقعہ ذکر کیا جائے اور وہاں ہمارے شیعوں اور محبوں کی جماعت موجود ہو، تو ان پر رحمت نازل ہوتی ہے، فرشتے انہیں گھیر لیتے ہیں اور ان کے منتشر ہونے تک ان کے لیے استغفار کرتے رہتے ہیں۔'
علی نے فرمایا: 'پس اللہ کی قسم! ہم کامیاب ہو گئے اور ہمارے شیعہ بھی کامیاب ہو گئے، کعبے کے رب کی قسم!'
پھر میرے والد رسول اللہ نے فرمایا: 'اے علی! اس ذات کی قسم جس نے مجھے حق کے ساتھ نبی بنا کر بھیجا اور رسالت کے لیے برگزیدہ کیا: جب بھی زمین کے کسی مجلس میں ہمارا یہ واقعہ ذکر کیا جائے اور وہاں ہمارے شیعوں اور محبوں کی جماعت موجود ہو، اور ان میں کوئی غمگین ہو تو اللہ اس کا غم دور کر دے گا، اور کوئی پریشان ہو تو اللہ اس کی پریشانی دور کر دے گا، اور کوئی حاجت مند ہو تو اللہ اس کی حاجت پوری کر دے گا۔'
علی نے فرمایا: 'پس اللہ کی قسم! ہم کامیاب ہو گئے اور خوش نصیب ہوئے، اور اسی طرح ہمارے شیعہ بھی دنیا و آخرت میں کامیاب و خوش نصیب ہوئے، کعبے کے رب کی قسم!'
اے اللہ! محمد اور آلِ محمد پر درود بھیج۔
