وَالحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي أُنادِيهِ كُلَّما شِئْتُ لِحاجَتِي،
وأَخْلُوبِهِ حَيْثُ شِئْتُ لِسرِّي بِغَيْرِ شَفِيعٍ فَيَقْضِي لِي حاجَتِي،
الحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي لا أَدْعُوغَيْرَهُ وَلَوْ دَعَوْتُ غَيْرَهُ لَمْ يَسْتَجِبْ لِي دُعائِي،
وَالحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي لا أَرْجو غَيْرَهُ وَلَوْ رَجَوْتُ غَيْرَهُ لأخْلَفَ رَجائِي،
وَالحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي وَكَلَنِي إِلَيْهِ فَأَكْرَمَنِي وَلَمْ يَكِلْنِي إِلى النّاسِ فَيُهِينُونِي،
وَالحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي تَحَبَّبَ إِلَيَّ وَهُوَ غَنِيُّ عَنِّي،
وَالحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي يَحْلُمُ عَنِّي حَتَّى كَأَنِّي لاذَنْبَ لِي،
فَرَبِّي أَحْمَدُ شَيْءٍ عِنْدِي وَأَحَقُّ بِحَمْدِي.
اللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَجِدُ سُبُلَ المَطالِبِ إِلَيْكَ مُشْرَعَةٌ،
وَمَناهِلَ الرَّجاءِ إِلَيْكَ مُتْرَعَةٌ،
وَالاِسْتِعانَةَ بِفَضْلِكَ لِمَنْ أَمَّلَكَ مُباحَةً،
وَأَبْوابَ الدُّعاءِ إِلَيْكَ لِلصَّارِخِينَ مَفْتُوحَةً،
وأَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ لِلرَّاجِين بِمَوْضِعِ إِجابَةٍ،
وَلِلْمَلْهُوفِينَ بِمَرْصَدِ إِغاثَةٍ،
وَأَنَّ فِي اللَّهْفِ إِلى جُودِكَ وَالرِّضا بِقَضائِكَ عِوَضاً مِنْ مَنْعِ الباخِلِينَ،
وَمَنْدُوَحَةً عَمّا فِي أَيْدِي المُسْتَأْثِرِينَ،
وَانَّ الرَّاحِلَ إِلَيْكَ قَرِيبُ المَسافَةِ،
وأَنَّكَ لاتَحْتَجِبُ عَنْ خَلْقِكَ إِلاّ أَنْ تَحْجُبَهُمُ الاَعْمالُ دُوَنَكَ،
وَقَدْ قَصَدْتُ إِلَيْكَ بِطَلِبَتِي،
وتَوَجَّهْتُ إِلَيْكَ بِحاجَتِي،
وَجَعَلْتُ بِكَ اسْتِغاثَتِي وَبِدُعائِكَ تَوَسُّلِي،
مِنْ غَيِرِ اسْتِحْقاقٍ لاسْتِماعِكَ مِنِّي وَلا اسْتِيجابٍ لِعَفْوِكَ عَنِّي،
بَلْ لِثِقَتِي بِكَرَمِكَ،
وَسُكُونِي إِلى صِدْقِ وَعْدِكَ،
ولَجَائِي إِلى الاِيْمانِ بِتَوْحِيدِكَ،
وَيَقِينِي بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ مِنِّي أَنْ لا رَبَّ لِي غَيْرُكَ وَلا إِلهَ إِلاّ أَنْتَ،
وَحْدَكَ لا شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
اللّهُمَّ أَنْتَ القائِلُ،
وَقَوْلُكَ حَقٌ وَوَعْدُكَ صِدْقٌ: ﴿وَاسْأَلُوا الله مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّ الله كانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيماً﴾،
وَلَيْسَ مِنْ صِفاتِكَ ياسَيِّدِي ‌أَنْ تَأْمُرَ بِالسُّؤالِ وَتَمْنَعَ العَطِيَّةِ،
وَأَنْتَ المَنَّانُ بِالعَطِيَّاتِ عَلى أَهْلِ مَمْلَكَتِكَ،
وَالعائِدُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِتَحَنُّنِ رَأْفَتِكَ.
إِلهِي،
رَبَّيْتَنِي فِي نِعَمِكَ وَإِحْسانِكَ صَغِيرا وَنَوَّهْتَ بِاسْمِي كَبِيراً،
فَيامَنْ رَبَّانِي فِي الدُّنْيا بإِحْسانِهِ وَتَفَضُّلِهِ وَنِعَمِهِ،
وَأَشارَ لِي فِي الآخِرَةِ إِلى عَفْوِهِ وَكَرَمِهِ مَعْرِفَتِي،
يامَوْلاىَ دَلِيلِي عَلَيْكَ وحُبِّي لَكَ شَفِيِعِي إِلَيْكَ،
وَأَنا وَاثِقٌ مِنْ دَلِيلِي بِدَلالَتِكَ،
وَساكِنٌ مِنْ شَفِيعِي إِلى شَفاعَتِكَ،
أَدْعُوكَ ياسَيِّدِي بِلِسانٍ قَدْ أَخْرَسَهُ ذَنْبُهُ،
رَبِّ أُناجِيكَ بِقَلْبٍ قَدْ أَوْبَقَهُ جُرْمُهُ،
أَدْعُوكَ يارَبِّ راهِباً راغِباً راجِياً خائِفاً،
إِذا رَأَيْتُ مَوْلايَ ذُنُوبِي فَزِعْتُ وَإِذا رَأَيْتُ كَرَمَكَ طَمَعْتُ،
فَإِنْ عَفَوْتَ فَخَيْرُ راحِمٍ وَإِنْ عَذَّبْتَ فَغَيْرُ ظالِمٍ.
حُجَّتِي يا الله فِي جُرْأَتِي عَلى مَسأَلَتِكَ مَعَ إِتْيانِي ماتَكْرَهُ جُودُكَ وَكَرَمُكَ،
وعُدَّتِي فِي شِدَّتِي مَعَ قِلَّةِ حَيائِي رَأَفَتُكَ وَرَحْمَتُكَ،
وَقَدْ رَجَوْتُ أَنْ لا تَخِيبَ بَيْنَ ذَيْنِ وذَيْنِ مُنْيَتِي،
فَحَقِّقْ رَجائِي وَاسْمَعْ دُعائِي،
ياخَيْرَ مَنْ دَعاهُ داعٍ وَأَفْضَلَ مَنْ رَجاهُ راجٍ.
عَظُمَ ياسَيِّدِي أَمَلِي وَساءَ عَمَلِي،
فَأَعْطِنِي مِنْ عَفْوِكَ بِمِقْدارِ أَمَلِي وَلا تُؤاَخِذْنِي بِأَسْوَءِ عَمَلِي،
فَإِنَّ كَرَمَكَ يَجِلُّ عَنْ مُجازاةِ المُذْنِبِينَ،
وَحِلْمَكَ يَكْبُرُ عَنْ مُكافأَةِ المُقَصِّرِينَ،
وَأَنا ياسَيِّدِي عَائِذٌ بِفَضْلِكَ هارِبٌ مِنْكَ إِلَيْكَ،
مُتَنَجِّزٌ ما وَعَدْتَ مِنَ الصَّفْحِ عَمَّنْ أَحْسَنَ بِكَ ظَنّا،
وَما أَنا يارَبِّ وَما خَطَرِي؟!
هَبْنِي بَفَضْلِكَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيَّ بِعَفْوِكَ أَيْ رَبِّ،
جَلِّلْنِي بِسِتْرِكَ،
وَاعْفُ عَنْ تَوْبِيخِي بِكَرَمِ وَجْهِكَ،
فَلَوِ اطَّلَعَ اليَوْمَ عَلى ذَنْبِي غَيْرُكَ مافَعَلْتُهُ،
وَلَوْ خِفْتُ تَعْجِيلَ العُقُوبَةِ لاجْتَنَبْتُهُ،
لا لاَنَّكَ أَهْوَنُ النَّاظِرِينَ وَأَخَفُّ المُطَّلِعِينَ،
بَلْ لاَنَّكَ يارَبِّ خَيْرُ السَّاتِرِينَ وَأَحْكَمُ الحاكِمِينَ وَأَكْرَمُ الاَكْرَمِينَ،
سَتَّارُ العُيُوبِ غَفَّارُ الذُّنُوبِ عَلامُ الغُيُوبِ،
تَسْتُرُ الذَّنْبَ بِكَرَمِكَ وَتُؤَخِّرُ العُقُوبَةَ بِحِلْمِكَ،
فَلَكَ الحَمْدُ عَلى حِلْمِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ وَعَلى عَفْوِكَ بَعْدَ قَدْرَتِكَ.
وَيَحْمِلُنِي وَيُجَرِّؤُنِي عَلى مَعْصِيَتِكَ حِلْمُكَ عَنِّي،
وَيَدْعُونِي إِلى قِلَّةِ الحَياءِ سِتْرُكَ عَلَيَّ،
وَيُسْرِعُنِي إِلى التَّوَثُّبِ عَلى مَحارِمِكَ مَعْرِفَتِي بِسَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَظِيمِ عَفْوِكَ،
ياحَلِيمُ ياكَرِيمُ،
ياحَيُّ ياقَيُّومُ،
ياغافِرَ الذَّنْبِ ياقابِلَ التَّوْبِ،
ياعَظِيمَ المَنِّ ياقَدِيمَ الاِحْسانِ،
أَيْنَ سَتْرُكَ الجَمِيلُ؟
أَيْنَ عَفْوُكَ الجَلِيلُ؟
أَيْنَ فَرَجُكَ القَرِيبُ؟
أَيْنَ غِياثُكَ السَّرِيعُ؟
أَيْنَ رَحْمَتُكَ الواسِعَةُ؟
أَيْنَ عَطاياكَ الفاضِلَةُ؟
أَيْنَ مَواهِبُكَ الهَنِيئةُ؟
أَيْنَ صَنائِعُكَ السَّنِيَّةُ؟
أَيْنَ فَضْلُكَ العَظِيمُ؟
أَيْنَ مَنُّكَ الجَسِيمُ؟
أَيْنَ إِحْسانُكَ القَدِيمُ؟
أَيْنَ كَرَمُكَ ياكَرِيمُ؟
بِهِ فَاسْتَنْقِذْنِي وَبِرَحْمَتِكَ فَخَلِّصْنِي،
يامُحْسِنُ يامُجْمِلُ،
يامُنْعِمُ يامُفْضِلُ،
لَسْتُ أَتَّكِلُ فِي النَّجاةِ مِنْ عِقابِكَ عَلى أَعْمالِنا،
بَلْ بِفَضْلِكَ عَلَيْنا،
لاَنَّكَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوى وَأَهْلُ المَغْفِرَةِ،
تُبْدِئُ بِالاِحْسانِ نِعَماً،
وَتَعْفُوعَنِ الذَّنْبِ كَرَماً،
فَما نَدْرِي ما نَشْكُرُ،
أَجَمِيلَ ماتَنْشُرُ أَمْ قَبِيحَ ماتَسْتُرُ؟
أَمْ عَظِيمَ ما أَبْلَيْتَ وَأَوْلَيْتَ أَمْ كَثِيرَ ما مِنْهُ نَجَّيْتَ وَعافَيْتَ؟
ياحَبِيبَ مَنْ تَحَبَّبَ إِلَيْكَ،
وَياقُرَّةَ عَيْنِ مَنْ لاذَ بِكَ وَانْقَطَعَ إِلَيْكَ،
أَنْتَ المُحْسِنُ وَنَحْنُ المُسِيؤونَ،
فَتَجاوَزْ يارَبِّ عَنْ قَبِيحِ ماعِنْدَنا بِجَمِيلِ ما عِنْدَكَ،
وَأَيُّ جَهْلٍ يارَبِّ لا يَسَعَهُ جُودُكَ؟
وَأَيُّ زَمانٍ أَطْوَلُ مِنْ أَناتِكَ؟
وَماقَدْرُ أَعْمالِنا فِي جَنْبِ نِعَمِكَ؟
وَكَيْفَ نَسْتَكْثِرُ أَعْمالاً نُقابِلُ بِها كَرَمَكَ؟
بَلْ كَيْفَ يَضِيقُ عَلى المُذْنِبِينَ ماوَسِعَهُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ؟!
ياوَاسِعَ المَغْفِرَةِ ياباسِطَ اليَدَيْنِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ،
فَوَ عِزَّتِكَ ياسَيِّدِي لَوْ نَهَرْتَنِي مابَرِحْتُ مِنْ بابِكَ وَلا كَففْتُ عَنْ تَمَلُّقِكَ،
لِما انْتَهى إِلَيَّ مِنْ المَعْرِفَةِ بِجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ،
وَأَنْتَ الفاعِلُ لِما تَشاءُ،
تُعَذِّبُ مَنْ تَشاءُ بِما تَشاءُ كَيْفَ تَشاءُ،
وَتَرْحَمُ مَنْ تَشاءُ بِما تَشاءُ كَيْفَ تَشاءُ،
لا تُسْأَلُ عَنْ فِعْلِكَ،
وَلا تُنازَعُ فِي مُلْكِكَ،
وَلا تُشارَكُ فِي أَمْرِكَ،
وَلا تُضادُّ فِي حُكْمِكَ،
وَلا يَعْتَرِضُ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدٌ فِي تَدْبِيرِكَ،
لَكَ الخَلْقُ وَالاَمْرُ تَبارَكَ الله رَبُّ العَالَمِينَ.
يارَبِّ هذا مَقامُ مَنْ لاذَ بِكَ وَاسْتَجارَ بِكَرَمِكَ وَأَلِفَ إِحْسانَكَ وَنِعَمَكَ،
وَأَنْتَ الجَوادُ الَّذِي لايَضِيقُ عَفْوُكَ وَلا يَنْقُصُ فَضْلُكَ وَلا تَقِلُّ رَحْمَتُكَ،
وَقَدْ تَوَثَّقْنا مِنْكَ بالصَّفْحِ القَدِيمِ وَالفَضْلِ العَظِيمِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ الواسِعَةِ،
أَفَتُراكَ يارَبِّ تَخْلِفُ ظُنُونَنا أَوْ تُخَيِّبُ آمالَنا؟
كَلا ياكَرِيمُ،
فَلَيْسَ هذا ظَنُّنا بِكَ وَلا هذا فِيكَ طَمَعُنا،
يارَبِّ إِنَّ لَنا فِيكَ أَمَلاً طَوِيلاً كَثِيراً،
إِنَّ لَنا فِيكَ رَجاءاً عَظِيما،
عَصَيْناكَ وَنَحْنُ نَرْجُوأَنْ تَسْتُرَ عَلَيْنا،
وَدَعَوْناكَ وَنَحْنُ نَرْجو أَنْ تَسْتَجِيبَ لَنا،
فَحَقِّقْ رَجائَنا.
مَوْلانا فَقَدْ عَلِمْنا ما نَسْتَوْجِبُ بِأَعْمالِنا،
وَلكِنْ عِلْمُكَ فِينا وَعِلْمُنا بِأَنَّكَ لا تَصْرِفُنا عَنْكَ حَثَّنا عَلى الرَّغْبَةِ إِلَيْكَ،
وَإِنْ كُنّا غَيْرَ مُسْتَوْجِبِينَ لِرَحْمَتِكَ فَأَنْتَ أَهْلٌ أَنْ تَجُودَ عَلَيْنا وَعَلى المُذْنِبِينَ بِفَضْلِ سَعَتِكَ،
فَامْنُنْ عَلَيْنا بِما أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ،
وَجُدْ عَلَيْنا فَإِنّا مُحْتاجُونَ إِلى نَيْلِكَ،
ياغَفَّارُ بِنُورِكَ اهْتَدَيْنا،
وَبِفَضْلِكَ اسْتَغْنَيْنا،
وَبِنِعْمَتِكَ أَصْبَحْنا وَأَمْسَيْنا،
ذُنُوبُنا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ،
نَسْتَغْفِرُكَ اللّهُمَّ مِنْها وَنَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ،
تَتَحَبَّبُ إِلَيْنا بِالنِّعَمِ وَنُعارِضُكَ بِالذُّنُوبِ،
خَيْرُكَ إِلَيْنا نازِلٌ وَشَرُّنا إِلَيْكَ صاعِدٌ،
وَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَلايزالُ مَلَكٌ كَرِيمٌ يَأْتِيكَ عَنّا بِعَمَلٍ قَبِيحٍ،
فَلا يَمْنَعُكَ ذلِكَ مِنْ أَنْ تَحُوطَنا بِنِعَمِكَ وَتَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْنا بِآلائِكَ،
فَسُبْحانَكَ ماأَحْلَمَكَ وَأَعْظَمَكَ وَأَكْرَمَكَ مُبْدِئاً وَمُعِيداً،
تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْماؤُكَ وَجَلَّ ثَناؤُكَ وَكَرُمَ صَنائِعُكَ وَفِعالُكَ.
أَنْتَ إِلهِي أَوْسَعُ فَضْلاً وَأَعْظَمُ حِلْما مِنْ أَنْ تُقايِسَنِي بِفِعْلِي وَخَطِيئَتِي،
فَالعَفْوَ العَفْوَ العَفْوَ،
سَيِّدِي سَيِّدِي سَيِّدِي،
اللَّهُمَّ اشْغَلْنا بِذِكْرِكَ،
وَأَعِذْنا مِنْ سَخَطِكَ،
وَأَجِرْنا مِنْ عَذابِكَ،
وَارْزُقْنا مِنْ مَواهِبِكَ،
وَأَنْعِمْ عَلَيْنا مِنْ فَضْلِكَ،
وَارْزُقْنا حَجَّ بَيْتِكَ وَزِيارَةَ قَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ،
صَلَواتُكَ وَرَحْمَتُكَ وَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَرِضْوانُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ،
إِنَّكَ قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ،
وَارْزُقْنا عَمَلاً بِطاعَتِكَ،
وَتَوَفَّنا عَلى مِلَّتِكَ وَسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.
اللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُما كَما رَبَّيانِي صَغِيراً،
اجْزِهِما بِالاِحْسانِ إِحْساناً وَبِالسَّيِّئاتِ غُفْرانا،
اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنينَ وَالمُؤْمِناتِ،
الاَحْياءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالاَمْواتِ،
وَتابِعْ بَيْنَنا وَبَيْنَهُمْ بِالخَيْراتِ،
اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنا وَمَيِّتِنا،
وَشاهِدِنا وَغائِبِنا،
ذَكَرِنا وَاُنْثانا،
صَغِيرِنا وَكَبِيرنا،
حُرِّنا وَمَمْلُوكِنا.
كَذَّبَ العادِلُونَ بِالله وَضَلُّوا ضَلالاً بَعِيداً وَخَسِرُوا خُسْراناً مُبِيناً.
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
وَاخْتِمْ لِي بِخَيْرٍ،
وَاكْفِنِي ماأَهَمَّنِي مِنْ أَمْرِ دُنْيايَ وَآخِرَتِي،
وَلاتُسَلِّطْ عَلَيَّ مَنْ لا يَرْحَمُنِي،
وَاجْعَلْ عَلَيَّ مِنْكَ وَاقِيَةً باقِيَةً،
وَلاتَسْلُبْنِي صالِحَ ما أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ،
وَارْزُقْنِي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ رِزْقاً وَاسِعاً حَلالاً طَيِّباً.
اللَّهُمَّ احْرُسْنِي بِحِراسَتِكَ،
وَاحْفَظْنِي بِحِفْظِكَ،
وَاكْلاْنِي بِكلاَتِكَ،
وَارْزُقْنِي حَجَّ بَيْتِكَ الحَرامِ،
فِي عامِنا هذا وَفِي كُلِّ عامٍ،
وَزِيارَةَ قَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ وَالأَئِمَّةِ عَلَيْهُمُ السَّلامُ،
وَلا تُخْلِنِي يارَبِّ مِنْ تِلْكَ المَشاهِدِ الشَّرِيفَةِ وَالمَواقِفِ الكَرِيمَةِ.
اللّهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَيَّ حَتَّى لا أَعْصِيكَ،
وَأَلْهِمْنِي الخَيْرَ وَالعَمَلَ بِهِ،
وَخَشْيَتَكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهارِ ما أَبْقَيْتَنِي،
يارَبَّ العَالَمِينَ.
اللّهُمَّ إِنِّي كُلَّما قُلتُ قَدْ تَهَيّأْتُ وَتَعَبّأْتُ،
وَقُمْتُ للصَّلاةِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ وَناجَيْتُكَ،
أَلْقَيْتَ عَلَيَّ نُعاساً إِذا أَنا صَلَّيْتُ،
وَسَلَبْتَنِي مُناجاتَكَ إِذا أَنا ناجَيْتُ،
مالِي كُلَّما قُلْتُ قَدْ صَلُحَتْ سَرِيرَتِي وَقَرُبَ مِنْ مَجالِسِ التَّوّابِينَ مَجْلِسِي،
عَرَضَتْ لِي بَلِيَّةٌ أَزالَتْ قَدْمِي وَحالَتْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خِدْمَتِكَ؟
سَيِّدِي لَعَلَّكَ عَنْ بابِكَ طَرَدْتَنِي،
وَعَنْ خِدْمَتِكَ نَحَّيْتَنِي،
أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَأَيْتَنِي مُسْتَخِفا بِحَقَّكَ فَأَقْصَيْتَنِي،
أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَأيْتَنِي مُعْرِضا عَنْكَ فَقَلَيْتَنِي،
أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ وَجَدْتَنِي فِي مَقامِ الكاذِبِينَ فَرَفَضْتَنِي،
أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَأَيْتَنِي غَيْرَ شاكِرٍ لِنَعْمائِكَ فَحَرَمْتَنِي،
أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ فَقَدْتَنِي مِنْ مَجالِسِ العُلَماءِ فَخَذَلْتَنِي،
أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَأَيْتَنِي فِي الغافِلِينَ فَمِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ آيَسْتَنِي،
أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَأَيْتَنِي آلِفُ مَجالِسَ البَطَّالِينَ فَبَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ خَلَّيْتَنِي،
أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ لَمْ تُحِبَّ أَنْ تَسْمَعَ دُعائِي فَباعَدْتَنِي،
أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ بِجُرْمِي وَجَرِيرَتِي كافَيْتَنِي،
أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ بِقِلَّةِ حَيائِي مِنْكَ جازَيْتَنِي،
فَإِنْ عَفَوْتَ يارَبِّ فَطالَما عَفَوْتَ عَنْ المُذْنِبِينَ قبْلِي،
لاَنَّ كَرَمِكَ أَيْ رَبِّ يَجِلُّ عَنْ مُكافاةِ المُقَصِّرِينَ،
وَأَنا عائِذٌ بِفَضْلِكَ هارِبٌ مِنْكَ إِلَيْكَ،
مُتَنَجِّزٌ ما وَعَدْتَ مِنَ الصَّفْحِ عَمَّنْ أَحْسَنَ بِكَ ظَنّاً.
إِلهِي،
أَنْتَ أَوْسَعُ فَضْلاً وَأَعْظَمُ حِلْماً مِنْ أَنْ تُقايِسنِي بِعَمَلِي،
أَوْ أَنْ تَسْتَزِلَّنِي بِخّطِيئَتِي،
وَما أَنا ياسَيِّدِي وَما خَطَرِي؟
هَبْنِي بِفَضْلِكَ سَيِّدِي،
وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيَّ بِعَفْوِكَ،
وَجَلِّلْنِي بِسَتْرِكَ،
وَاعْفُ عَنْ تَوْبِيخِي بِكَرَمِ وَجْهِكَ.
سَيِّدِي،
أَنا الصَّغِيرُ الَّذِي رَبَيْتَهُ،
وَأَنا الجاهِلُ الَّذِي عَلَّمْتُهُ،
وَأَنا الضَّالُّ الَّذِي هَدَيْتَهُ،
وَأَنا الوَضِيعُ الَّذِي رَفَعْتَهُ،
وَأَنا الخائِفُ الَّذِي آمَنْتُهُ،
وَالجائِعُ الَّذِي أَشْبَعْتَهُ،
وَالعَطْشانُ الَّذِي أَرْوَيْتَهُ،
وَالعارِي الَّذِي كَسَوْتَهُ،
وَالفَقِيرُ الَّذِي أَغنَيْتَهُ،
وَالضَّعِيفُ الَّذِي قَوَّيْتَهُ،
وَالذَّلِيلُ الَّذِي أَعْزَزْتَهُ،
وَالسَّقِيمُ الَّذِي شَفَيْتَهُ،
وَالسَّائِلُ الَّذِي أَعْطيْتَهُ،
وَالمُذْنِبُ الَّذِي سَتَرْتَهُ،
وَالخاطِيُ الَّذِي أَقلْتَهُ،
وَأَنا القَلِيلُ الَّذِي كَثَّرْتَهُ،
وَالمُسْتَضْعَفُ الَّذِي نَصَرْتَهُ،
وَأَنا الطَّرِيدُ الَّذِي آوَيْتَهُ،
أَنا يارَبِّ الَّذِي لَمْ أَسْتَحْيِكَ فِي الخَلاءِ وَلَمْ اُراقِبْكَ فِي المَلاءِ،
أَنا صاحِبُ الدَّواهِي العُظْمى،
أَنا الَّذِي عَلى سَيِّدِهِ اجْترى،
أَنا الَّذِي عَصَيْتُ جَبَّارَ السَّماء،
أَنا الَّذِي أَعْطَيْتُ عَلى مَعاصِي الجَلِيلِ الرُّشا،
أَنا الَّذِي حِينَ بُشِّرْتُ بِها خَرَجْتُ إِلَيْها أَسْعى،
أَنا الَّذِي أَمْهَلْتَنِي فَما ارْعَوَيْتُ،
وَسَتَرْتَ عَلَيَّ فَما اسْتَحْيَيْتُ،
وَعَمِلْتُ بِالمَعاصِي فَتَعَدَّيْتُ،
وَأَسْقَطْتَنِي مِنْ عَيْنِكَ فَما بالَيْتُ،
فَبِحِلْمِكَ أَمْهَلْتَنِي وَبِسِتْرِكَ سَتَرْتَنِي،
حَتَّى كَأَنَّكَ أّغْفَلْتَنِي،
وَمِنْ عُقُوباتِ المَعاصِي جَنَّبْتَنِي،
حَتَّى كَأَنَّكَ اسْتَحْيَيْتَنِي.
إِلهِي،
لَمْ أَعْصِكَ حِيْنَ عَصَيْتُكَ وَأَنا بِرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ جاحِدٌ،
وَلا بِأَمْرِكَ مُسْتَخِفٌ،
وَلا لِعُقُوبَتِكَ مُتَعَرِّضٌ،
وَلا لِوَعِيدِكَ مُتَهاوِنٌ،
لكِنْ خَطِيئَةٌ عَرَضَتْ،
وَسَوَّلَتْ لِي نَفْسِي،
وَغَلَبَنِي هَوَايَ،
وَأَعانَنِي عَلَيْها شِقْوَتِي،
وَغَرَّنِي سِتْرُكَ المُرْخَى عَلَيَّ،
فَقَدْ عَصَيْتُكَ وَخالَفْتُكَ بِجُهْدِي،
فَالآنَ مِنْ عَذابِكَ مَنْ يَسْتَنْقِذُنِي؟
وَمِنْ أَيْدِي الخُصَماءِ غَداً مَنْ يُخَلِّصُنِي؟
وَبِحَبْلِ مَنْ أَتَّصِلُ إِنْ أَنْتَ قَطَعْتَ حَبْلَكَ عَنِّي؟
فَواسَوْأَتا عَلى ما أَحْصَى كِتابُكَ مِنْ عَمَلِي،
الَّذِي لَوْلا ما أَرْجو مِنْ كَرَمِكَ وَسَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَنَهْيِكَ إِيَّايَ عَنْ القُنُوطِ لَقَنَطْتُ عِنْدَما أَتَذَكَّرُها،
يا خَيْرَ مِنْ دَعاهُ داعٍ،
وَأَفْضَلَ مَنْ رَجاهُ راجٍ،
اللّهُمَّ بِذِمَّةِ الاِسْلامِ أَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ،
وَبِحُرْمَةِ القُرْآنِ أَعْتَمِدُ عَلَيْكَ،
وَبِحُبِّي النَّبِيَّ الاُمِّيَّ القَرَشِيَّ الهاشِمِيَّ العَرَبِيَّ التِّهامِيَّ المَكِّيَّ المَدَنِيَّ أَرْجُوالزُّلْفَةَ لَدَيْكَ،
فَلا تُوحِشِ اسْتِئْناسَ إِيْمانِي،
وَلا تَجْعَلْ ثَوابِي ثَوابَ مَنْ عَبَدَ سِواكَ،
فَإِنَّ قَوْما آمَنُوا بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ لِيَحْقِنُوا بِهِ دِمائَهُمْ فَأَدْرَكُوا ما أَمَّلُوا،
وإِنّا آمَنّا بِكَ بِأَلْسِنَتِنا وَقُلُوبِنا لِتَعْفُوَ عَنّا،
فَأَدْرِكْنا ما أَمَّلْنا،
وَثَبِّتْ رَجائَكَ فِي صُدُورِنا،
وَلا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنا،
وَهَبْ لَنا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الوَهّابُ.
فَوَعِزَّتِكَ لَوْ انْتَهَرْتَنِي مابَرِحْتُ مِنْ بابِكَ وَلا كَفَفْتُ عَنْ تَمَلُّقِكَ،
لِما أُلْهِمَ قَلْبِي مِنَ المَعْرِفَةِ بِكَرَمِكَ وَسَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ.
إِلى مَنْ يَذْهَبُ العَبْدُ إِلاّ إِلى مَوْلاهُ؟
وَإِلى مَنْ يَلْتَجِيُ المَخْلُوقُ إِلاّ إِلى خالِقِهِ؟
إِلهِي لَوْ قَرَنْتَنِي بِالأصْفادِ،
وَمَنَعْتَنِي سَيْبَكَ مِنْ بَيْنِ الاَشْهادِ،
وَدَلَلْتَ عَلى فَضائِحِي عُيُونَ العِبادِ،
وَأَمَرْتَ بِي إِلى النّارِ،
وَحُلْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ الاَبْرارِ،
ماقَطَعْتُ رَجائِي مِنْكَ،
وَما صَرَفْتُ تأْمِيلِي لِلْعَفْوِ عَنْكَ،
وَلا خَرَجَ حُبُّكَ مِنْ قَلْبِي.
أَنا لا أَنْسى أَيادِيكَ عِنْدِي وَسَتْرَكَ عَلَيَّ فِي دارِ الدُّنْيا،
سَيِّدِي أَخْرِجْ حُبَّ الدُّنْيا مِنْ قَلْبِي،
وَاجْمَعْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ المُصْطَفى وَآلِهِ خِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَخاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ صَلّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ،
وَانْقُلْنِي إِلى دَرّجَةِ التَوْبَةِ إِلَيْكَ،
وَأَعِنِّي بِالبُكاءِ عَلى نَفْسِي،
فَقَدْ أَفْنَيْتُ بِالتَّسْوِيفِ وَالآمالِ عُمْرِي،
وَقَدْ نَزَلْتُ مَنْزِلَةَ الآيِسِينَ مِنْ خَيْرِي،
فَمَنْ يَكُونُ أَسْوَءَ حالاً مِنِّي اِنْ أَنا نُقِلْتُ عَلى مِثْلِ حالِي إِلى قَبْرِي،
لَمْ اُمَهِّدْهُ لِرَقْدَتِي وَلَمْ أَفْرُشْهُ بِالعَمَلِ الصَّالِحِ لِضَجْعَتِي،
وَمالِي لا أَبْكِي وَلا أَدْرِي إِلى ما يَكُونُ مَصِيرِي،
وَأَرى نَفْسِي تُخادِعُنِي وَأَيَّامِي تُخاتِلُنِي،
وَقَدْ خَفَقَتْ عِنْدَ رَأْسِي أَجْنِحَةُ المَوْتِ،
فَما لي لا أَبْكِي؟!
أَبْكِي لِخُرُوجِ نَفْسِي،
أَبْكِي لِظُلْمَةِ قَبْرِي،
أَبْكِي لِضِيقِ لَحْدِي،
أَبْكِي لِسُؤالِ مُنْكَرٍ وَنَكِيرٍ إِيايَ،
أَبْكِي لِخُرُوجِي مِنْ قَبْرِي عُرْياناً ذَلِيلاً حامِلاً ثِقْلِي عَلى ظَهْرِي،
أَنْظُرُ مَرَّةً عَنْ يَمِينِي وَاُخْرى عَنْ شَمالِي،
إِذِ الخَلائِقُ فِي شَأْنٍ غَيْرِ شَأْنِي،
لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ،
وَجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُسْفِرَةٌ،
ضاحِكَةٌ مُسْتَبْشِرَةٌ،
وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْها غَبَرَةٌ،
تَرْهَقُها قَتَرَةٌ وَذِلَّةٌ،
سَيِّدِي عَلَيْكَ مُعَوَّلِي وَمُعْتَمَدِي وَرَجائِي وَتَوَكُّلِي،
وَبِرَحْمَتِكَ تَعَلُّقِي،
تُصِيبُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ مَنْ تَشاءُ وَتَهْدِي بِكَرامَتِكَ مَنْ تُحِبُّ،
فَلَكَ الحَمْدُ عَلى مانَقَّيَتَ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ قَلْبِي،
وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ عَلى بَسْطِ لِسانِي،
أَفَبِلِسانِي هذا الكالِّ أَشْكُرُكَ؟
أَمْ بِغايَةِ جُهْدِي فِي عَمَلِي أُرْضِيكَ؟
وَما قَدْرُ لِسانِي يارَبِّ فِي جَنْبِ شُكْرِكَ؟
وَما قَدْرُ عَمَلِي فِي جَنْبِ نِعَمِكَ وَإِحْسانِكَ؟
إِلهِي إِنَّ جُودَكَ بَسَطَ أَمَلِي وَشُكْرَكَ قَبلَ عَمَلِي.
سَيِّدِي،
إِلَيْكَ رَغْبَتِي،
وَإِلَيْكَ رَهْبَتِي،
وَإِلَيْكَ تَأْمِيلِي،
وَقَدْ ساقَنِي إِلَيْكَ أَمَلِي،
وَعَلَيْكَ ياوَاحِدِي عَكَفَتْ هِمَّتِي،
وَفِيما عِنْدَكَ انْبَسَطَتْ رَغْبَتِي،
وَلَكَ خالِصُ رَجائِي وَخَوْفِي،
وَبِكَ أَنِسَتْ مَحَبَّتِي،
وَإِلَيْكَ أَلَقَيْتُ بِيَدِي،
وَبِحَبْلِ طاعَتِكَ مَدَدْتُ رَهْبَتِي،
يامَوْلايَ بِذِكْرِكَ عاشَ قَلْبِي،
وَبِمُناجاتِكَ بَرَّدْتُ أَلَمَ الخَوْفِ عَنِّي،
فَيا مَوْلايَ وَيا مُؤَمَّلِي وَيا مُنْتهى سُؤْلِي،
فَرِّقْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ ذَنْبِي المانِعِ لِي مِنْ لُزُومِ طاعَتِكَ،
فَإِنَّما أَسْأَلُكَ لِقَدِيمِ الرَّجاءِ فِيكَ،
وَعَظِيمِ الطَمَعِ مِنْكَ الَّذِي أَوْجَبْتَهُ عَلى نَفْسِكَ مِنَ الرَّأْفَةِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ،
فَالاَمْرُ لَكَ وَحْدَكَ لاشَرِيكَ لَكَ،
وَالخَلْقُ كُلُّهُمْ عِيالُكَ وَفِي قَبْضَتِكَ،
وَكُلُّ شَىّْءٍ خاضِعٌ لَكَ،
تَبارَكْتَ يارَبَّ العَالَمِينَ.
إِلهِي ارْحَمْنِي إِذا انْقَطَعَتْ حُجَّتِي،
وَكَلَّ عَنْ جَوابِكَ لِسانِي،
وَطاشَ عِنْدَ سُؤْالِكَ إِيّايَ لُبِّي،
فِيا عَظِيمَ رَجائِي،
لا تُخَيِّبْنِي إِذا اشْتَدَّتْ فاقَتِي وَلاتَرُدَّنِي،
لِجَهْلِي وَلا تَمْنَعْنِي لِقِلَّةِ صَبْرِي،
أَعْطِنِي لِفَقْرِي،
وَارْحَمْنِي لِضَعْفِي،
سَيِّدِي عَلَيْكَ مُعْتَمَدِي وَمُعَوَّلِي وَرَجائِي وَتَوَكُّلِي،
وَبِرَحْمَتِكَ تَعَلُّقِي،
وَبِفِنائِكَ أَحُطُّ رَحْلِي،
وَبِجُودِكَ أَقْصِدُ طَلِبَتِي،
وَبِكَرَمِكَ أَيْ رَبِّ أَسْتَفْتِحُ دُعائِي،
وَلَدَيْكَ أَرْجُوفاقَتِي،
وَبِغناكَ أَجْبُرُ عَيْلَتِي،
وَتَحْتَ ظِلِّ عَفْوِكَ قِيامِي،
وَإِلى جُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ أَرْفَعُ بَصَرِي،
وَإِلى مَعْرُوفِكَ أُدِيمُ نَظَرِي،
فَلا تُحْرِقْنِي بِالنَّارِ وَأَنْتَ مَوْضِعُ أَمَلِي،
وَلا تُسْكِنِّي الهاوِيَةَ فَإِنَّكَ قُرَّةُ عَيْنِي،
ياسَيِّدِي لاتُكَذِّبْ ظَنِّي بِإحْسانِكَ وَمَعْرُوفِكَ فَإِنَّكَ ثِقَتِي،
وَلا تَحْرِمْنِي ثَوابَكَ فَإِنَّكَ العارِفُ بِفَقْرِي.
إِلهِي إِنْ كانَ قَدْ دَنا أَجَلِي وَلَمْ يُقَرِّبُنِي مِنْكَ عَمَلِي،
فَقَدْ جَعَلْتُ الاِعْتِرافَ إِلَيْكَ بِذَنْبِي وَسائِلَ عِلَلِي،
إِلهِي إِنْ عَفَوْتَ فَمَنْ أَوْلى مِنْكَ بِالعَفْوِ؟
وَإِنْ عَذَّبْتَ فَمَنْ أَعْدَلُ مِنْكَ فِي الحُكْمِ؟
إرْحَمْ فِي هذِهِ الدُّنْيا غُرْبَتِي،
وَعِنْدَ المَوْتِ كُرْبَتِي،
وَفِي القَبْرِ وَحْدَتِي،
وَفِي اللَّحْدِ وَحْشَتِي،
وَإِذا نُشِرْتُ لِلْحِسابِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ ذُلَّ مَوْقِفِي،
وَاغْفِرْ لِي ماخَفِيَ عَلى الادَمِيِّينَ مِنْ عَمَلِي،
وَأَدِمْ لِي ما بِهِ سَتَرْتَنِي،
وَارْحَمْنِي صَرِيعاً عَلى الفِراشِ تُقَلِّبُنِي أَيْدِي أَحِبَّتِي،
وَتَفضَّلْ عَلَيَّ مَمْدُوداً عَلى المُغْتَسَلِ يُقَلِّبُنِي صالِحُ جِيرَتِي،
وَتَحَنَّنْ عَلَيَّ مَحْمُولاً قَدْ تَناوَلَ الأقْرِباءُ أَطْرافَ جَنازَتِي،
وَجُدْ عَلَيَّ مَنْقُولاً قَدْ نَزَلْتُ بِكَ وَحِيداً فِي حُفْرَتِي،
وَارْحَمْ فِي ذلِكَ البَيْتِ الجَدِيدِ غُرْبَتِي حَتَّىْ لا أَسْتَأْنِسَ بِغَيْرِكَ.
ياسَيِّدِي إنْ وَكَلْتَنِي إِلى نَفْسِي هَلَكْتُ،
سَيِّدِي فَبِمَنْ اسْتَغِيثُ إِنْ لَمْ تُقِلْنِي عَثْرَتِي،
فَإِلى مَنْ أَفْزَعُ إِنْ فَقَدْتُ عِنايَتَكَ فِي ضَجْعَتِي؟
وَإِلى مَنْ أَلْتَجِيُ إِنْ لَمْ تُنَفِّسُ كُرْبَتِي؟
سَيِّدِي مَنْ لِي وَمَنْ يَرْحَمُنِي إِنْ لَمْ تَرْحَمْنِي؟
وَفَضْلَ مَنْ اُؤَمِّلُ إِنْ عَدِمْتُ فَضْلَكَ يَوْمَ فاقَتِي؟
وَإِلى مَنْ الفِرارُ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ إِذا انْقَضى أَجَلِي؟
سَيِّدِي لاتُعَذِّبْنِي وَأَنا أَرْجُوكَ،
إِلهِي حَقِّقْ رَجائِي وَآمِنْ خَوْفِي،
فَإِنَّ كَثْرَةَ ذُنُوبِي لا أَرْجُوفِيها إِلاّ عَفْوَكَ،
سَيِّدِي أَنا أَسْأَلُكَ ما لا اسْتَحِقُّ،
وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوى وَأَهْلُ المَغْفِرَةِ،
فَاغْفِرْ لِي وَأَلْبِسْنِي مِنْ نَظَرِكَ ثَوْباً يُغَطِّي عَلَيَّ التَّبِعاتِ وَتَغْفِرُها لِي وَلا اُطالَبُ بِها،
إِنَّكَ ذُومَنٍّ قَدِيمٍ وَصَفْحٍ عَظِيمٍ وَتَجاوُزٍ كَرِيمٍ.
إِلهِي أَنْتَ الَّذِي تُفِيضُ سَيْبَكَ عَلى مَنْ لا يَسْأَلُكَ وَعَلى الجاحِدِينَ بِرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ،
فَكَيْفَ سَيِّدِي بِمَنْ سَأَلَكَ وَأَيْقَنَ أَنَّ الخَلْقَ لَكَ وَالاَمْرَ إِلَيْكَ،
تَبارَكْتَ وَتَعالَيْتَ يارَبَّ العَالَمِينَ،
سَيِّدِي عَبْدُكَ بِبابِكَ أَقامَتْهُ الخَصاصَةُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ،
يَقْرَعُ بابَ إِحْسانِكَ بِدُعائِهِ،
فَلا تُعْرِضَ بِوَجْهِكَ الكَرِيمِ عَنِّي،
وَاقْبَلْ مِنِّي ما أَقُولُ،
فَقَدْ دَعَوْتُ بِهذا الدُّعاءِ وَأَنا أَرْجُوأَنْ لا تَرُدَّنِي مَعْرِفَةً مِنِّي بِرَأْفَتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ.
إِلهِي أَنْتَ الَّذِي لا يُحْفِيكَ سائِلٌ وَلا يَنْقُصُكَ نائِلٌ،
أَنْتَ كَما تَقُولُ وَفَوْقَ ما نَقُولُ.
اللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ صَبْراً جَمِيلاً،
وَفَرَجاً قَرِيباً،
وَقَوْلا صادِقاً،
وَأَجْراً عَظِيماً،
أَسْأَلُكَ يارَبِّ مِنَ الخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ ماعَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَما لَمْ أَعْلَمُ،
أَسْأَلُكَ اللّهُمَّ مِنْ خَيْرِ ما سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ عِبادُكَ الصَّالِحُونَ،
ياخَيْرَ مَنْ سُئِلَ وَأَجْوَدَ مَنْ أَعْطي،
أَعْطِنِي سُؤْلِي فِي نَفْسِي وَأَهْلِي وَوالِدَيَّ وَوُلْدِي وَأَهْلِ حُزانَتِي وَإِخْوانِي فِيكَ،
وَأَرْغِدْ عَيْشِي،
وَأَظْهِرْ مُرُوَّتِي،
وَأَصْلِحْ جَمِيعَ أَحْوالِي،
وَاجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ أَطَلْتَ عُمْرَهُ،
وَحَسَّنْتَ عَمَلَهُ،
وَأَتْمَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ نِعْمَتَكَ،
وَرَضِيتَ عَنْهُ،
وَأَحْيَيْتَهُ حَياةً طَيِّبَةً فِي أَدْوَمِ السُّرُورِ وَأَسْبَغِ الكَرامَةِ وَأّتَمِّ العَيْشِ،
إِنَّكَ تَفْعَلُ ما تَشاءُ وَلايَفْعَلُ مايَشاءُ غَيْرُكَ.
اللّهُمَّ خُصَّنِي مِنْكَ بِخاصَّةِ ذِكْرِكَ،
وَلا تَجْعَلْ شَيْئاً مِمّا أَتَقَرَّبُ بِهِ فِي إِناء اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرافِ النَّهارِ رِياءً وَلا سُمْعَةً وَلا أَشَراً وَلا بَطَراً،
وَاجْعَلْنِي لَكَ مِنَ الخاشِعِينَ.
اللّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي السَّعَةَ فِي الرِّزْقِ،
وَالاَمْنَ فِي الوَطَنِ،
وَقُرَّةَ العَيْنِ فِي الاَهْلِ وَالمالِ وَالوَلَدِ،
وَالمُقامَ فِي نِعَمِكَ عِنْدِي،
وَالصِّحَّةَ فِي الجِسْمِ،
وَالقُوَّةَ فِي البَدَنِ،
وَالسَّلامَةَ فِي الدِّينِ،
وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِطاعَتِكَ وَطاعَةِ رَسُولِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ (صَلّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ) أَبَداً ما اسْتّعْمَرْتَنِي،
وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَوْفَرِ عِبادِكَ نَصِيبا فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَنْزَلْتَهُ وَتُنْزِلُهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضانَ فِي لَيْلَةِ القَدْرِ،
وَما أَنْتَ مُنْزِلُهُ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ،
مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ تَنْشُرُها،
وَعافِيَةٍ تُلْبِسُها،
وَبَلِيَّةٍ تَدْفَعُها،
وَحَسَناتٍ تَتَقَبَّلُها،
وَسَيِّئاتٍ تَتَجاوَزُ عَنْها،
وَارْزُقْنِي حَجَّ بَيْتِكَ الحَرامِ فِي عامِنا هذا وَفِي كُلِّ عامٍ،
وَارْزُقْنِي رِزْقاً وَاسِعاً مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الواسِعِ،
وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي ياسَيِّدِي الاَسْواءِ،
وَاقْضِ عَنِّي الدَّيْنَ وَالظُّلاماتِ حَتَّى لا أَتَأَذّى بِشَيٍ مِنْهُ،
وَخُذْ عَنِّي بِأَسْماعِ وَأَبْصارِ أَعْدائِي وَحُسَّادِي وَالباغِينَ عَلَيَّ،
وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَيْهِمْ،
وَأَقِرَّ عَيْنِي وَفَرِّحْ قَلْبِي،
وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ هَمِّي وَكَرْبِي فَرَجاً وَمَخْرَجاً،
وَاجْعَلْ مَنْ أَرادَنِي بِسُوءٍ مِنْ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ تَحْتَ قَدَمِيَّ،
وَاكْفِنِي شَرَّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَّ السُّلْطانِ وَسَيِّئاتِ عَمَلِي،
وَطَهِّرْنِي مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ كُلِّها،
وَأَجِرْنِي مِنَ النّارِ بِعَفْوِكَ،
وَأَدْخِلْنِي الجَنَّةَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ،
وَزَوِّجْنِي مِنَ الحُورِ العِينِ بِفَضْلِكَ،
وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِأَوْلِيائِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ،
مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ الاَبْرارِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ الأخْيارِ،
صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلى أَجْسادِهِمْ وَأَرْواحِهِمْ،
وَرَحْمَةُ الله وَبَرَكاتُهُ.
إِلهِي وَسَيِّدِي،
وَعزَّتِكَ وَجَلالِكَ،
لَئِنْ طالَبْتَنِي بِذُنُوبِي لاُطالِبَنَّكَ بِعَفْوِكَ،
وَلَئِنْ طالَبْتَنِي بِلُؤْمِي لاُطالِبَنَّكَ بِكَرَمِكَ،
وَلَئِنْ أَدْخَلْتَنِي النّار لاُخْبِرَنَّ أَهْلَ النّارِ بِحُبِّي لَكَ.
إِلهِي وَسَيِّدِي،
إِنْ كُنْتَ لا تَغْفِرُ إِلاّ لاَوْلِيائِكَ وَأَهْلِ طاعَتِكَ،
فَإِلى مَنْ يَفْزَعُ المُذْنِبُونَ؟
وَإِنْ كُنْتَ لا تُكْرِمُ إِلاّ أَهْلَ الوَفاءِ بِكَ،
فَبِمَنْ يَسْتَغِيثُ المُسِيئُونَ؟
إِلهِي إِنْ أَدْخَلْتَنِي النّارَ فَفِي ذلِكَ سُرُورُ عَدُوِّكَ،
وَإِنْ أَدْخَلْتَني الجَنَّةَ فَفِي ذلِكَ سُرُورُ نَبِيِّكَ،
وَأَنا وَالله أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ سُرُورَ نَبِيِّكَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ سُرُورِ عَدُوِّكَ.
اللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَمْلأَ قَلْبِي حُبّاً لَكَ،
وَخَشْيَةً مِنْكَ،
وَتَصْدِيقاً بِكتابِكَ،
وَإِيماناً بِكَ،
وَفَرَقاً مِنْكَ،
وَشَوْقاً إِلَيْكَ،
ياذا الجَلالِ وَالاِكْرامِ.
حَبِّبْ إِلَيَّ لِقأَكَ وَأَحْبِبْ لِقائِي،
وَاجْعَلْ لِي فِي لِقائِكَ الرَّاحَةَ والفَرَجَ وَالكَرامَةَ.
اللّهُمَّ أَلْحِقْنِي بِصالِحِ مَنْ مَضى،
وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ صالِحِ مَنْ بَقِيَ،
وَخُذْ بِي سَبِيلَ الصَّالِحِينَ،
وَأَعِنِّي عَلى نَفْسِي بِما تُعِينُ بِهِ الصَّالِحِينَ عَلى أّنْفُسِهِمْ،
وَاخْتِمْ عَمَلِي بِأَحْسَنِهِ،
وَاجْعّلْ ثَوابِي مِنْهُ الجَنَّةَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ،
وَأَعِنِّي عَلى صالِحِ ما أَعْطَيْتَنِي،
وَثَبِّتْنِي يارَبِّ وَلاتَرُدَّنِي فِي سُوءٍ اسْتَنْقَذْتَنِي مِنْهُ،
يارَبَّ العَالَمِينَ.
اللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيْمانا لا أَجَلَ لَهُ دُونَ لِقائِكَ،
أَحْينِي ما أَحْيَيْتَنِي عَلَيْهِ،
وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي عَلَيْهِ،
وَابْعّثْنِي إِذا بَعَثْتَنِي عَلَيْهِ،
وَابْرِيْ قَلْبِي مَنَ الرِّياءِ وَالشَّكِّ وَالسُّمْعَةِ فِي دِينِكَ،
حَتَّى يَكُونَ عَمَلِي خالِصا لَكَ.
اللّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي بَصِيرَةً فِي دِينِكَ،
وَفَهْما فِي حُكْمِكَ،
وَفِقْهاً فِي عِلْمِكَ،
وَكِفْلَيْنِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ،
وَوَرَعاً يَحْجُزُنِي عَنْ مَعاصِيكَ،
وَبَيِّضْ وَجْهِي بِنُورِكَ،
وَاجْعَلْ رَغْبَتِي فِيما عِنْدَكَ،
وَتَوفَّنِي فِي سَبِيلِكَ وَعلى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِكَ (صَلّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ).
اللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الكَسَلِ وَالفَشَلِ وَالهَمِّ وَالجُبْنِ وَالبُخْلِ وَالغَفْلَةِ وَالقَسْوَةِ وَالمَسْكَنَةِ وَالفَقْرِ وَالفاقَةِ وَكُلِّ بَلِيَّةٍ،
وَالفَواحِشِ ما ظَهَرَ مِنْها وَما بَطَنَ،
وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ لا تَقْنَعُ،
وَبَطْنٍ لا يَشْبَعُ،
وَقَلْبٍ لا يَخْشَعُ،
وَدُعاءٍ لا يُسْمَعُ،
وَعَمَلٍ لا يَنْفَعُ،
وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ يارَبِّ عَلى نَفْسِي وَدِينِي وَمالِي وَعَلى جَمِيعِ مارَزَقْتَنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ الرَّجِيمِ،
إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ العَلِيمُ.
اللّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لايُجِيرُنِي مِنْكَ أَحَدٌ،
وَلا أَجِدُ مِنْ دُونِكَ مُلْتَحَداً،
فَلا تَجْعَلْ نَفْسِي فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ عَذابِكَ،
ولا تَرُدَّنِي بِهَلَكَةٍ وَلا تَرُدَّنِي بِعَذابٍ أَلِيمٍ.
اللّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي،
وَأَعْلِ ذِكْرِي،
وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتِي،
وَحُطَّ وِزْرِي،
وَلاتَذْكُرْنِي بِخَطِيئَتي،
وَاجْعَلْ ثَوابَ مَجْلِسِي وَثَوابَ مَنْطِقِي وَثَوابَ دُعائِي رِضاكَ وَالجَنَّةَ،
وَأَعْطِنِي يارَبِّ جَمِيعَ ماسَألْتُكَ،
وَزِدْنِي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ،
إِنِّي إِلَيْكَ راغِبٌ يارَبَّ العالَمِينَ.
اللّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْزَلْتَ فِي كِتابِكَ أَنْ نَعْفُوَ عَمَّنْ ظَلَمَنا وَقْدْ ظَلَمْنا أَنْفُسَنا،
فَاعْفُ عَنّا فَإِنَّكَ أَوْلى بِذلِكَ مِنّا،
وَأَمَرْتَنا أَنْ لانَرُدَّ سائِلاً عَنْ أَبْوابِنا،
وَقَدْ جِئْتُكَ سائِلاً فَلا تَرُدَّنِي إِلاّ بِقَضاء حاجَتِي،
وَأَمَرْتَنا بِالاِحْسانِ إِلى مامَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُنا،
وَنَحْنُ أَرِقاؤُكَ فَاعْتِقْ رِقابَنا مِنَ النّارِ،
يا مَفْزَعِي عِنْدَ كُرْبَتِي،
وَيا غَوْثِي عِنْدَ شِدَّتِي،
إِلَيْكَ فَزِعْتُ وَبِكَ اسْتَغَثْتُ وَلُذْتُ،
لا أَلُوذُ بِسِواكَ وَلا أَطْلُبُ الفَرَجَ إِلاّ مِنْكَ،
فَأَغِثْنِي وَفَرِّجْ عَنِّي،
يامَنْ يَفُكُّ الاَسِيرَ وَيَعْفُوعَنِ الكَثِيرِ،
اقْبَلْ مِنِّي اليَسِيرَ وَاعْفُ عَنِّي الكَثِيرَ،
إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الرَّحِيمُ الغَفُورُ.
اللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسأَلُكَ إِيْمانا تُباشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي،
وَيَقِينا حَتَّى أَعْلَمَ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يُصِيبَنِي إِلاّ ماكَتَبْتَ لِي،
وَرَضِّنِي مِنَ العَيْشِ بِما قَسَمْتَ لِي،
يا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِين
entries.translation_en:
My God,
Do not discipline me with Your punishment,
and do not ensnare me by Your stratagem,
From where would good come to me, my Lord, when it is found nowhere except from You?
And from where would deliverance come to me, when it cannot be attained except through You?
Neither the one who did good has become free of need for Your help and Your mercy,
nor has the one who did evil, and dared against You, and did not please You, escaped Your power,
My Lord, my Lord, my Lord... (until the breath runs out),
Through You I came to know You,
and You guided me to Yourself and called me to Yourself,
and had it not been for You, I would not have known what You are.
All praise belongs to God, whom I call upon and He answers me, even though I am slow when He calls me,
and all praise belongs to God, whom I ask and He gives me, even though I am miserly when He asks a loan of me,
and all praise belongs to God, whom I call whenever I wish for my need,
and with whom I am alone wherever I wish for my secret, without any intercessor, and He fulfils my need for me,
All praise belongs to God, other than whom I call upon no one; for if I called upon another, he would not answer my prayer,
and all praise belongs to God, other than whom I hope in no one; for if I hoped in another, he would disappoint my hope,
and all praise belongs to God, who entrusted me to Himself and so honoured me, and did not entrust me to people, who would have humiliated me,
and all praise belongs to God, who shows affection to me while He is free of need of me,
and all praise belongs to God, who forbears with me until it is as though I have no sin,
so my Lord is the most praiseworthy thing to me, and the most worthy of my praise.
O God, I find the roads to what is sought from You laid open,
and the springs of hope in You filled to the brim,
and seeking help through Your bounty open to whoever sets his hope on You,
and the doors of prayer to You open for those who cry out,
and I know that You are, for those who hope, at the place of answering,
and for the distressed, at the watch-post of rescue,
and that in eagerly turning to Your generosity and being content with Your decree there is a substitute for the withholding of the stingy,
and a way out from what is in the hands of the grasping,
and that the one journeying to You is near in distance,
and that You are not veiled from Your creation except that deeds veil them from You,
and I have headed to You with my request,
and turned to You with my need,
and made my cry for help through You, and my approach through calling upon You,
not because I deserve to be heard by You, nor because I deserve Your pardon for me,
but because of my trust in Your generosity,
and my calm reliance on the truth of Your promise,
and my resort to faith in Your oneness,
and my certainty, from my knowledge of You, that I have no Lord other than You and no god except You,
alone, with no partner for You.
O God, You are the One who says,
and Your word is truth and Your promise is true: "Ask God of His bounty; indeed God is ever merciful to you",
and it is not among Your attributes, my Master, that You command asking and withhold giving,
while You are the Bestower of gifts upon the people of Your kingdom,
and the One who returns to them with the tenderness of Your compassion.
My God,
You raised me amid Your blessings and Your kindness when I was small, and You made my name renowned when I was grown,
so O You who raised me in this world through His kindness, His favour, and His blessings,
and pointed my knowledge in the Hereafter to His pardon and His generosity,
O my Master, my guide to You, and my love for You, is my intercessor to You,
and I am confident in my guide through Your guidance,
and at rest regarding my intercessor through Your intercession,
I call upon You, my Master, with a tongue that its sin has made mute,
my Lord, I whisper to You with a heart that its crime has ruined,
I call upon You, my Lord, in awe and longing, in hope and fear,
when I see, my Master, my sins, I panic, and when I see Your generosity, I grow eager,
so if You pardon, then You are the best of those who show mercy, and if You punish, then You are not unjust.
My plea, O God, for my boldness in asking You, despite my doing what You dislike, is Your generosity and Your kindness,
and my provision in my hardship, despite my little shame, is Your compassion and Your mercy,
and I have hoped that my wish will not be disappointed between these and those,
so make my hope real and hear my prayer,
O best of those called upon by any caller, and most excellent of those hoped in by any hoper.
Great, my Master, is my hope, and evil is my deed,
so give me from Your pardon in measure of my hope, and do not hold me to account for my worst deed,
for Your generosity is too exalted to repay the sinners,
and Your forbearance is too great to recompense the negligent,
and I, my Master, am one who seeks refuge in Your bounty, fleeing from You to You,
claiming what You promised of overlooking whoever thinks well of You,
and what am I, my Lord, and what is my standing?!
Grant me, by Your bounty, and give charity to me by Your pardon, O my Lord,
envelop me in Your covering,
and excuse me from rebuke, by the nobility of Your face,
for if anyone other than You had looked today upon my sin, I would not have done it,
and if I had feared the hastening of punishment, I would have avoided it,
not because You are the least of onlookers, nor the lightest of observers,
but because You, my Lord, are the best of concealers, the wisest of judges, and the most generous of the generous,
Veiler of faults, Forgiver of sins, Knower of the unseen,
You veil the sin by Your generosity, and You delay punishment by Your forbearance,
so praise be to You for Your forbearance after Your knowledge, and for Your pardon after Your power.
And what emboldens me and makes me dare to disobey You is Your forbearance toward me,
and what calls me to little shame is Your covering over me,
and what hurries me to leap upon Your prohibitions is my knowledge of the vastness of Your mercy and the greatness of Your pardon,
O Forbearing, O Generous,
O Living, O Self-Subsisting,
O Forgiver of sin, O Accepter of repentance,
O Great in favour, O Ancient in kindness,
Where is Your beautiful covering?
Where is Your majestic pardon?
Where is Your near relief?
Where is Your swift succour?
Where is Your vast mercy?
Where is Your surpassing gifts?
Where is Your delightful bestowals?
Where is Your splendid favours?
Where is Your great bounty?
Where is Your immense favour?
Where is Your ancient kindness?
Where is Your generosity, O Generous One?
By it, then, rescue me, and by Your mercy, deliver me,
O Doer of good, O Beautifier,
O Bestower of blessings, O Giver of bounty,
I do not rely, for salvation from Your punishment, upon our deeds,
but upon Your bounty toward us,
for You are worthy of reverence and worthy of forgiveness,
You begin with kindness as blessings,
and You pardon sin out of generosity,
so we do not know what to thank You for,
the beauty of what You spread abroad, or the ugliness of what You conceal?
Or the greatness of what You have tried us with and bestowed, or the abundance of what You have saved us from and spared us?
O Beloved of whoever shows love to You,
and O delight of the eye of whoever takes refuge in You and cuts himself off for You,
You are the Doer of good, and we are the doers of evil,
so overlook, my Lord, the ugliness of what is with us, by the beauty of what is with You,
and what ignorance, my Lord, is there that Your generosity cannot encompass?
and what time is longer than Your patience?
and what is the worth of our deeds beside Your blessings?
and how could we consider many the deeds with which we meet Your generosity?
Rather, how could what has encompassed the sinners of Your mercy become narrow for them?!
O Vast in forgiveness, O Spreader of the two hands in mercy,
then by Your might, my Master, if You rebuked me, I would not leave Your door, nor cease flattering You,
because of what has reached me of knowledge of Your generosity and Your kindness,
and You are the Doer of whatever You will,
You punish whomever You will, with whatever You will, however You will,
and You show mercy to whomever You will, with whatever You will, however You will,
You are not questioned about Your act,
nor contested in Your dominion,
nor shared in Your command,
nor opposed in Your decree,
nor does anyone object to You in Your planning,
Yours is the creation and the command; blessed is God, Lord of the worlds.
My Lord, this is the standing of one who has taken refuge in You, and sought shelter in Your generosity, and grown familiar with Your kindness and Your blessings,
and You are the Generous One whose pardon does not narrow, whose bounty does not lessen, and whose mercy does not grow small,
and we have taken firm assurance from You of ancient overlooking, and great bounty, and vast mercy,
Do You think, my Lord, that You will break our expectations, or disappoint our hopes?
No indeed, O Generous One,
for this is not our expectation of You, nor is this our hope in You,
my Lord, we have in You a hope, long and great,
we have in You a great expectation,
we disobeyed You while hoping that You would cover us,
and we called upon You while hoping that You would answer us,
so make our hope real.
Our Master, we have known what we deserve for our deeds,
but Your knowledge of us, and our knowledge that You do not turn us away from You, urged us to long for You,
and even if we do not deserve Your mercy, You are worthy to be generous to us and to the sinners, by the bounty of Your vastness,
so bestow upon us what You are worthy of,
and be generous to us, for we are in need of attaining You,
O Forgiver, by Your light we have been guided,
and by Your bounty we have become free of need,
and by Your blessing we have entered morning and evening,
our sins are before You,
we seek Your forgiveness, O God, from them, and we turn to You in repentance,
You show affection to us through blessings, while we meet You with sins,
Your good descends to us, and our evil ascends to You,
and there has never ceased, nor does there cease, a noble angel coming to You from us with an ugly deed,
yet that does not prevent You from encompassing us with Your blessings and favouring us with Your bounties,
so glory be to You, how forbearing You are, and how great, and how generous, as Originator and Restorer,
hallowed are Your names, and exalted is Your praise, and noble are Your deeds and Your acts.
You, my God, are vaster in bounty and greater in forbearance than to measure me against my deed and my fault,
so pardon, pardon, pardon,
my Master, my Master, my Master,
O God, occupy us with remembering You,
and protect us from Your anger,
and grant us refuge from Your punishment,
and provide us from Your gifts,
and favour us from Your bounty,
and provide us with the pilgrimage to Your House and the visitation of the grave of Your Prophet,
Your blessings, Your mercy, Your forgiveness, and Your approval be upon him and upon the people of his House,
indeed You are Near, Answering,
and provide us with deeds in obedience to You,
and take our lives upon Your creed and the practice of Your Prophet, may God bless him and his family.
O God, forgive me and my parents, and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small,
repay them for good with good, and for evil deeds with forgiveness,
O God, forgive the believing men and the believing women,
the living among them and the dead,
and join between us and them through good things,
O God, forgive our living and our dead,
and our present and our absent,
our males and our females,
our young and our old,
our free and our enslaved.
The justifiers have denied God, and strayed far astray, and lost a manifest loss.
O God, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
and seal my end with good,
and suffice me against what concerns me of the affair of my world and my Hereafter,
and do not give power over me to one who will not have mercy on me,
and place over me from You a lasting protection,
and do not strip me of the good of what You have blessed me with,
and provide me from Your bounty with a provision, wide, lawful, and wholesome.
O God, guard me with Your guarding,
and preserve me with Your preserving,
and watch over me with Your watchfulness,
and provide me with the pilgrimage to Your Sacred House,
in this year of ours and in every year,
and the visitation of the grave of Your Prophet and the Imams, peace be upon them,
and do not leave me empty, my Lord, of those noble shrines and generous stations.
O God, turn to me in repentance, so that I do not disobey You,
and inspire me with good, and with acting upon it,
and with fear of You by night and by day, as long as You keep me alive,
O Lord of the worlds.
O God, whenever I say that I have readied and prepared myself,
and stood for prayer before You and whispered to You,
You cast drowsiness upon me when I pray,
and You take away Your whispering from me when I whisper,
what is wrong with me, that whenever I say that my inward state has become sound, and my seat has drawn near to the seats of the repentant,
a trial befalls me that removes my footing and comes between me and Your service?
My Master, perhaps You have driven me from Your door,
and set me aside from Your service,
or perhaps You have seen me belittling Your right, so You have banished me,
or perhaps You have seen me turning away from You, so You have loathed me,
or perhaps You have found me in the station of the liars, so You have rejected me,
or perhaps You have seen me ungrateful for Your favours, so You have deprived me,
or perhaps You have missed me from the gatherings of the learned, so You have forsaken me,
or perhaps You have seen me among the heedless, so You have made me despair of Your mercy,
or perhaps You have seen me fond of the gatherings of the idle, so You have left me between me and them,
or perhaps You have not loved to hear my prayer, so You have distanced me,
or perhaps You have recompensed me for my crime and my offence,
or perhaps You have repaid me for my little shame before You,
but if You pardon, my Lord, then how often have You pardoned sinners before me,
for Your generosity, O my Lord, is too exalted to recompense the negligent,
and I am one who seeks refuge in Your bounty, fleeing from You to You,
claiming what You promised of overlooking whoever thinks well of You.
My God,
You are vaster in bounty and greater in forbearance than to measure me against my deed,
or to cause me to slip by my fault,
and what am I, my Master, and what is my standing?
Grant me, by Your bounty, my Master,
and give charity to me by Your pardon,
and envelop me in Your covering,
and excuse me from rebuke, by the nobility of Your face.
My Master,
I am the little one whom You raised,
and I am the ignorant one whom You taught,
and I am the straying one whom You guided,
and I am the lowly one whom You raised up,
and I am the fearful one whom You made safe,
and the hungry one whom You fed,
and the thirsty one whom You gave to drink,
and the naked one whom You clothed,
and the poor one whom You enriched,
and the weak one whom You strengthened,
and the abased one whom You honoured,
and the sick one whom You healed,
and the asker whom You gave,
and the sinner whom You covered,
and the offender whom You excused,
and I am the few whom You made many,
and the oppressed one whom You helped,
and I am the outcast whom You sheltered,
I am, my Lord, the one who did not feel shame before You in private, nor watch over myself before You in public,
I am the owner of the great calamities,
I am the one who dared against his Master,
I am the one who disobeyed the Compeller of heaven,
I am the one who gave bribes for disobedience to the Majestic One,
I am the one who, when told glad tidings of them, went out to them hastening,
I am the one whom You gave time, yet I did not desist,
and You covered me, yet I did not feel shame,
and I acted with disobedience, so I transgressed,
and You dropped me from Your sight, yet I did not care,
so by Your forbearance You gave me time, and by Your covering You covered me,
until it was as though You had overlooked me,
and You kept me away from the punishments of disobedience,
until it was as though You felt shame on my behalf.
My God,
I did not disobey You, when I disobeyed You, while denying Your lordship,
nor while belittling Your command,
nor while exposing myself to Your punishment,
nor while treating Your threat lightly,
but a fault presented itself,
and my soul enticed me,
and my desire overcame me,
and my wretchedness helped me in it,
and Your covering, let down over me, deceived me,
so I disobeyed You and opposed You with all my effort,
so now, from Your punishment, who will rescue me?
And from the hands of the adversaries tomorrow, who will deliver me?
And to whose rope shall I cling, if You cut Your rope from me?
So, alas, for what Your book has recorded of my deed,
which, were it not for what I hope for of Your generosity and the vastness of Your mercy, and Your forbidding me from despair, I would have despaired when I remembered them,
O best of those called upon by any caller,
and most excellent of those hoped in by any hoper,
O God, by the pledge of Islam I approach You,
and by the sanctity of the Quran I rely upon You,
and by my love for the unlettered Prophet, the Qurayshi, the Hashimi, the Arab, the Tihami, the Meccan, the Medinan, I hope for nearness to You,
so do not make the comfort of my faith lonely,
and do not make my reward the reward of one who worshipped other than You,
for a people believed with their tongues, that they might protect their blood by it, and so they attained what they hoped for,
and we have believed in You with our tongues and our hearts, that You might pardon us,
so let us attain what we hoped for,
and make Your hope firm in our breasts,
and do not turn our hearts aside after You have guided us,
and grant us mercy from Yourself; indeed You are the Bestower.
Then, by Your might, if You rebuked me, I would not leave Your door, nor cease flattering You,
because of what my heart has been inspired with of knowledge of Your generosity and the vastness of Your mercy.
To whom does the servant go, except to his Master?
And to whom does the creature take refuge, except to its Creator?
My God, even if You bound me in fetters,
and withheld Your bounty from me before the witnesses,
and pointed the eyes of the servants to my disgraces,
and ordered me to the Fire,
and came between me and the righteous,
I would not cut off my hope from You,
nor turn away my expectation of pardon from You,
nor would Your love leave my heart.
I do not forget Your favours to me, and Your covering over me in the abode of this world,
my Master, take the love of this world out of my heart,
and join me with the Chosen One and his family, Your chosen ones from Your creation, and the Seal of the Prophets, may God bless him and his family,
and move me to the rank of repentance to You,
and help me to weep over myself,
for I have spent my life in putting off and in hopes,
and I have come down to the station of those who despair of my good,
so who would be worse in state than me, if I am carried, in such a state, to my grave,
which I have not prepared for my sleep, nor furnished with righteous deeds for my resting place,
and why should I not weep, when I do not know what my end will be,
and I see my soul deceiving me, and my days tricking me,
and the wings of death have already fluttered over my head,
so why should I not weep?!
I weep for the departure of my soul,
I weep for the darkness of my grave,
I weep for the narrowness of my burial niche,
I weep for the questioning of Munkar and Nakir of me,
I weep for my coming out of my grave naked, abased, carrying my burden on my back,
looking once to my right and another time to my left,
while the creatures are in a concern other than my concern,
for every person among them, that day, has a concern to occupy him,
faces that day, bright,
laughing, rejoicing,
and faces that day, upon them dust,
darkness and abasement covering them,
my Master, upon You is my reliance, my dependence, my hope, and my trust,
and to Your mercy is my attachment,
You strike with Your mercy whomever You will, and You guide by Your nobility whomever You love,
so praise be to You for purifying my heart of idolatry,
and praise be to You for loosening my tongue,
Shall I thank You with this failing tongue of mine?
Or shall I please You with the utmost of my effort in my deeds?
And what is the worth of my tongue, my Lord, beside thanks to You?
And what is the worth of my deed beside Your blessings and Your kindness?
My God, Your generosity has widened my hope, and thanks to You comes before my deed.
My Master,
to You is my longing,
and to You is my fear,
and to You is my expectation,
and my hope has driven me to You,
and upon You, O my One, my resolve has settled,
and in what is with You my longing has expanded,
and Yours alone are my pure hope and my fear,
and in You my love has found comfort,
and to You I have surrendered,
and by the rope of obedience to You I have extended my fear,
O my Master, by remembering You my heart has lived,
and by whispering to You I have cooled the pain of fear from me,
so O my Master, and O my hoped One, and O utmost of my asking,
separate me from my sin, which prevents me from keeping to obedience to You,
for I ask You only by the ancient hope in You,
and the great eagerness for You, which You have made binding upon Yourself, of compassion and mercy,
so the command is Yours alone, with no partner for You,
and all creation are Your dependents, and in Your grasp,
and everything is submissive to You,
blessed are You, O Lord of the worlds.
My God, have mercy on me when my plea is cut off,
and my tongue grows weary of answering You,
and my mind is scattered when You question me,
so O great object of my hope,
do not disappoint me when my need becomes severe, nor turn me away,
for my ignorance, nor withhold from me for my little patience,
give me, for my poverty,
and have mercy on me, for my weakness,
my Master, upon You are my dependence, my reliance, my hope, and my trust,
and to Your mercy is my attachment,
and in Your courtyard I lay down my baggage,
and by Your generosity I seek my request,
and by Your kindness, O my Lord, I open my prayer,
and with You I hope for my destitution,
and by Your wealth I mend my neediness,
and under the shade of Your pardon is my standing,
and to Your generosity and Your kindness I raise my gaze,
and to Your beneficence I keep my look,
so do not burn me with the Fire, while You are the place of my hope,
nor settle me in the Abyss, for You are the delight of my eye,
my Master, do not belie my expectation of Your kindness and Your beneficence, for You are my trust,
nor deprive me of Your reward, for You are the Knower of my poverty.
My God, if my term has drawn near, and my deed has not brought me near to You,
then I have made my confession to You of my sin the means for my ailments,
My God, if You pardon, then who is more worthy of pardoning than You?
And if You punish, then who is more just than You in judgement?
Have mercy, in this world, on my strangeness,
and at death, on my distress,
and in the grave, on my loneliness,
and in the burial niche, on my desolation,
and when I am raised for reckoning before You, on the lowliness of my standing,
and forgive me what was hidden from people of my deed,
and keep for me what You have covered me with,
and have mercy on me, struck down on the bed, turned by the hands of my loved ones,
and favour me, stretched out on the washing place, turned by my righteous neighbours,
and be tender to me, carried, while my relatives have taken the edges of my bier,
and be generous to me, moved, for I have come down to You, alone, in my pit,
and have mercy, in that new house, on my strangeness, until I find comfort in none but You.
My Master, if You entrust me to myself, I perish,
my Master, then in whom shall I seek rescue, if You do not lift my stumble,
then to whom shall I flee, if I lose Your care in my resting place?
and to whom shall I take refuge, if You do not relieve my distress?
My Master, who is there for me, and who will have mercy on me, if You do not have mercy on me?
And whose bounty shall I hope for, if I lack Your bounty on the day of my need?
And to whom is the flight from sins, when my term has ended?
My Master, do not punish me while I hope in You,
my God, make my hope real and make my fear safe,
for with the multitude of my sins, I hope in nothing but Your pardon,
my Master, I ask You for what I do not deserve,
and You are worthy of reverence and worthy of forgiveness,
so forgive me, and clothe me, by Your regard, with a garment that covers my liabilities for me, and forgives them for me, so that I am not called to account for them,
indeed You are Possessor of ancient favour, and great overlooking, and generous passing over.
My God, You are the One who pours out Your bounty upon one who does not ask You, and upon the deniers of Your lordship,
so how, my Master, will it be with one who has asked You, and is certain that creation belongs to You and command returns to You,
blessed and exalted are You, O Lord of the worlds,
my Master, Your servant is at Your door, whom need has made to stand before You,
knocking at the door of Your kindness with his prayer,
so do not turn away Your noble face from me,
and accept from me what I say,
for I have prayed with this prayer, hoping that You will not turn me away, from my knowledge of Your compassion and Your mercy.
My God, You are the One whom no asker wearies, and whom no gift lessens,
You are as You say, and above what we say.
O God, I ask You for beautiful patience,
and near relief,
and truthful speech,
and a great reward,
I ask You, my Lord, for all good, what I know of it and what I do not know,
I ask You, O God, for the best of what Your righteous servants have asked You for,
O best of those asked, and most generous of those who give,
grant me my request, for myself, my family, my parents, my children, my household, and my brothers in You,
and make my living plentiful,
and make my manliness manifest,
and set right all my states,
and make me among those whose life You have lengthened,
and whose deed You have made good,
and upon whom You have completed Your blessing,
and with whom You are pleased,
and whom You have given a good life, in lasting joy, and most ample honour, and most complete living,
indeed You do whatever You will, and none but You does whatever he wills.
O God, single me out from You with a special remembrance of You,
and do not make anything by which I draw near to You, in the watches of the night and the ends of the day, show, or reputation, or insolence, or arrogance,
and make me, for You, among the humble.
O God, grant me amplitude in provision,
and security in the homeland,
and delight of the eye in family, wealth, and children,
and abiding in Your blessings with me,
and health in the body,
and strength in the frame,
and safety in religion,
and employ me in obedience to You, and obedience to Your Messenger Muhammad, may God bless him and his family, for as long as You keep me alive,
and make me among the fullest share of Your servants in every good You have sent down, and will send down, in the month of Ramadan, on the Night of Decree,
and what You will send down in every year,
of mercy You spread,
and well-being You clothe,
and trial You repel,
and good deeds You accept,
and evil deeds You pass over,
and provide me with the pilgrimage to Your Sacred House, in this year of ours and in every year,
and provide me with a wide provision from Your vast bounty,
and turn away from me, my Master, evils,
and settle for me debt and wrongs, so that I am not harmed by any of them,
and take for me, by the hearing and sight of my enemies, my enviers, and those who wrong me,
and help me against them,
and delight my eye, and gladden my heart,
and make for me, from my worry and distress, relief and a way out,
and place whoever among all Your creation intends me harm beneath my feet,
and suffice me against the evil of Satan, and the evil of the ruler, and the evils of my deed,
and purify me from all sins,
and grant me refuge from the Fire by Your pardon,
and enter me into Paradise by Your mercy,
and wed me to the wide-eyed maidens by Your bounty,
and join me to Your righteous friends,
Muhammad and his family, the righteous, the good, the pure, the chosen,
Your blessings upon them, and upon their bodies and their spirits,
and the mercy of God and His blessings.
My God and my Master,
and by Your might and Your majesty,
if You demand me for my sins, I will demand You for Your pardon,
and if You demand me for my baseness, I will demand You for Your generosity,
and if You enter me into the Fire, I will tell the people of the Fire of my love for You.
My God and my Master,
if You forgive none but Your friends and the people of obedience to You,
then to whom shall the sinners flee?
And if You honour none but the people of loyalty to You,
then by whom shall the evildoers seek rescue?
My God, if You enter me into the Fire, then in that is the joy of Your enemy,
and if You enter me into Paradise, then in that is the joy of Your Prophet,
and I, by God, know that the joy of Your Prophet is dearer to You than the joy of Your enemy.
O God, I ask You to fill my heart with love for You,
and fear of You,
and assent to Your Book,
and faith in You,
and dread of You,
and longing for You,
O Possessor of majesty and honour.
Make meeting You beloved to me, and make my meeting beloved to You,
and make for me, in meeting You, rest, and relief, and honour.
O God, join me to the righteous of those who have passed,
and make me among the righteous of those who remain,
and take me by the path of the righteous,
and help me against myself with what You help the righteous with against themselves,
and seal my deed with its best,
and make my reward from it Paradise, by Your mercy,
and help me to do good with what You have given me,
and make me firm, my Lord, and do not return me to an evil from which You rescued me,
O Lord of the worlds.
O God, I ask You for a faith that has no term short of meeting You,
keep me alive, as long as You keep me alive, upon it,
and take my life, when You take my life, upon it,
and raise me, when You raise me, upon it,
and cleanse my heart of show, and doubt, and reputation, in Your religion,
until my deed is purely for You.
O God, grant me insight in Your religion,
and understanding in Your judgement,
and comprehension in Your knowledge,
and two shares of Your mercy,
and restraint that holds me back from disobeying You,
and whiten my face with Your light,
and place my longing in what is with You,
and take my life in Your path, and upon the creed of Your Messenger, may God bless him and his family.
O God, I seek refuge in You from laziness, and failure, and worry, and cowardice, and miserliness, and heedlessness, and hardness, and destitution, and poverty, and need, and every trial,
and from shameful deeds, what is open of them and what is hidden,
and I seek refuge in You from a soul that is not content,
and a belly that is not filled,
and a heart that is not humble,
and a prayer that is not heard,
and a deed that does not benefit,
and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, for myself, my religion, my wealth, and for all that You have provided me, from Satan, the outcast,
indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
O God, no one grants me refuge from You,
nor do I find, apart from You, any place of escape,
so do not place my soul in anything of Your punishment,
nor send me back with destruction, nor send me back with a painful punishment.
O God, accept from me,
and raise my renown,
and lift my rank,
and take away my burden,
and do not remind me of my fault,
and make the reward of my sitting, and the reward of my speech, and the reward of my prayer, Your approval and Paradise,
and give me, my Lord, all that I have asked You for,
and increase me from Your bounty,
indeed I long for You, O Lord of the worlds.
O God, You have sent down in Your Book that we pardon whoever wronged us, and we have wronged ourselves,
so pardon us, for You are more worthy of that than we are,
and You commanded us not to turn away an asker from our doors,
and I have come to You as an asker, so do not turn me away except with my need fulfilled,
and You commanded us to do good to what our right hands possess,
and we are Your slaves, so free our necks from the Fire,
O my refuge at my distress,
and O my succour at my hardship,
to You I have fled, and by You I have sought rescue and taken refuge,
I take refuge in none but You, and I seek relief from none but You,
so rescue me and relieve me,
O You who free the captive, and pardon much,
accept from me the little, and pardon for me the much,
indeed You are the Merciful, the Forgiving.
O God, I ask You for a faith that touches my heart directly,
and certainty, until I know that nothing will befall me except what You have written for me,
and make me content in life with what You have apportioned for me,
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
entries.note_en: Recited in the pre-dawn hours (sahar) of Ramadan nights, as narrated from Imam Zayn al-Abidin (as) via Abu Hamza al-Thumali.

وَاهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ اجْمَعِينَ
وَاسْالُكَ بِكُلِّ مَسْالَةٍ سَالَكَ بِهَا احَدٌ
مِمَنْ رَضِيتَ عَنْهُ فَحَتَمْتَ لَهُ عَلىٰ ٱلإِجَابَةِ
يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ

يَا رَحِيمُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا رَحِيمُ
يَا ذَا ٱلْجَلاَ لِ وَٱلإِكْرَامِ
يَا ذَا ٱلْجَلاَ لِ وَٱلإِكْرَامِ
يَا ذَا ٱلْجَلاَلِ وَٱلإِكْرَامِ
بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ
اسْالُكَ بِكُلِّ ٱسْمٍ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ
اوْ انْزَلْتَهُ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ كُتُبِكَ
اوِ ٱسْتَاثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ ٱلَّذِي عِنْدَكَ
وَبِمَعَاِقدِ ٱلْعِزِّ مِنْ عَرْشِكَ
وَبِمُنْتَهَىٰ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ
وَبِمَا ﴿وَلَوْ انّ َمَا فِي ٱلارْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ اقْلاَمٌ
وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ ابْحُرٍ
مَا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَاتُ ٱللَّهِ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾
وَاسْالُكَ بِاسْمَائِكَ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
